jobs.title: Supervisor Production (Food Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
Reporting to the immediate manager, this role leads daily production operations, ensuring efficient use of labor and materials to meet schedule targets. Key responsibilities include maintaining a safe work environment, enforcing sanitation and GMP standards, and driving operational excellence through strong problem-solving and effective team leadership. Success in this role requires sound judgment, accountability, and the ability to foster positive employee relations while achieving performance goals.  Must be able to work rotating shift (3rd, 2nd, 1st) as needed.

• Lead daily packaging operations to ensure safe, efficient, and effective use of labor, materials, and time in meeting production schedules.
• Monitor and control packaging processes by maintaining standard operating procedures (SOPs) and implementing necessary adjustments to achieve production targets.
• Ensure delivery of required quality, output, yield, and line efficiency in alignment with customer and organizational expectations.
• Maintain accountability for manufacturing and shipping performance, including productivity, efficiency, and operational continuity.
• Serve as back-up support for supervisors and lead personnel as needed to maintain operational coverage.
• Drive and model strict adherence to OSHA, environmental, food safety, GMP, and company policies across all operations.
• Promote and enforce a safe work environment, including participation in safety programs and meetings.
• Maintain high standards of sanitation, housekeeping, and equipment cleanliness to meet GMP and Quality System requirements.
• Train employees on proper safety practices, operating procedures, and compliance expectations.
• Supervise, direct, and develop team members to achieve operational goals while fostering a positive and productive work environment.
• Administer company policies consistently, addressing performance issues and implementing corrective actions when necessary.
• Promote teamwork, engagement, and strong employee relations through proactive communication and leadership.
• Drive operational performance by monitoring key metrics such as efficiency, yield, and production rates, and implementing improvements where needed.
• Apply root cause analysis and problem-solving techniques to resolve operational challenges and prevent recurrence.
• Collaborate with Maintenance and Production teams to optimize equipment performance and sustain line efficiencies.
• Support adherence to established budget targets by managing labor and operational resources effectively.
• Optimize use of materials and workforce allocation to improve cost efficiency without compromising safety or quality.
• Communicate daily shift activities, performance results, and key issues to plant leadership in a timely manner.
• Coordinate cross-functionally with production, maintenance, and leadership teams to ensure alignment and issue resolution.
• Participate in regular meetings (e.g., safety, GMP) to support alignment and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Must be able to work rotating shift (3rd, 2nd, 1st) as needed

Education: High school diploma required; a bachelor’s degree in operations, engineering, business, or a related field is preferred.

Experience: 3–5 years of manufacturing experience, ideally in food processing, packaging, or food safety environments. Prior supervisory or leadership experience preferred.

Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (including Outlook) and general PC literacy required.

Competencies

• Accountability - Holds self and others accountable to meet commitments
• Effective Teambuilding - Active participation in, or creation of, teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals
• Customer Focus - Builds strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
• Creative and Innovative Thinking - Develops fresh ideas that provide solutions; creates new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
• Effective Communication - Develops and delivers communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
• Ethics & Integrity - Earns others' trust and respect through honesty, integrity, authenticity and professionalism in all interactions.

Ability to lift 50 lbs, climb stairs/ladders, bend, kneel, stand for long periods, work in confined spaces, and work at heights.

Requires adequate sensory acuity to identify normal and abnormal conditions.

Must be able to logically and methodically work through and break down complex problems and communicate effectively across all levels.

Must pass background check and drug screen.

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision

jobs.title: Building Envelope Internship
jobs.description:
SOCOTEC’s Building Envelope team helps clients evaluate, design, construct, maintain, and improve the exterior components of buildings. The building envelope includes systems such as exterior walls, windows, doors, roofs, waterproofing, and other components that protect buildings from weather and the surrounding environment.

Our projects range from new construction to upgrades, repairs, maintenance, and repositioning of existing buildings. As a Building Envelope Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers, inspectors, and Project Managers to gain exposure to both the technical and practical sides of building envelope consulting.

About SOCOTEC’s Summer Internship Program

SOCOTEC’s summer internship program is designed for college students who are eager to gain hands-on industry experience and learn more about the work we do. Interns receive well-rounded exposure to their field, with opportunities to spend time both on job sites and in the office while working alongside experienced professionals.

As a Building Envelope Intern, you can expect to spend approximately 2–3 days per week in the field, gaining firsthand experience with real-world building projects, construction activities, and site inspections. The remainder of your time will be spent in the office supporting project teams and learning how Building Envelope services are delivered.

What You’ll Do

Depending on the project, you may have the opportunity to:

• Participate in field visits and construction site inspections alongside experienced engineers and inspectors.
• Observe different phases of exterior wall and building envelope construction.
• Learn how building envelope projects progress from design and planning through construction.
• Assist with field reviews and documenting construction progress.
• Learn how to identify and document building envelope conditions and potential issues.
• Assist with reviewing architectural and construction drawings.
• Gain exposure to shop drawings, design development, and construction documents.
• Assist with building envelope research, inspections, and technical evaluations.
• Help prepare clear and detailed project reports, photographs, and other documentation.
• Gain exposure to building codes, construction standards, and industry best practices.
• Work alongside Project Managers and other team members to support project activities and deadlines.
• Learn how engineers and inspectors communicate technical information to clients, contractors, architects, and design teams.
• Attend team meetings, training sessions, and in-house seminars.
• Assist with other project-related assignments as needed.
• Develop your technical, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field. Architectural, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering is preferred.
• Interest in building envelope design, construction, inspection, and engineering.
• Basic understanding of building construction, architectural design, or structural concepts is a plus.
• Ability or willingness to learn how to read and interpret architectural and construction drawings.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively with engineers, inspectors, Project Managers, and other team members.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Familiarity with AutoCAD, Revit, BIM, or other modeling/drafting software is a plus, but not required.
• Comfortable working both in an office and on active construction sites.
• Willingness to learn, ask questions, and take on new challenges.

What You’ll Gain

Through this internship, you will gain:

• Hands-on experience with real-world Building Envelope projects.
• Exposure to exterior wall systems, windows, doors, roofing, waterproofing, and other building envelope components.
• Experience participating in field reviews and construction site inspections.
• An understanding of how building envelope projects move from design through construction.
• Exposure to architectural drawings, shop drawings, construction documents, and building codes.
• Experience working with engineers, inspectors, Project Managers, clients, contractors, architects, and design teams.
• Opportunities to apply your classroom knowledge to practical building and construction challenges.
• Mentorship and professional development from experienced industry professionals.
• A better understanding of career opportunities in Building Envelope Engineering, Inspection, and Consulting.

Work Environment

This is a combination of field and office-based work. Building Envelope interns should expect to spend approximately 2–3 days per week on construction sites or at project locations.

Field work may involve walking active construction sites, climbing stairs or ladders, and working in various weather conditions. Interns will be expected to follow all applicable site safety requirements and will receive guidance from their supervisor and project team.

Potential Career Paths

This internship can provide a strong foundation for future opportunities in Building Envelope Engineering, Inspection, and Consulting, including entry-level roles such as:

• Building Envelope Engineer
• Engineer Inspector
• Building Envelope Consultant
• Project Engineer

For more information, please visit www.socotec.us

Job Type: Full-Time

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

SOCOTEC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Automation PLC Engineer
jobs.description:
This role supports the Automation division by leading and executing control system design, programming, and commissioning on automation projects. You’ll be responsible for delivering reliable, scalable, and well-documented industrial control solutions that directly impact customer success and project outcomes. Success in this role means meeting project requirements with technical excellence and clear communication, all while upholding KE’s commitment to Safety, People, Passion, and Performance. If you're someone who takes pride in doing things the right way and thrives in a fast-moving environment, this position is built for you.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be part of a team that gets things done, works with purpose, and takes pride in the results. Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

• Technically lead automation projects from conception to completion, ensuring adherence to timelines and budgetary constraints.
• Provide detailed design of industrial control systems including control panel design, networking design, and field device specification.
• Interpret P&ID, Process Flows, Specifications, and other system design documentation to use as the basis of control system design and programming.
• Create I/O lists, specifications, test procedures, FDS manuals, and other project documentation as needed.
• Create and document control system PLC/HMI/SCADA programs using modular and reusable programming techniques.
• Configure and program control system devices such as managed Ethernet switches, protocol converters, VFDs, and other controllers.
• Provide on-site control system start-up and commissioning.
• Assist technicians with field modifications as needed.
• Participate in client meetings to define scope and functional and operational requirements of the PLC/HMI/SCADA system.
• Provide technical assistance to field technicians on PLC/HMI/SCADA programs.
• Troubleshoot, test, and analyze existing project program errors and revise programs to operational order.
• Work independently and as part of a team on multiple projects simultaneously.
• Proven ability to develop professionally through direct mentorship and personally sourced academics.
• Ability to stay aware of industry best practices and emerging technological developments.
• Effectively communicate with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
• Excellent critical thinking skills supporting sound technical solutions to complex problems.
• Strong verbal, written and presentation skills.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

What You Bring

You’re someone who shows up ready to work hard, learn fast, and contribute to a team that takes pride in doing things right. Successful candidates typically bring:

• 5+ years’ programming experience with PLC/HMI/SCADA applications.
• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, or Computer Science, or equivalent education/experience.
• Detailed knowledge of industrial control systems, motor control, and field instrumentation.
• Highly proficient at creating complete PLC programs using RSLogix 5000, FactoryTalk View SE, and the Rockwell portfolio suite.
• Experience with Step 7 and TIA Portal is beneficial.
• Experience with HMI/SCADA screens, preferably using Ignition, FactoryTalk View, or Wonderware.
• Working knowledge of Ethernet/IP industrial communication protocol.
• Experience with Modbus TCP, Modbus Serial, Profibus, Profinet, ControlNet, Ethernet and DeviceNet is also beneficial.
• Knowledge of scripting languages and databases.
• Time management skills and ability to meet deadlines.
• Proven communication, organizational, interpersonal and problem-solving skills.
• Work occasional start-ups which may include extended working hours.
• Required travel up to 30% of the time. Most start-ups are local or regional travel and are typically 2 weeks or less in duration.

Pay Range

We believe in paying for the value you bring to the team, and we aim to be competitive in every market we hire in.

Pay Range: $105,000 – $120,000 per year plus per diem and discretionary incentive opportunities

Total Rewards

As a full-time employee at Knobelsdorff, you'll have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and future.

• 100% employer-paid health and dental coverage for employees
• HSA contributions to support your medical expenses
• Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage
• 401(k) with competitive company match
• Paid weekly with competitive wages
• PTO, six paid holidays, and education reimbursement
• Exclusive employee discounts through Working Advantage

We believe your work should be rewarded with more than just a paycheck. At KE, we invest in your total wellbeing.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided for individuals with disabilities.

Typical requirements may include:

• Must be able to sit, stand, kneel, stoop, walk, and sit for long periods of time.
• Must be physically capable of lifting and carrying up to 20 lbs.
• Must be able to climb ladders on equipment mezzanines.
• Must be able to climb stairs over 100 feet.
• Must be able to periodically work in a noisy and dirty environment.
• Must be able to travel up to 100% or be on-site

The Technical Operations Support Technician will provide hands-on support for R&D laboratory operations, with primary focus on equipment setup, material production support, equipment cleaning, and room readiness. jobs.title: Sr Scientist, Quantitative Bioimaging
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Scientist to advance quantitative bioimaging capabilities in support of immunology discovery research. In this role, you will work within a cross-functional team with access to multiple microscopy modalities, complex in vitro models, multimodal biological datasets, and advanced computational infrastructure. You will develop and apply quantitative imaging and machine-learning approaches to characterize cellular and tissue phenotypes, support the development of complex in vitro models, and generate insights that advance immunology discovery programs. The role sits at the intersection of biology, bioengineering, microscopy, and computational science; candidates who have combined expertise in two or more of these areas are especially encouraged to apply. This position is onsite in Worcester, Massachusetts.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, optimize, and apply imaging assays and quantitative image-analysis workflows for 2D and 3D cellular and tissue models across multiple microscopy platforms.
• Collaborate with wet-lab assay scientists, imaging specialists, and computational scientists from experimental design through image acquisition, analysis, and data delivery.
• Design and implement reproducible computer-vision and machine-learning pipelines for image segmentation, object detection, feature extraction, phenotypic profiling, and representation learning.
• Extract biologically meaningful, multiparametric features from high-content imaging datasets and use them to characterize disease-relevant phenotypes, mechanisms, and treatment responses.
• Establish practical quality-control and evaluation frameworks that assess image and assay quality, distinguish biological signal from technical artifacts, and define appropriate limitations and acceptance criteria.
• Apply statistical, machine-learning, and deep-learning methods to identify candidate imaging biomarkers and relate imaging phenotypes to molecular, functional, and other biological readouts.
• Maintain clear experimental and analytical records; analyze, visualize, and present results rigorously to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
• Stay current with advances in quantitative bioimaging, image analysis, computer vision, and foundation models for biological imaging, and evaluate opportunities to incorporate relevant approaches into team workflows.

Basic Qualifications

• BS, MS, or PhD in engineering, biophysics, computational biology, imaging science or a related discipline, with typically 10-12+ (BS), 8-10+ (MS), or 0-4+ (PhD) years experience.
• Demonstrated experience with microscopy, high-content imaging, quantitative image analysis, or phenotypic in vitro assay development.
• Experience working with at least one relevant imaging modality or assay type, such as confocal, high-content imaging, or cell painting. Candidates should be able to assess image quality, recognize common artifacts, and interpret biologically meaningful phenotypes.
• Working knowledge of machine-learning or deep-learning approaches for biological imaging, with the ability to understand model behavior, assess performance, and contribute to appropriate evaluation strategies.
• Proficiency with the Python data-science ecosystem, including NumPy, pandas, Polars, scikit-learn, and/or PyTorch.
• Strong biological grounding, attention to experimental rigor, and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with wet-lab and computational colleagues.
• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain methods, results, assumptions, and limitations to diverse audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with complex in vitro models, such as organoids, organ-on-chip models and other advanced in vitro model platforms.
• Familiarity with image-based profiling, dimensionality-reduction methods, clustering, morphological feature analysis, or phenotypic similarity analysis.
• Peer-reviewed publications, patents, conference presentations, or other demonstrated scientific contributions in quantitative bioimaging, computer vision, computational biology, bioengineering, or a related field.

This is a critical leadership position designed for a strategic and hands-on leader who will shape the future of our operations across North America. You will not only lead business operations for the region but also proactively identify opportunities for improvement and guide a team of BizOps managers to execute these initiatives.

This is a high-visibility leadership role with significant regional scope. For the right candidate, this position offers a clear succession pathway to senior executive entity leadership in North America. You will serve as the primary operational representative to our regulators and the regional Board of Directors.

What you’ll do.

You will lead the North American operational strategy, directing a matrixed footprint of over 1,000 support and servicing team members located in our European hubs (Budapest and Tallinn), while building out our local teams in Austin and São Paulo.

• Strategic Leadership: Lead the business operations organization in the region, identifying and capitalizing on opportunities to enhance efficiency and performance. You will work closely with global heads to shape the future of the region, including location strategy and capacity planning.
• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a small team of high-performing BizOps managers, guiding them to execute on key operational improvements.
• Regulatory & Board Representation: Represent our operations confidently and credibly in front of regulators and our board of directors.
• Expansion and Growth: Collaborate with the North American leadership team on strategic expansion into new markets and regions.
• Talent Development: Grow and mentor local operational leaders, hire new talent, and establish effective local ways of working, including hybrid models and career growth opportunities.
• Execution in a Flat Structure: Embrace our flat organizational structure by being a leader who can both strategize and execute, getting your hands dirty to solve problems and drive projects forward.

Accountability & Success Metrics.

Your success will be measured by your ability to scale our regional operations efficiently and sustainably.

While you will ultimately hold accountability for regional servicing metrics (including SLAs, efficiency targets and resolution quality), your primary focus will be on driving structural improvements. You will work in lockstep with our product teams to build forward-looking infrastructure that upgrades our operations.

• Operational Excellence: Proactively identify systemic operational vulnerabilities, lead high-impact automation projects, and drive contact deflection strategies to scale our volume without linearly scaling headcount.
• Strategic Planning: Translate product requirements into a sustainable servicing model and formulate both long-term strategies and actionable 6-month plans.
• Data-Driven Decisions: Build, track and execute against robust KPIs, using data to uncover operational insights and eliminate customer friction points.
• Location and Talent Strategy: Act as a "local office leader", owning decisions on location changes, and contributing to our hybrid work strategy. You will also provide key input into forecasting and hiring decisions.

We are looking for a seasoned leader with a proven ability to operate at a senior level in a dynamic, product-driven environment.

Essential:

• Experience: A minimum of 7+ years of experience in senior operational leadership roles within FinTech or at US banks.
• Leadership in Scale-Up Environments: A highly successful track record in senior operational leadership, with a sophisticated approach to managing people, processes, and fast-moving organizational change. You must have a demonstrated ability to execute and scale within complex, tech-driven operations or product-led servicing environments.
• Regulatory and Board Experience: Proven experience representing operations to regulators and a board of directors.
• Product Partnership: A track record of working in true partnership with product teams to build effective solutions for support challenges.
• Analytical & Data-Driven: You must be able to build and execute against KPIs and use data to solve complex problems and find insights.
• Local Market Knowledge: A strong understanding of the laws, culture, and regulations within the US market.

Leading at Wise

Our 4D leadership framework, defined by four key attributes, captures what it means to be an impactful leader at Wise. Our unique culture gives teams and individuals the autonomy to make impactful decisions for our customers. Leaders empowr their teams to deliver this impact and champion our culture.

• Design: Our leaders design the strategic direction, empowering their teams to operate autonomously and make data-driven decisions that directly benefit our customers.
• Drive: They drive a high-performing culture by acting as a coach, nurturing an environment of continuous development and growth.
• Develop: Leaders actively develop resilience and emotional intelligence to lead authentically and by example.
• Disrupt: They disrupt the status quo by championing change and innovation, constantly seeking new ways to achieve our mission.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

• Coordinate dock scheduling and material movement throughout the facility

• Maintain warehouse organization and cleanliness according to 6S standards

• Lead, coach, and develop warehouse associates to achieve safety, quality, and productivity goals

• Conduct weekly safety observations and corrective actions

• Investigate incidents and near misses and recommend preventative measures

• Ensure proper use of warehouse equipment, including forklifts and pallet jacks

• Maintain compliance with company procedures and operational standards

Continuous Improvement

• Track and analyze warehouse performance metrics including: Inventory Accuracy Order Accuracy On-Time Shipment Performance Productivity Rates Safety Metrics

• Support implementation of Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement initiatives

• Physical Requirements: Ability to stand and walk for extended periods Ability to lift and move up to 50 pounds Ability to work in a warehouse environment with varying temperatures Ability to safely operate warehouse equipment when required

jobs.title: Head of Product, PAYO Digital Bank
jobs.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role summary

PAYO Digital Bank, N.A. (PDB), Payoneer's national trust bank subsidiary, is seeking a strategic, execution-focused Head of Product to own the product vision and roadmap for the bank's core offering: stablecoin issuance and redemption, customer onboarding, on/off-ramp experiences, built on the bank's core ledger and custody infrastructure.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer of PDB. The ideal candidate is a seasoned product leader with regulated payments or banking experience who is comfortable building zero-to-one in an environment where compliance is a design input, not an afterthought. You will hold a roadmap to a regulatory clock, run disciplined launch gates, partner ruthlessly with engineering on execution, and represent product decisions to OCC examiners with confidence.

Candidates must be based in New York, NY OR Miami, FL | Full-time

What you'll do

• Product Vision & Roadmap: Define and own the end-to-end product vision for PAYO-USD issuance, redemption, and payment flows, sequenced against the bank's regulatory milestones from pre-opening exam readiness through controlled pilot to general availability.

• Engineering Partnership & Execution: Act as the ultimate unblocker for the engineering team. Drive ruthless prioritization, define clear acceptance criteria, and manage technical trade-offs to ensure on-time delivery without compromising compliance.

• Compliance-Embedded Design: Partner with Compliance to embed KYC, sanctions screening, and transaction monitoring controls directly into product flows. Document user journeys to a standard suitable for strict regulatory examination.

• Launch Governance: Design the controlled pilot, including transaction volume caps, staged merchant onboarding, and clearly defined launch criteria. Enforce feature freeze discipline ahead of user acceptance testing.

• Vendor & Platform Requirements: Own product requirements for the bank's core banking, custody, screening, and oracle infrastructure partners, driving integration decisions alongside Engineering.

• Transparency & Trust: Shape product requirements supporting proof-of-reserve attestation so stablecoin holders can seamlessly verify 1:1 backing.

• Stakeholder Leadership: Represent product decisions to the board, management committees, and OCC examiners as required.

Who you are

• Product Leadership: 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years in payments, banking, or digital assets.

• Regulated Environment Experience: Direct experience shipping products inside a regulated financial institution, ideally under OCC, Federal Reserve, or state banking supervision.

• Zero-to-One Track Record: Demonstrated success taking a complex product from concept to launch, navigating technical dependencies, pilot design, and staged rollouts.

• Stablecoin Mechanics: Working knowledge of mint/burn flows, reserve backing, redemption rights, and on-chain/off-chain reconciliation.

• Compliance by Design: Demonstrated ability to build compliance requirements into the core product architecture rather than bolting them on afterward.

• Regulator-Ready Communication: Strong written and verbal skills; comfortable producing documentation reviewed by regulators and external auditors, and presenting to examiners.

Not a must but a great advantage:

• GENIUS Act Familiarity: Understanding of the Permitted Payment Stablecoin Issuer framework.

• SMB & Cross-Border: Experience serving SMB or cross-border payments customer bases.

In accordance with New York City Law, below is the annual base salary range for this position. Actual annual base salary is based on, but not limited to: experience, education, professional licenses, location and business needs. The position is eligible for health insurance, disability insurance, life insurance, 401k plan, paid-time off, and sick (and where applicable safe) leave. This position is also eligible for a discretionary year-end bonus.

The annual base salary range for this position is

$220,000—$320,000 USD

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

jobs.title: [2026-2027] Social Worker - Middle School
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

School social workers are responsible for supporting the emotional, social, academic and character growth and well-being of KIPP NYC students and families. Social workers play a vital role in ensuring our students succeed in school and go on to lead self-sufficient, successful, and happy lives.

General responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Provide direct services to the school community, including:

• Providing regular one-on-one counseling or group counseling to students and families;
• Providing crisis intervention as needed;
• Managing, tracking, and documenting student interactions and counseling schedule;
• Setting goals with students and tracking progress towards those goals;
• Working directly with students to help them successfully work towards high school graduation, college matriculation and self-sufficiency;
• Collaborating and communicating daily with supervisors, colleagues, and teachers to meet students’ needs.

Manage aspects of the referral process for social services, partnerships, and special education services, including:

• Provide support and documentation for all students with IEPs.
• Meet regularly with students who have mandated counseling on their IEPs;
• Conducting regular assessments of current and emerging student and family needs;
• Developing and maintaining partnerships with external agencies;
• Referring individuals and families to external resources and services, and when necessary, referring cases of suspected child abuse to the State Central Registry.
• Monitoring and facilitating the delivery of external resources and services;
• Administering records, documentation, and other compliance activities.

Design and coordinate student engagement, family engagement, and family education activities, including:

• Home visits for newly enrolled and current students, as appropriate;
• Workshops to educate families, staff, and/or students on specific issues;
• Support the Principal, Deans, and teachers when discipline issues arise.
• Participate actively in department meetings, faculty meetings, and other meetings.
• Consult with the school’s Student Response Teams to develop comprehensive supports and interventions to students who are presenting challenging behaviors.
• Share responsibility for grade-level and school-wide activities, including chaperoning day and overnight trips.
• Provide recommendations to the staff and leadership team around approaches to working with struggling students.
• Implement and enhance the school’s systems and culture by discussing character education with students.
• Meet with parents (English and Spanish-speaking) regularly regarding student issues.
• Establish a professional rapport and strong relationship with students, staff, and families.
• Display the highest ethical and professional behavior and confidentiality when working with students, parents, and staff.
• Ensure a safe, positive environment in group and one-on-one counseling sessions.
• Commit to professional growth.

• Strong interpersonal skills that contribute to a collegial work environment and reflect the character traits we value: zest, grit, hope, social intelligence, gratitude, and a sense of humor
• A passion for being part of a team-oriented, mission-driven school culture
• Documented track record of personal and professional success
• Extensive knowledge of adolescent development
• Experience in therapeutic modalities related to children and families from the communities KIPP NYC serves, including assessment and treatment of trauma
• Experience working within a school environment or extensive work with teenagers and young adults
• LMSW (Licensed Master Social Worker) or LCSW (Licensed Clinical Social Worker)
• Oral and written fluency in Spanish is highly preferred

jobs.title: Presentations Supervisor
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Presentations Supervisor is a hands-on, working supervisor responsible for leading day-to-day people, workflow, quality, and client service across presentation and creative services. In addition to supervising the team, the supervisor actively performs presentation production and creative work as business needs require, including complex or high-priority assignments. The role coordinates work across onsite and offshore teams, enabling effective intake, allocation, handoffs, quality control, and on-time delivery. The supervisor supports operational excellence, client satisfaction, and team member growth and development.

Key Responsibilities

• Supervise day-to-day work assignments across presentation and creative services, including presentation design, creative or marketing design, pitch books, projects, and ad hoc requests.
• Operate as a working supervisor by providing hands-on presentation production, formatting, design, proofreading, quality assurance, and troubleshooting support as workload and service priorities require.
• Coordinate workflow across onsite and offshore teams, including intake, prioritization, resource allocation, turnaround expectations, inter-shift handoffs, status communication, and escalation management.
• Ensure offshore partners receive complete instructions, source materials, templates, brand standards, deadlines, and client-specific requirements needed to execute work accurately.
• Monitor work transferred between teams and shifts, validate ownership and status, and ensure seamless follow-through through final delivery.
• Perform and oversee quality assurance to confirm accuracy, consistency, brand compliance, and adherence to client and company standards before delivery.
• Ensure quality service delivery through standard operating procedures, alignment with the account plan, and achievement of agreed-upon service metrics and goals.
• Respond to client inquiries promptly and professionally; keep the client and manager informed of significant or potential issues and recommend solutions that reduce recurrence.
• Manage the employee lifecycle, including interviewing, onboarding, training, development, succession planning, and offboarding.
• Ensure compliance with company and client policies, service level agreements, confidentiality requirements, and expected quality standards; use corrective action when necessary.
• Enable team performance by setting goals and priorities and providing regular feedback through individual and group communication.
• Monitor staffing and workflow volumes and use workflow management systems to align resources by shift, location, or service line based on demand.
• Complete required administrative and operational reporting accurately and on time.
• Support the manager with P&L-related activities and understand the impact of overtime, time off, offshore utilization, and staffing decisions on service costs.
• Support materials for Client Service Reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews, as needed.
• Maintain a strong understanding of the client’s business and the impact of presentation services.
• Foster cross-training, collaboration, and consistent working practices across onsite and offshore teams.
• Train and coach junior team members and contribute to continuous improvement of tools, templates, workflows, and operating procedures.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
• 2+ years of supervisory experience, preferably in a legal, banking, financial services, or other large corporate environment.
• 3+ years of experience in presentation design or creative production, including pitch books, marketing materials, creative deliverables, or related banking services.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite, with the ability to create, format, and edit presentations, graphics, charts, and graphs.
• Demonstrated ability to provide hands-on production support while managing people, workflow, quality, and client priorities.
• Experience coordinating work across multiple locations, shifts, or offshore delivery teams preferred.
• Strong grammar, editing, composition, and proofreading skills.
• Experience with workflow management systems and manager self-service or centralized HR systems preferred.
• Basic financial understanding of how day-to-day staffing and operating decisions affect P&L.
• Ability to balance competing requests in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and make independent decisions aligned with business needs and policy.
• Excellent client service, stakeholder management, and written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively with multifunctional and globally distributed teams and diverse backgrounds.
• Detail-oriented, organized, self-motivated, and able to handle sensitive and confidential information.

jobs.title: Quality Systems Supervisor
jobs.description:
PURPOSE STATEMENT

Supervise the Document Control Department in Costa Rica to ensure an efficient, consistent operation aligned with AbbVie’s corporate standards, while ensuring the timely fulfillment of Quality System requirements and applicable regulatory requirements. Lead the creation, approval, maintenance, and custody of controlled documentation for medical products, as well as the administration of the change control system and document repositories. Drive continuous improvement of documentation and training processes, systems, and metrics, strengthening operational effectiveness and compliance across AbbVie’s different sites.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Supervise and coordinate the activities of the Document Control Department, ensuring the timely and consistent execution of the processes under its responsibility.
• Assign, prioritize, and follow up on the team’s work to ensure compliance with Quality System requirements and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Ensure the custody, control, filing, retrieval, reproduction, distribution, and traceability of controlled documentation, including related documents, records, and logs.
• Coordinate and follow up on the administration of the Change Control Board, ensuring compliance with established guidelines, traceability of changes, and timely closure of outstanding items.
• Supervise the complete document control process, including DCC, ECO, and MCO, ensuring document consistency and integrity, as well as compliance with internal procedures.
• Follow up on the preparation, organization, and documentation required for internal and external audits, as well as the timely closure of findings, CAPAs, and investigations assigned to the department.
• Monitor departmental metrics, indicators, and results, identifying trends, improvement opportunities, and operational support needs.
• Coordinate the implementation and effective use of manual and electronic documentation and training systems, ensuring adoption, consistency, and operational stability.
• Support coordination with other functional areas to address requests related to critical documentation, changes, training, and support for improvement initiatives.
• Promote continuous improvement of Document Center processes by driving standards, operational efficiency, and sustained compliance.
• Participate in process improvement or new product introduction projects with the objective of identifying and coordinating the activities required of the Document Center.
• Define and control the budget for the areas under the position’s responsibility.
• Perform other duties inherent to the position and any additional responsibilities assigned by the immediate supervisor.
• Foster the motivation of direct reports by ensuring that behaviors promoted by AbbVie’s culture are reinforced and recognized in a timely manner, both formally and informally.

EDUCATION

• University bachelor’s degree in a STEAM-related field, preferably Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, English, or English Teaching. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred.
• Advanced English proficiency in reading comprehension, writing, and conversation. C1 level or higher preferred.

EXPERIENCE

• 3+ years of experience in quality systems, compliance, traceability, risk management, and change control within a regulated industry, preferably under ISO 13485.
• Experience working with cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution, standardization, and compliance.
• Experience in project management, audits, inspections, or process improvement.
• Experience with electronic documentation systems, such as SAP, OneVault, Salesforce, Arena, Windchill, or similar platforms.

SKILLS

• Ability to supervise, coordinate, and follow up on team activities and priorities.
• Strong interpersonal, analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.
• Ability to organize, prioritize, and follow up on multiple processes and stakeholders.
• Knowledge of change control, filing, and critical documentation processes associated with medical devices.
• Continuous improvement and problem-solving mindset.
• Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.

jobs.title: Industrial Maintenance Technician - Food Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Domino's Supply Chain Center is seeking an Industrial Maintenance Technician to join the team. This position requires the technical skills to safely design, evaluate, troubleshoot, repair, and install production equipment. Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, Hydraulics, Pneumatics, Hydraulics, and Computer Controls are skills that are required. The Maintenance Technician will be responsible for the maintenance of a distribution and manufacturing facility, including preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and installation of machinery relating to food processing equipment, physical structures, and mechanical and electrical systems. In addition, the Maintenance Technician must possess an awareness and understanding of how to work safely on mechanical and electrical equipment in a production environment.

Compensation: $31.00-$39.00/hour; based on candidate's experience

Schedule: Sunday to Thursday 3:00 AM -11:30 AM*

*Will train on the 1st shift (Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM) for 3 to 4 weeks. Following this training period, you will transition to the regular schedule (Sunday–Thursday, 3:00 AM – 11:30 AM).

Responsibilities and Duties

Inspect, test, troubleshoot, repair, and install machinery and equipment

• Monitor equipment to detect malfunctions
• Discuss machine operation variations with a supervisor or other team members to diagnose problems and repair machines
• Install, repair, or replace electrical devices such as transformers, relays, circuit breakers, starters, and safety and limit switches
• Layout, assemble, install, and maintain pipe systems and related hydraulic and pneumatic equipment
• Install, program, and troubleshoot automated machinery and Programmable Logic Controllers
• Install, troubleshoot, and repair refrigeration and Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning (HVAC) equipment
• Service and repair material handling equipment
• Monitor the main electrical panel and troubleshoot as necessary
• Repair and maintain boilers, water heaters, water conditioning equipment, and all water distribution systems

Follow established preventative maintenance guidelines

• Perform all necessary maintenance and update logs as necessary
• Report major problems to the supervisor

Maintain building through painting, repairing minor structural problems, and other repairs as necessary

• Repair and maintain the physical structure of the establishment
• General maintenance repairs of office and building

Ensure proper adherence to all safety and government guidelines

• Identify safety issues with machines; document issues; develop an action plan to resolve concerns; follow up to ensure problems are resolved
• Monitor machines to ensure all levels are within EPA, OSHA, and other government guidelines; develop an action plan to resolve issues if not; follow up to ensure problems are resolved

Miscellaneous duties

• Assist in the control and scheduling of projects
• Monitor inventory and order parts as necessary
• Monitor energy usage and provide recommendations for better usage

Certificates, Licenses, Regulations (Preferred)

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be proactive and self-motivated, have the ability to evaluate and repair all types of mechanical and electrical equipment, and is able to perform under extreme stress when there is equipment failure. Core Competencies should include:

• Refrigeration
• Electrical Systems
• Controls
• Mechanical Systems
• Basic Maintenance skills
• HS Diploma and/or Technical School Training two years, and/or 3 to 4 years related experience, and/or licensed journeyman of a skilled trade.
• Basic level computer skills for word processing and spreadsheets
• Able to read and interpret blueprints, mechanical and electrical schematic diagrams
• Able to effectively present information to peers, upper management, and team members in oral and written form
• Define problems and draw conclusions
• Interpret technical instructions and diagrams

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential function.

While performing the duties of this job, the team member is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, outside weather conditions, extreme cold, extreme heat, and risk of electrical shock, explosion, and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate but can be high. The team member must have a strong safety awareness to ensure a safe and healthy workplace.

Domino's offers:

• Competitive wages - $31/hr-39/hr based on experience level
• Paid Holidays and Vacation
• Positive work environment
• Comprehensive benefits available, effective first date of employment, including: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with employer match contribution up to 5%, Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Sick Time (PST), Short Term Disability, Employee Stock Payroll Deduction Plan, and Parental Leave.
• 401k matching contributions after 60 days
• 15% off the purchase price of stock
• Company bonus
• Referral bonuses
• Career growth!

jobs.title: Security Guard - ADESA Shreveport
jobs.description:
Available Schedule (*subject to change based on business needs, open availability highly preferred*): Tuesday - Saturday 3:00 PM-11:00 PM

Starting Pay: $12/hour

About Us

ADESA, a Carvana-owned company, currently operates in over 50 locations throughout the US. Our auto auctions, some up to 200 acres, provide a wide array of vehicle services including repair, reconditioning, and auction remarketing, and many of our sites serve as market hub distribution centers. Our inventory comprises hundreds of thousands of vehicles across North America from retail to commercial, OEM & more.

We work in a service industry and embrace a “we” versus “I” culture – help others, and they will help you. Our industry is fun, fast-paced, and competitive – and filled with the best people who are passionate about what they do.

We’re excited about the future! As an industry leader, ADESA is poised for a multi-year expansion including huge investments in facilities, massive sales growth, and an ever-increasing inventory of vehicles! We are looking for great people who want to take this journey with us! Get a sneak peek into life at ADESA!

Role and Team

Reporting to the Inspections or Operations Manager executing processes at our facility to ensure our team members, customers, and assets are protected.   At our gates, you will be the face of ADESA to our customers, vendors and associates.  You will play an active role in ensuring our Inventory Control procedures are followed.  You will be adept at utilizing ADESA technology.  You will support vehicle location research when necessary.  This position is hourly and reports to the Operations or designated manager. This position may work various shifts and weekends.

Responsibilities

• Secure all gates and buildings and patrol the premises. Sound alarms and notify authorities in case of emergency.

• Verify only authorized individuals enter the property. Provide facility directions to customers, vendors and transporters.

• Check gate passes to ensure vehicles are authorized to exit property.

• Check departing vehicles to guard against theft of company property.

• Greet customers at the gate and provide prompt and courteous service. Resolve customer complaints in a friendly manner.

• When difficult situations arise, de-escalate situations to ensure we win with partners and collaborate on the forefront.

• Watch and report irregularities such as fire hazards, leaking water pipes and doors left unsecured.

• Account for and identify all keys, codes or other safety and security information

• Maintain a current list of emergency and management telephone numbers

• Maintain good operating condition of all equipment and facilities, including handheld devices and printers. Notify management of all breakdowns and maintenance needs.

• Maintain a professional appearance and orderly work environment

• Practice and promote teamwork continuously. Set a good personal example of attitude and performance

• Maintain a good flow of communication with all auction team members and leaders

• Any other duties assigned by the designated manager

Skills and Attributes

• 1 - 2 years of experience within a customer service environment

• Strong attention to detail and communication skills

• Ability to relate well with others and establish strong working relationships

• Ability to handle conflict situations in a positive way

• Ability to accurately enter data on a handheld device or computer

• Strong customer service skills

• Ability to organize, plan, and execute multiple tasks in a fast-paced work environment

Qualifications

• High School diploma or GED preferred

• Ability to work in all weather conditions

• Requires computer data entry skills

• Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver’s license that meets the requirements

• Able to safely drive a variety of make/model/sizes of vehicles

• Requires standing for extended periods

ADESA Values

• Our Next Customer May Be Your Mom: Every customer deserves the same level of care and respect one would give to their own mother.

• We’re All in This Together: The company is unified by the shared goal of providing fantastic customer experiences, achieved through mutual trust, respect, and understanding.

• There Are No Sidelines: Employees are encouraged to be proactive, work hard, and take ownership of what needs to be done in a fast-paced environment.

• Be Brave: Employees should not fear taking risks, pushing themselves outside their comfort zones, or being decisive, even if they stumble along the way.

• Zag Forward: The company empowers creative and passionate thinking to find meaningful ways to be different and deliver amazing experiences.

• Don’t Be a Richard: A simple guiding principle to act appropriately and professionally.

• Stay Scrappy: This value rejects mediocrity and "good enough," pushing employees to do more with less to pass savings on to customers.

ADESA Benefits and Perks

Competitive Pay | Quality Benefits | Holiday and Paid Time Off | Education and Equipment Reimbursement Programs | Matching 401(k) | Career Path Opportunities | And More!

Other Requirements

To be able to do your job at ADESA, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you. Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

• The physical activity requirements of the position range from Light to Medium Physical Work.

• Constant - standing, watching, touching, listening, walking, talking

• Frequent - bending, stooping, kneeling, lifting, grasping, pushing, pulling

• Potential – running, jumping, yelling or other rapid or forceful movement in emergency situations

• Visual acuity requirements include color, depth perception and field of vision comparable to definitions for Clerical, Administrative, Machine Operators (including inspection) positions.

Physical Working Conditions

This position is subject to both inside and outside environmental working conditions, including temperature changes, outside weather conditions, slightly elevated ambient noise levels, and minor atmospheric conditions affecting skin or respiratory systems, such as fumes, odors and dusts associated with internal and external service station/convenience food and petroleum dispensing operations.

To be able to do your job at ADESA, you must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English. Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal Stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

ADESA is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  ADESA also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. About the Role

As a Director of Strategy, Paid Social, you’ll lead full-funnel paid social media campaigns that drive customer acquisition, brand awareness, and high-value product launches across enterprise accounts (such as telecom and tech lines of business), acting as a senior domain expert driving large-scale programs and managing high-performing teams. We are looking for someone who is passionate about seeking new opportunities to create impactful work.

Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Design and execute full-funnel paid social roadmaps across Meta, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, X, and emerging channels to achieve client revenue and audience targets.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with creative, analytics, and product development teams to optimize creative variations, target audience preferences, and landing page performance.

• Client & Business Growth: Lead executive-level presentations, foster high-value client relationships, and drive organic and new business scoping efforts.

• Team Management & Development: Lead, coach, and scale internal strategists, digital marketers, and media buyers—setting best practices for campaign trafficking and execution.

• Reporting & Optimization: Deliver clear performance reporting on traffic, user engagement, and attribution metrics, transforming raw data into actionable strategy recommendations.

• Emerging Tech & Compliance: Leverage AI and automation to scale campaign efficiency while ensuring strict adherence to data privacy regulations and brand safety guidelines.

About You

The essentials:

• Experience: 8+ years of digital marketing and paid social strategy experience working with enterprise brands (telecom, tech, or high-consideration lines of business preferred).

• Platform Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of major social platforms and ad managers (Meta Ads Manager, YouTube/Google Ads, etc.) and analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics).

• Leadership Track Record: Proven experience leading multi-disciplinary teams and successfully driving large-scale strategic initiatives.

• Analytical Mindset: Exceptional ability to dissect complex datasets to identify audience insights, optimize user engagement, and prove marketing ROI.

• Communication Skills: Outstanding presentation, client-facing, and executive stakeholder management abilities.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

jobs.title: Technical Sales and Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

Seeking a driven and motivated engineer to join our sales team focusing on growing business with existing customers and developing new business. This position will involve applications engineering, sales support and field service work. Sales Engineers should be comfortable working in a result-driven, fast-paced environment.

Position will involve extensive formalized training plus work under a mentor, developing skills and gaining an understanding of CaptiveAire products, how we go to market, application engineering processes etc. as well as business development and sales strategies.

Why Work for CaptiveAire?

• Nation’s leading manufacturer of commercial kitchen ventilation systems, and now offering a complete solution of fans, heaters, ductwork and HVAC equipment. Our primary purpose is to provide fully integrated, sustainable HVAC Systems.

• Leader in the industry for over 40 years with innovative technologies, unmatched service, competitive pricing, and rapid lead times.

• Mission: to provide the highest quality products and service to our users at the lowest possible price

• Strong commitment to the development of our employees, including continuous education opportunities like sponsorship for Professional Engineering license and continuous education through weekly webinars and company developed technical videos

What our employees have to say:

There is never a day you don’t learn something new at CaptiveAire. I am able to learn something new due to the freedom to take on new tasks independently and problem solve.

I love the mindset of continuous learning and pushing the bounds of your capabilities and knowledge. I love the people I work with and the environment, particularly in a world where remote work is common. I love how Captiveaire is all about connections, with customers, coworkers, end users, and everyone in between.

One of the things I appreciate most about CaptiveAire is how strongly it embodies the entrepreneurial spirit. I’m empowered with the autonomy to manage my work independently, while also benefiting from the robust support and resources of a large, well-established company.

CaptiveAire is fast-moving and no-nonsense. We operate differently than any other company that I've worked for with our decentralized structure. Quick action is taken when a good idea is presented. We are focused on end users where the rest of the industry is very short-sighted. We are on the front lines, actively changing the landscape of the HVAC industry.

Learn more about CaptiveAire and our products here

A Day in the Life:

A technical sales role encompasses a wide variety of tasks where one day does not look exactly like the next. The projects our team handles are high in volume and unique from one another, spanning throughout the whole course of design, procurement, coordination, and post-sale support.

Typical tasks include:

• Outside sales meetings and calls to build relationships with existing and new customers

• Application engineering to apply our products using sound engineering principles

• Project management of installations in progress - Managing schedules/plans to guarantee we can get equipment on site when the site needs it, in turn creating satisfied and returning customers.

• Service and technical support of existing equipment

• Supporting end users to maintain high levels of customer service, from assisting contractors with wiring on site to remote troubleshooting for staff in the kitchen.

Two to three full days per week in the office working on bids, one to two days on job sites, and dedicate another day to developing the territory. Territory development may include giving presentations to the engineering community, dropping off donuts to a new customer, or meeting a new contact with an existing customer.

Comments from some of our sales engineers:

Every day I get to help someone. Whether it's an engineer with a design, a contractor with a troubleshooting issue, or an end user looking for help to obtain better indoor air quality. I get to use my engineering skills, people skills and business skills every day.

Our main "role" is not to sell products but to provide solutions - kitchen ventilation solutions, commercial ventilation solutions, heating/air conditioning solutions. I enjoy getting to work directly with end users and helping them complete their business goals. Attending a soft opening after completing a full design-build project with an owner is rewarding.

I love the balance between working on designs in the office and also having that face to face interaction with our customers. It's awesome to handle the design phase of a project, then also take charge of the procurement process with the end user/customer and lastly watch our equipment perform as designed once installed and the project is complete. I also love the growth aspect of my role, I enjoy molding and shaping our business in order to set it up for success and then see the value we are adding to the market.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

• Provide integrated application engineering and design support for a wide range of ventilation applications with the goal of providing sustainable products and the latest technologies best designed to meet the customers’ needs.

• Work directly with Engineers, Contractors, End Users, and Food Service Dealers.

• Daily tasks include inside sales support, application engineering and outside sales.

• Responsibilities will vary and may include presentations, quotes, submittals, technical product support, job site visits and hands on troubleshooting as needed.

• Educate and promote CaptiveAire products to users in your market. This includes conference calls, meetings, organizing presentations, and product demos.

• Research and develop new business opportunities with new and existing users.

• Top notch customer service and willingness to go above and beyond to serve the customer.

• Quick turnaround times a priority.

• Continuously evaluate and improve processes as well as the customer experience.

Required skills:

• 0-5 years experience

• 4 year technical degree in a mechanical, electrical, construction or science-oriented curriculum preferred

• Excellent computer, organizational and communication/presentation skills

• Problem solving with a passion for continuous learning

• Strong desire to interface with the customer

• Embrace new technologies and business savvy

• Passion for work with aggressive nature to succeed

• Willing to travel for various training opportunities

• If not already completed, expectation of FE Exam completion in area of study for engineering graduates within 6 months of employment with CaptiveAire

• MUST BE A “GO GETTER”!

Benefits:

• Medical, dental and vision insurance

• Disability & life insurance based upon election of medical insurance

• 401k with employer match

• Paid holidays

• Paid time off (PTO) based upon tenure

• Flexible spending account (FSA)

• Tuition reimbursement, including for Professional Engineering (PE) License

• Relocation assistance

Salary:

$70k-$100k base, negotiable dependent on experience, with additional monthly bonus based on productivity and profits.

jobs.title: Senior Influencer & Creator Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
We are ARB Interactive, the team behind Modo Casino, one of the top Social+ platforms in the US. Founded in 2022, we've grown to nearly 200 team members and were named one of LinkedIn's 2025 Top 50 Startups in the United States. We move fast, think big, and love bold ideas that push boundaries (and buttons). From new rewards to fresh game mechanics, every challenge is a chance to innovate and have fun doing it. Our culture is collaborative, curious, and full of laughter because great ideas grow best between coffee, code, and a few epic high-fives.


ABOUT US

We are ARB Interactive, the team behind Modo Casino, one of the top Social+ platforms in the US. Founded in 2022, we've grown to nearly 200 team members and were named one of LinkedIn's 2025 Top 50 Startups in the United States. We move fast, think big, and love bold ideas that push boundaries (and buttons). From new rewards to fresh game mechanics, every challenge is a chance to innovate and have fun doing it. Our culture is collaborative, curious, and full of laughter because great ideas grow best between coffee, code, and a few epic high-fives.




POSITION OVERVIEW

Today we have a brand people want to talk about, a category full of creators looking for a partner who actually gets them, and no formal creator program. You will create one, and you will do it yourself. You'll report to the Director of Growth Strategy, with the room to define how this function runs.

You own it end to end: sourcing, outreach, negotiation, briefing, deal structure, content, and the program architecture that makes all of it repeatable. Not a roster of one-off posts. A network you can activate on short notice, where the creators we find early and help grow become our loudest advocates and pull the next wave of talent toward us.

You'll partner closely with the Director of Growth Strategy and cross-functionally with Marketing, Brand and Product as the creator channel scales.

This is a founding role: expect to set the systems, tools and cadence yourself in year one, with the scope to grow into leading the function as the program proves out.




THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

Creator is the next big unlock. We're hiring the person who will build it. This is a hands-on, zero to one build.

We're looking for someone with natural grit. Someone who will send 200 DMs on a Tuesday, get 12 replies, close 3, and treat that as a great day. Someone who would rather build the machine than inherit one.

If you do your best work with a system already built for you, this role will feel like a stretch. If you want to point at something in 18 months and say you built every piece of it, keep reading.




THE ROLE

Build the program

 - Design and launch our creator program: tiers, incentives, content expectations, deal and code structures, onboarding, and a real path from emerging talent to flagship partner.

 - Build the scouting engine that finds creators before anyone else does. Set the criteria, watch the signals, and get there early while partnerships are still affordable and relationships still matter.

 - Create the development side of the program: coaching, content feedback, early access, co-created formats, and support that makes creators better at their craft. We want creators to grow with us, not just post for us.

Build a network, not a roster

 - Grow an owned community of creators, streamers, editors and clippers who work with us on an ongoing basis rather than campaign to campaign.

 - Run always-on programs and recurring briefs that keep the community producing, competing and improving between formal activations.

 - Make participation worth it. Design the incentives, recognition and progression that turn one-time contributors into regulars, and regulars into partners.

Run the outreach engine

 - Own high-volume, high-quality prospecting across TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Twitch, Kick, X, and wherever the audience moves next.

 - Negotiate and close across the full spectrum: performance-based, flat fee, hybrid, affiliate, ambassador and always-on retainers. Land rights and usage terms that work for both sides.

 - Build the CRM and tracking discipline that turns outreach into a forecastable channel, and that tells us which creators actually perform rather than which ones simply posted.

Make it perform

 - Treat this as a growth channel with real economics behind it, not a brand line item. You will shape how creators are rewarded against performance, and you will be accountable for what the channel returns.

 - Define the KPIs and report on them without being asked: creators activated, cost per activation, cost per new registration, content volume and quality, code redemption, and the retention and value of the players creators bring in.

 - Kill what doesn't work fast. Double down on what does, faster.




QUALIFICATIONS

Required

 - 5+ years in influencer, creator, talent or community marketing, including at least one program you built or scaled meaningfully yourself.

 - A real network. You can open a laptop and start sending messages to people who will actually reply.

 - Natural grit. You are motivated by the opportunity to build the machine rather than inherit it.

 - Proven closing ability. You've negotiated deals from a few hundred dollars to six figures and know when each makes sense.

 - Fluency in creator economics: rate benchmarks, CPM and CPA math, affiliate and rev share structures, whitelisting, usage rights, and how to build a deal that works for both sides.

 - Experience running something always-on. A community, a contributor program, an ambassador network, anything where the job was keeping a lot of people engaged and producing over time, not just booking deals one at a time.

 - Strong content instincts. You can tell in five seconds whether a creator's audience is real and whether their style will convert.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action. You build the spreadsheet, write the contract template and set up the tracking yourself.

 - Sharp written communication. Most of your closing happens in DMs and email.

Preferred

 - Background in talent management, or you've been a creator yourself.

 - Live streaming know-how, especially Twitch and Kick.

 - Experience with clipping or edit-driven content programs.

 - Familiarity with influencer platforms, affiliate tooling and attribution setups.

 - You've worked in a regulated or age-gated category and know how to operate cleanly inside one.


HOW WE'LL KNOW IT'S WORKING

 - A program that runs on a documented process and doesn't depend on you being online.

 - A pipeline of emerging talent we reached first.

 - Creator-sourced players who stick around and play, not just click.

 - Creators who talk about working with us the way we'd want them to, publicly and unprompted.
