jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
AIR’s Tek Office is seeking a Technical Project Manager to support project delivery and day-to-day operations. This role focuses on core project management responsibilities to drive efficient execution, ensure alignment across stakeholders, and advance projects with a heavy technology component. The Technical Project Manager will work on client-facing projects in the areas of Health, Education, or Workforce primarily and support initiatives to implement and enforce standardization and strong agile project management. This position reports to the Principal Technical Project Manager.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, with strong organization skills and has a good understanding of technology-focused teams. This role is well-suited for someone eager to grow in project or program management, with a proactive mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity while contributing to team success.

This position offers hybrid work flexibility, requiring three days per week in AIR’s Virginia office, with occasional travel for meetings, training sessions, and conferences.

About AIR:

Established in 1946, with headquarters in Arlington, Virginia, AIR is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit institution that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to solve some of the most urgent challenges in the U.S. and around the world. We advance evidence in the areas of education, health, the workforce, human services, and international development to create a better, more equitable world. AIR's commitment to diversity goes beyond legal compliance to its full integration in our strategy, operations, and work environment.

Responsibilities:

The key responsibilities for the position include, but are not limited to, the following-

• Lead technical project planning and execution in a fast-paced, agile environment.

• Manage and expedite technical deliverables while coordinating amongst competing priorities. Track key timelines, action items, and priorities, providing proactive follow-ups, reminders, and escalation support as needed.

• Maintain accurate project documentation, trackers, dashboards, and status updates to ensure visibility and informed decision-making.

• Use tools, such as Jira and Confluence to coordinate technical projects and tasks, participate and lead sprint plans and retrospectives, and support the teams in using best practices.

• Frame agendas, prepare briefing materials, and track actionable follow-ups. Partner with cross-functional teams to foster collaboration, alignment, and smooth execution across projects and initiatives.

• Provide operational support across budgeting, expense coordination, procurement, and vendor interactions while ensuring compliance with internal processes and confidentiality standards.

• Duties and responsibilities may change based on evolving business needs.

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Minimum of 5 years of relevant project management, technology, or operations experience.

• Experience using project management and work management tools such as Microsoft Project, Planner, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar platforms.

• CAPM certification, or progress toward certification, preferred.

Skills:

• Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with executive presence and the ability to effectively engage diverse audiences, influence outcomes, and collaborate across cross-functional and virtual teams.

• Solid project management skills, including the ability to coordinate tasks, track deliverables, maintain project documentation, and support successful project execution.

• Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information, exercise sound judgment, and support leadership decision-making.

• Team-oriented and collaborative mindset, demonstrated initiative, and strong accountability, balancing independent ownership of work with effective partnership across teams to achieve shared goals and deliver high-quality results.

• Strong prioritization, organizational, and adaptability skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, manage multiple competing priorities and concurrent workstreams, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.

• High level of integrity and discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word and Excel, with the ability to quickly learn and leverage new technologies, systems, and AI tools to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support project outcomes.

jobs.title: Strategist, Agent Development (Brazilian Portuguese speaking)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

As an Agent Strategist https://sierra.ai/blog/agent-strategist-your-phd-in-applied-ai, you own how Sierra’s AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer’s thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business.

 - Own the Agent Development Life Cycle https://sierra.ai/blog/agent-development-life-cycle. Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, and evaluation, to launch and continuous iteration in production — translating business goals into an agent that outperforms, and tuning relentlessly until it’s the best version of itself in the real world. You’ll have real ownership and autonomy over the outcome.

 - Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers’ executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there.

 - Partner with the customer’s working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch.

 - Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next.


EXAMPLE PROJECTS

These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently:

 - Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers.

 - Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation.

 - Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog https://sierra.ai/blog/five-ways-to-use-ai-agents-financial-services for examples.

 - Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner.

 - Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome https://sierra.ai/blog/outcome-based-pricing-for-ai-agents week over week.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships.

 - Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast.

 - Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion.

 - Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes.

 - Genuine interest in Financial Services and improving the end customer experience. Experience in financial technology, implementations at financial institutions, working inside of these institutions or familiarity with financial services security and compliance requirements (fair lending, PII handling, etc.) are a strong plus.


EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts.

 - You’ve been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

 - A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
About Re:Build

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles)

About Re:Build DAPR Engineering

Re:Build DAPR Engineering, LLC (DAPR) is an engineering design and analysis consulting firm in Merrimack, New Hampshire. We work with customers across many industries to develop and deliver turnkey industrial machines to meet their unique requirements. We design and build custom automation solutions, work with OEM’s to develop industrial products, and provide engineering analysis using FEA tools.

Who We Are Looking For

We're looking for a quality-minded engineer who takes genuine pride in building things right the first time. You're someone who sees quality not as a final checkpoint, but as something that gets designed and built into a product from the very beginning — through solid data, sound processes, and close collaboration with the teams designing and building the product.

You bring a strong foundation in manufacturing or mechanical engineering, backed by real-world experience solving production problems, and you're comfortable moving between hands-on inspection work and higher-level statistical analysis. You know how to dig into data to find the root cause of an issue, document it clearly, and drive a fix that sticks — and you're just as comfortable auditing a supplier's process as you are sitting in on a design review contributing to an FMEA.

This role is a great fit for someone who wants to have a direct, visible impact on product quality at Re:Build DAPR Engineering — from early design input through incoming materials, in-process controls, and finished goods. If you enjoy variety in your work, take ownership of problems until they're truly resolved, and want your analytical skills to translate into tangible improvements on the shop floor, this role offers that opportunity.

What You Get To Do

• Contribute to product design teams by driving FMEAs, identifying critical-to-quality (CTQ) characteristics, and establishing verification methods early in the development process

• Analyze process data statistically to confirm processes are in control, and lead troubleshooting efforts when they're not

• Investigate quality issues and document corrective actions using 8D or a similar structured methodology

• Drive Material Review Board (MRB) actions to resolve nonconforming material

• Inspect incoming parts and materials as needed to catch issues before they enter production

• Track KPIs such as scrap rate, rework, and yield, and lead continuous improvement efforts to move those metrics in the right direction

• Maintain the calibration schedule for inspection equipment to ensure measurement accuracy

• Conduct supplier audits and provide recommendations on preferred vendors

• Support company-wide ISO 9001 internal and external audits as needed

What You Bring To The Team

Required:

• Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, mechanical, or another engineering discipline

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in a manufacturing environment

• Familiarity with ISO standards, root cause analysis, and statistical process control

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and guide decisions that improve performance

• Ability to read and interpret 2D drawings

• Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint, with strong Excel skills

• Ability to communicate clearly and confidently in written and verbal English, including moderately complex documents and group discussions

• Willingness to travel domestically on an occasional basis, depending on business needs

Preferred:

• Six Sigma or other quality-related certification

• Experience with ERP software (e.g., Syteline)

• Exposure to CAD/CAE tools, preferably SolidWorks

The base salary range for this position is $99,000 – $125,000 per year. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting.  Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits.

The BIG payoff

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.  Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

jobs.title: Clinical Pharmacist- Oncology Full time Days
jobs.description:
The Clinical Pharmacist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Clinical Pharmacist is responsible for identifying, preventing, and/or resolving medication related problems; for providing authoritative information to other health care professionals, patients, and the public; and for assuring that the informational, clinical, and drug distribution components of pharmacy services function as an integrated system to provide patient centered care to the patients and staff of Northwestern Medicine.

The mission of the Department of Pharmacy is to deliver the safest, highest quality, most effective and efficient patient care while developing the best people, advancing research, and integrating pharmacy services to successfully coordinate care across the Northwestern Medicine enterprise.

The vision of the Department of Pharmacy is to be a recognized as a national leader in advancing the pharmacy enterprise through excellence, innovation, education and research.

Responsibilities:

• Interprets medication orders to ensure safety and proper use of medications and is alert to compatibilities, incompatibilities, medication duplication, medication allergies, and potential medication administration errors. Coordinates the solving of medication related problems between pharmacy, nursing, and prescribers, demonstrating initiative and sound judgment.
• Monitors medication therapy for significant drug-drug, drug-diet, or drug-laboratory test interactions. Intervenes in circumstances of significant interactions, therapeutic duplications, and other occasions where pharmacodynamics and pharmacokinetic expertise is warranted.
• Evaluates and documents that the medication(s) selected are appropriate for achieving the desired therapeutic outcome. Communicates potential problems and likely solutions to the prescriber.
• Acts as a consultant in the areas of pharmacokinetics and adverse reactions to physicians, nurses and other healthcare professionals. Participates in all therapeutic drug monitoring or intervention programs; adjusting therapy as indicated by patient condition and laboratory results.
• Processes all medication order information into the Electronic Health Record to ensure accuracy of records regarding past, current and future dispensing and charging.
• Maintains a comprehensive pharmacy patient profile. The profile should include age, maturation, weight, allergies, diagnosis, estimated and actual pharmacokinetic parameters, and pertinent information which may affect medication therapy decisions.
• Oversees the packaging labeling, and distribution of medications for all patients and employees according to established policies, procedures, and guidelines. Monitors the use of scheduled medications on the nursing units and maintains controlled inventories of medication in the dispensing areas.
• Compounds and dispenses pharmaceuticals including sterile products, chemotherapy and parenteral nutrition products.
• Verifies medication orders before delivery to patient care areas and ensures accuracy and completeness. Resolves discrepancies as necessary.
• Reviews all laboratory data for appropriateness of medication use and recommends changes when needed. Including microbial culture and sensitivity data, toxicology, therapeutic drug monitoring, etc.
• Develops and presents orientation, education and training programs for medical, nursing, hospital and pharmacy staff, as well as assisting in the educating of pharmacy students, residents, and fellows.
• Educates patients and their families about specific medications.
• Responds to emergency situations to assist with medication management (e.g. response to cardiac arrests)
• Provides accurate and timely medication information and or teaching to healthcare professionals or patients.
• Maintains the hospital formulary and acts to limit medication usage to formulary items when appropriate
• Documents all clinical activities and interventions performed. Collects data, maintains logs, records and other documentation as required by the department
• Communicates professional knowledge effectively in both oral and written forms to patients and other health professionals.
• Participates in quality improvement and medication use review activities of the department.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
TheGuarantors is a fintech company helping multifamily owners and operators mitigate leasing risk while expanding access for renters. With a deep understanding of owner, operator, and renter needs, we believe renters deserve better access to the home of their choice and operators deserve greater protection and growth opportunities. That’s why we’re leveraging our real estate expertise and using AI-driven renter underwriting to help operators qualify renters faster while mitigating the financial risk of renter default. With $7B+ in lease value protected, we work with 9 of the country’s top 10 operators, are the #1 lease guarantee provider nationwide, and have consistently been named one of Inc. 5000’s fastest-growing companies, Forbes’ Best Startup Employers, Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Data Science Team at TheGuarantors. This is a highly cross-functional role designed for someone who enjoys turning data into clear, actionable answers for the business. You will dig deep into data to uncover insights, build analytical and reporting frameworks, and run ad-hoc analyses to answer emerging business questions. You’ll work closely with teams across Data, Risk, Operations, and GTM, translating data into insights that inform strategic decisions across the company.

Location
This is hybrid role based in NYC (3 days/week onsite).

What you’ll do:

• Translate ambiguous business questions into clear, structured analyses
• Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business decisions
• Run ad-hoc analyses and experiments to evaluate hypotheses to address emerging business challenges and opportunities
• Write and optimize SQL queries against Snowflake, and use Python/dbt to clean, transform, and model data for analysis
• Partner with Data Scientists to analyze and monitor existing models and conduct deeper analyses in response to business questions
• Support recurring model monitoring and established Data Science processes developed by senior team members, including investigating trends, anomalies, and changes in model outcomes.
• Communicate findings clearly through data storytelling, visualizations, and presentations to technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Synthesize analyses into clear reports and presentations for cross-functional and strategic discussions

What you bring:

• 2+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or related quantitative role
• Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative role
• Proficiency in SQL and Python for data analysis, with a foundational understanding of statistical and machine learning concepts
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the intellectual curiosity to explore data and investigate open-ended questions
• Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset

Benefits

• Flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, commuter)

Base Salary

The base salary range is between $120,000 - $140,000 annually.

Base salary does not include other forms of compensation or benefits. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location and current market data and may vary from the range above.

jobs.title: Sales Advisor
jobs.description:
About Co-Active Training Institute:

As the trailblazers of coaching, CTI has emerged over the last 30 years to become the place where the best coaches and leaders are trained. At its core, CTI is a concept and modality on how to be in relationship with self, other, and a system. In the last ten years we moved from being founder-led to employee-owned and believe that our collective responsibility to our mission is what will make us thrive. Co-Active is so much more than courses, it is a way of altering how the world communicates, leads and creates change, and we believe that this change is and will be created by the people we train as coaches and leaders. We aspire to create a movement that brings more responsibility and wholeness to the leaders who want to create change at the level of self and system and believe Co-Active is the answer.

About the Role

The Sales Advisor role is crucial to our mission of delivering a transformative Co-Active experience to all our customers. As an Advisor, you will be responsible for converting inbound leads into enthusiastic participants in our coach training and leadership programs, guiding potential and active clients through the registration process, and ensuring they feel supported and informed at every step of their journey.

Advisors play a vital part in creating a true Co-Active experience, allowing customers to fully understand and connect with our values and offerings. You will act as a trusted partner to our clients, providing insightful answers to their questions and following up with current customers to offer additional opportunities that enhance their engagement with our programs.

This role also sits at the front of our expansion into organizational (B2B) business. We are building offerings for companies, HR, and L&D leaders, and we are looking for Advisors who can grow with us: people who excel at converting inbound demand today and who have the appetite and skill to develop outbound, consultative B2B business as those offerings come to market. Innovation and creativity in strategy are encouraged, and by collaborating cross-functionally you will help shape how Co-Active sells to both individuals and organizations.

Key Responsibilities

Inbound conversion (primary focus)

• Convert inbound leads into customers by effectively communicating the value of our coach training and leadership programs.

• Guide prospective participants through the registration process, ensuring a seamless experience.

• Respond promptly and professionally to questions from potential candidates and participants, providing accurate information and addressing their concerns.

• Embody the ethos of Co-Active customer support and channel it in every interaction.

• Follow up with current customers to identify and offer additional opportunities that meet their needs and enhance their experience with our programs.

• Maintain detailed, accurate records of interactions with leads and customers in our CRM to ensure efficient follow-up and reliable reporting.

• Achieve individual and team conversion targets and contribute to overall sales and revenue goals.

B2B and organizational business (growing focus)

• Identify and qualify organizational opportunities that surface through inbound conversations (for example, participants exploring coach training for their teams or companies) and progress them toward a proposal.

• Execute targeted outreach to HR, L&D, OD, and Talent leaders through calls, email, social media touchpoints, networking, and events as our B2B offerings become available.

• Guide prospects through a needs-based discovery process to understand organizational challenges, talent development goals, and growth potential.

• Create and present proposals that align with each client's values, culture, and business objectives.

• Contribute to the development of B2B sales assets, messaging, and playbooks alongside the sales leadership team.

Team and process

• Collaborate with the sales and customer success teams to ensure a cohesive, customer-focused approach.

• Stay current on our program offerings and industry trends to provide informed recommendations.

• Represent the company at webinars and events to elevate brand awareness and connect with potential clients.

• Suggest and help implement improvements that streamline processes and elevate the customer experience.

• Occasional availability outside of normal working hours, for example to support webinars.

Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in consultative sales with a proven track record of closing, preferably in education, coaching, training, learning & development, or professional services.

• Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of inbound conversations (calls, email, follow-ups) while staying organized and responsive.

• Experience qualifying leads using BANT or an equivalent framework.

• Experience with, or a demonstrated appetite for, generating new business through outbound prospecting and relationship building.

• Experience selling to HR, L&D, OD, or Talent leaders, or a strong understanding of how organizations buy learning and development, is highly desirable.

• Proficient in CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot) and digital sales tools.

• Self-directed and accountable: able to manage time effectively, prioritize inbound demand, and hit conversion targets while building longer-cycle opportunities.

• Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas.

Strongly Preferred: Coaching Background

We have found that Advisors who have personal experience with coaching sell more effectively, because they can speak to the transformation our programs create from lived experience rather than from a script. We therefore strongly prefer candidates who have:

• Completed coach training (Co-Active or another accredited program), or hold or are pursuing an ICF credential; or

• Meaningful exposure to coaching, for example as a client, through a leadership development program, or by working closely with coaches in a prior role.

If you don't have this background but are genuinely drawn to coaching and personal growth, we still encourage you to apply and tell us why.

We're Excited About You Because

• You're a Consultative Communicator: Able to listen deeply, ask thoughtful questions, and tailor messaging to both individual and executive audiences.

• You Initiate: Driven and confident, willing to initiate communication and action to earn new business, whether from an inbound lead or a cold organizational prospect.

• You're a High Achiever: Self-motivated and committed to achieving aggressive performance targets.

• You're Versatile: You can switch between fast inbound conversion and longer, multi-stakeholder B2B cycles without losing momentum on either.

• You're Market-Savvy: You understand trends in corporate learning, coaching, and employee development.

• You're a Team Player: You collaborate across departments with humility and professionalism.

• You're a Builder: You spot inefficiencies, enjoy problem solving, and no task is too small or too big.

• You Grow: You're a lifelong learner with a growth mindset who is drawn to the Co-Active way of working.

You're Excited About Us Because

• You'll work remotely from your home

• Medical, dental, and vision plans available

• Monthly Wi-Fi stipend

• Generous PTO and annual holidays

• Employee Stock Ownership Plan

• 401k Retirement Plan

• Free Employee Registration Program for our very own CTI programs

• Parental leave

The OTE for this role is $125,000, with a base salary of $60,000.

We believe everyone has unique strengths to offer, so please apply, even if you don’t meet all the qualifications!

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Officer
jobs.description:
Purpose: To ensure that the hotel guests, heartists, and hotel property are maintained in a safe and secure environment. • Perform investigations as needed.

• Responds to police officials in the building, to include fire department.

• Execute all emergency protocols.

• Ability to read, write and speak in English. Spanish is a plus.

• Flexibility

• Telephone, pen/pencil, computer and printer, file folders, filing cabinet, radios, cameras.

• Lift jack dolly, hand truck, camera, first aid equipment.

Working Environment:

• Interior of hotel, in all areas with exposure to extreme temperatures.

• Exterior of hotel with exposure to weather conditions.

• Exposure to various hazardous chemicals.

• Must be able to lift 50 pounds

• Must be able to stand, walk for extended periods of time

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Fixed Assets Manager
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is experiencing continuous business growth, particularly in fixed asset transactions. To support this expansion while maintaining strong financial controls, operational efficiency, and compliance standards, we are strengthening our finance team.

We are looking for an experienced Fixed Assets Accountant who will take ownership of fixed asset accounting processes, support month-end close activities, and contribute to process optimization and automation initiatives. In this role, you will partner closely with finance, procurement, operational and logistic teams to ensure accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and scalable accounting processes in a fast-growing international environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Own and maintain the fixed asset register, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with internal policies, SOX requirements, and US GAAP.

• Review and process fixed asset acquisitions, disposals, transfers, depreciation, and other related transactions in a timely and accurate manner.

• Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual fixed asset close activities, including reconciliations, journal entries, and reporting.

• Coordinate and support fixed asset stock counts and related control procedures across business units.

• Partner with procurement, FP&A, and operational teams to improve purchasing and capitalization processes in line with business growth plans.

• Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, responding to audit requests, and ensuring compliance with control requirements.

• Identify opportunities for process improvements, automation, and optimization within fixed asset accounting workflows.

• Collaborate with cross-functional finance and systems teams to enhance integrations and reporting capabilities across platforms such as NetSuite and BlackLine.

• Contribute to the development and documentation of accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.

We expect you to have:

• 6+ years of accounting experience, including substantial hands-on experience in fixed assets accounting.

• Strong understanding of US GAAP, fixed asset accounting principles, and SOX/internal control frameworks.

• Experience working with ERP systems, preferably NetSuite or similar financial platforms.

• Proven ability to manage high transaction volumes and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.

• Advanced Excel skills and experience working with financial reporting and reconciliation tools.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership of processes, and drive improvements proactively.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills in an international environment.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

• Experience with process automation, finance transformation, or ERP/system integrations.

• Previous experience in a multinational, high-growth, or technology-driven company.

• Experience with BlackLine or similar reconciliation and close management tools.

• Big4 background or external audit experience.

• Experience supporting SOX compliance in a public-company environment.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Key responsibilities:

• Customer discovery and market insight: Build direct relationships with priority U.S. customers, distributors, ecosystem partners and regional teams; uncover unmet needs, decision criteria, price thresholds, platform schedules, supply expectations and software requirements.

• Product definition: Translate validated needs into market requirements documents, value propositions, product specifications and platform/derivative recommendations spanning silicon, software, tools, kits, security and ecosystem assets.

• RX and RA portfolio roadmap: Shape roadmap and lifecycle choices across RX200, RX600, RX700, RA4 and RA6 for general-purpose, low-power, motor-control, connectivity, HMI and application-specific opportunities; define where reuse, migration, derivatives, process changes or new silicon create the strongest customer and business value.

• Business case ownership: Develop volume, ASP, revenue, margin, investment and risk assumptions; align stakeholders on target customers, design-win funnel, market window and success criteria before gate approval.

• Competitive strategy: Maintain fact-based benchmarking against global and local MCU competitors, including portfolio, performance, power, security, ecosystem, quality, supply and price; convert insights into clear win themes and trade-offs.

• Cross-functional leadership: Drive alignment with Engineering, PMO, Product Marketing, Regional Marketing, Sales, FAE, Operations, Quality and Finance; resolve requirement conflicts and keep customer commitments synchronized with feasible execution.

• Early customer engagement: Secure lead customers, manage pre-NPI technical/commercial alignment, capture feedback on samples and collateral, and close requirement gaps before mass-production decisions.

• NPI and lifecycle execution: Guide launch readiness, pricing logic, fighting guides, training and product collateral; monitor adoption and business-case delivery; coordinate technical updates, product changes and discontinuation communication when required.

Near-term priorities:

• Validate U.S. customer requirements and business cases for the next generation of RX200, RX600, RX700, RA4 and RA6 products, prioritizing performance, power, memory, package, connectivity, security, cost, supply resilience and time-to-market gaps.

• Expand the U.S. customer and channel pipeline across industrial automation, building automation, HVAC, motor control, energy infrastructure, smart metering, IoT, medical, consumer and secure connected applications.

• Define a clear RX-versus-RA segmentation, migration and coexistence story across performance tiers that enables Sales and customers to select the right platform and protects the installed base while creating pathways to new products.

• Create competitive “must-win” requirements and a quantified product value proposition for each proposed roadmap item.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical engineering, electronics, computer engineering, embedded systems or a related discipline.

• Experience in MCU product definition,  system architecture, applications engineering or technical marketing.

• Strong knowledge of 32-bit MCU architectures and embedded-system trade-offs, including CPU, memory, analog/mixed-signal, low power, connectivity, security, packages, process technology, software and development tools.

• Demonstrated ability to conduct customer discovery and convert ambiguous needs into prioritized, testable product requirements.

• Experience building product business cases and influencing cross-functional decisions without direct authority.

• Understanding of U.S. customer engagement, regional market dynamics, distribution and channel models, competitive positioning, pricing pressure and long product-lifecycle requirements.

• Professional fluency in English, with strong written, presentation, executive-communication and negotiation skills.

• Ability to travel regularly to customer and internal sites across the United States and collaborate effectively across Americas, Japan and global time zones.

•Strong cross-cultural communication skills with the ability to work closely and effectively with Japanese teams, demonstrating cultural awareness, patience, and relationship-building capabilities.

Preferred qualifications:

• Hands-on familiarity with Renesas RA and/or RX MCUs, especially RX200, RX600, RX700, RA4 and RA6 devices and their development ecosystems.

• Experience with home appliances, motor/inverter control, industrial automation, building automation, HMI, metering or IoT applications.

• Knowledge of Arm Cortex-M and proprietary MCU architectures, embedded security, capacitive touch, real-time control and functional-safety considerations.

• Experience through the full product lifecycle: concept, MRD, business case, gate approval, development, NPI, customer qualification, ramp and lifecycle management.

• Established network with U.S. OEMs, distributors, engineering teams, design houses, technology partners or industry ecosystems.

Success measures:

• Quality and timeliness of customer-validated MRDs and product proposals.

• Roadmap decisions supported by clear customer evidence, competitive differentiation and executable business cases.

• Lead-customer engagement, pre-NPI commitments and healthy design-win pipeline for priority products.

• On-time gate readiness and closure of critical requirement, cost and ecosystem gaps.

• Product adoption, revenue, margin and customer satisfaction versus the approved business case.

• Clear regional-to-global communication and strong stakeholder alignment.

Additional location for consideration - San Jose, CA

The expected annual pay range for this position is $180,000- $220,000. This position is also eligible for bonus opportunities. Please note that final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

Brightcore Energy provides end-to-end energy efficiency and clean energy measures to commercial, industrial, and institutional clients. We have the intellectual and financial capital to develop, implement, fund, operate, and maintain clean energy solutions. Our diverse solutions range from lighting, controls, geothermal heating and cooling, and other energy efficiency measures to renewable energy solutions such as solar and battery storage. We are about Building Energy Performance.

Summary/Primary Role:

The Associate Counsel will play a critical role in Brightcore’s growing energy efficiency business and legal team, supporting our geothermal, energy efficiency and solar verticals. Reporting directly to the General Counsel, you will be primarily responsible for drafting, negotiating and managing Brightcore’s project and commercial agreements in close collaboration with internal business teams. The ideal candidate will have a combination of law firm and in-house transactional experience in energy or construction, be a self-motivated and pragmatic team player, and be passionate about accelerating the transition to a clean energy future.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities:

• Review, draft, negotiate and manage a variety of construction, project development, and other commercial and strategic agreements (including engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contracts, operations & maintenance agreements, subcontract agreements, vendor agreements, and NDAs).

• Manage the contract lifecycle, from negotiation through execution and ongoing compliance, ensuring that contractual relationships are well-managed.

• Support the company's tax credit and incentive programs, working with finance and outside advisors to document and preserve eligibility.

• Build collaborative partnerships with Brightcore’s project development, engineering, construction, finance and other internal teams to analyze, communicate and mitigate legal risks, provide legal advice and support sustainable business growth.

• Stay abreast of regulatory developments in the renewable energy sector to ensure compliance with relevant regulations.

• Contracting is the core of this role, but Brightcore's legal department is small and full-service so the Associate Counsel will have the opportunity to contribute across the full range of the legal department’s initiatives and workflows, including financing, M&A, corporate governance, insurance, real estate, intellectual property, employment, dispute resolution and litigation, and the department's compliance and policy initiatives.

• Strong track record of drafting, negotiating and reviewing a variety of commercial contracts.

jobs.title: Global Head of Sales Performance and Operations
jobs.description:
Shift delivers AI agents that transform insurers' most critical work. By combining deep industry expertise and unmatched data resources, Shift provides proven results that have earned the trust of hundreds of the world's leading insurers. Our insurance-grade AI is accurate, explainable, and secure—empowering human experts to move with unmatched speed, total confidence, and a renewed focus on the people they serve.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

Our culture is built on innovation, trust, and a drive to transform the insurance industry through our SaaS platform. We come from more than 50 different countries and cultures and together we are creating the future of insurance.

Learn more at www.shift-technology.com

We are seeking a high-urgency, commercially minded Global Head of Sales Performance & Operations to drive greater discipline, consistency, and outcomes across our global sales organization.

This leader will serve as a critical operating partner to the CRO and Heads of Market, helping them run their businesses more effectively—from pipeline creation and opportunity progression through forecasting and close. The mandate is: bring rigor to how we sell, identify where execution is breaking down, and work alongside sales leadership to drive action and results.

Shift operates in a complex enterprise selling environment. Our AI-native platform serves sophisticated buyers in a highly regulated industry, with multi-stakeholder sales processes, 12+ month sales cycles, and opportunities ranging from $300K to several million dollars. Success requires more than reporting and traditional sales operations. The ideal candidate understands enterprise selling and combines commercial judgment, analytical rigor, operational discipline, and executive presence. They are equally comfortable challenging a forecast with a Head of Market, dissecting a strategic deal with an AE, identifying systemic pipeline issues, and translating those insights into action.

This role is hybrid in Boston or fully remote in Eastern or Central US time zones, as you will manage a team in Paris and partner with a Global Sales team.

What Your Impact Looks Like

Execution Rigor & Pipeline Inspection

• Drive high-frequency pipeline inspection rhythms, rigorously questioning stage qualification, deal momentum, and close-date accuracy across long sales cycles.

• Implement and enforce standardized enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., Value Selling) to ensure rep-level accountability and eliminate deal slip.

• Actively manage the Deal Desk, unblocking contract roadblocks, managing custom terms, and expediting legal, security, and procurement approvals to close deals faster.

Sales Accountability & Performance Management

• Establish discipline, activity-based and milestone-based KPIs for reps to track deal velocity and risk exposure months before target close dates.

• Lead the Sales Enablement team to create outcome driven programs aligned with business strategy and product development, ensuring reps quickly learn to navigate a long sales cycle and dynamic market.

• Partner directly with Sales Leadership and Sales Enablement to identify underperforming territories or reps early, enforcing performance improvement plans and operational reset plans.

• Own quota allocation, capacity planning, and territory design, ensuring rep coverage is directly tied to pipeline generation and immediate revenue capture.

Strategic Go-to-Market & Incentive Alignment

• Architect incentive compensation and SPIFF structures that aggressively reward top-performer execution and support Shift's strategic objectives.

• Continuously audit rep time allocation, removing administrative burden so Account Executives spend maximum time in active buyer conversations.

• Translate revenue strategy into clear, executable weekly and monthly tactical mandates for field teams.

Tech Stack Execution & Process Enforcer

• Enforce strict usage of our GTM tech stack (Salesforce), turning software from data repositories into active execution tools.

• Streamline quote-to-cash workflows to eliminate sales friction and enforce strict compliance with pricing guidelines and discounting rules.

• Deliver real-time, actionable execution dashboards to executive leadership, highlighting operational bottlenecks, conversion gaps, and rep productivity metrics.

• Partner with Product, Finance, and Customer Success to ensure seamless post-sale operational transitions and retention visibility.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Experience: 8+ years in Sales Leadership, Sales/Revenue Operations in enterprise B2B SaaS with at least 3+ years managing global operational teams

• Execution Bias: Proven track record of operating as a proactive driver—not just a passive reporter of data—with an uncompromising standard for field execution and pipeline hygiene.

• Enterprise Mastery: Deep experience driving execution across complex, long-cycle enterprise deals (12+ months, $300k+ to $5M+ ACV, multiple economic buyers).

jobs.title: Customs Brokerage Manager
jobs.description:
Mallory Alexander International Logistics, a global third-party logistics (3PL) provider, is seeking a Logistics Professional to join our growing team.

The Customs Brokerage Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all aspects of U.S. import customs brokerage and import operations. This role will manage daily import activity, ensure regulatory compliance, maintain strong customer relationships, and lead a high-performing team.

Responsibilities:

• Lead daily customs brokerage and air/ocean import operations, ensuring timely and accurate customs clearance and shipment handling.

• Oversee import entry writing, classification, valuation, documentation, billing, and post-entry activities.

• Ensure compliance with CBP regulations, PGA requirements, customer SOPs, and company policies.

• Serve as the escalation point for complex customs, import, operational, and customer issues.

• Manage customer relationships and support customer retention and business growth.

• Monitor department productivity, service levels, profitability, and operational performance.

• Identify and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.

• Hire, train, coach, and develop team members while managing performance and staffing needs.

Qualifications:

• Licensed Customs Broker (LCB), required

• CCS certification, preferred.

• Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, International Business, or related field.

• 7+ years of U.S. customs brokerage and import operations experience.

• Supervisory or management experience in customs brokerage and/or import operations.

• Strong knowledge of CBP regulations, HTS classification, valuation, country of origin, and PGA requirements.

• Strong experience with air and ocean imports and entry writing.

• Experience managing departmental budgets, profitability, and business growth.

• Excellent customer service, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

• CargoWise experience, highly preferred

Mallory Alexander International Logistics is a leading full-service logistics provider established in 1925. jobs.title: Principal, HR Operations
jobs.description:
About LaunchWell Group

The HR and talent industry wasn't built for growth-stage companies, and it shows.

LaunchWell Group is changing that. We're a next-generation People partner built specifically for organizations that are scaling fast, operating lean, and can't afford to get talent wrong. No generalist playbooks. No one-size-fits-all solutions. Just bespoke, embedded support - across CHRO, Talent, and HR - designed to meet each organization exactly where they are.

Our clients are venture-backed startups, private equity portfolio companies, and mission-driven organizations building their People function often for the first time. They come to us because the traditional options - recruiting firms, fractional leaders, PEOs - weren't built for them.

LaunchWell is.



About the Role

We’re adding a Principal, HR Operations to our team, a seasoned HR professional who can operate independently, collaborate with leaders, and manage both strategic and day-to-day People needs.

As an embedded People partner across one or more LaunchWell client engagements, you’ll own the hands on day to day HR operations, employee relations, performance processes, policies, compliance, and employee experience initiatives - working independently or under the direction of senior People leaders and specialists as needed.

This role reports to LaunchWell’s Co-Founder and Head of Talent & Delivery. It’s a fully remote, contract role that flexes with client portfolio and business needs, with limited travel possible.



Terms of Engagement & Rates

Location: Remote / Hybrid, U.S.-based 
Engagement: Fractional (10-40 hours per week) 
Hourly Rates: $50-65 hourly, based upon experience

 - This is a fractional, independent contractor (1099) engagement.

 - Monthly hours and workload may fluctuate depending on client activity, project timelines, and broader business demand

 - Contractors are expected to proactively communicate availability, capacity changes, and other client commitments to support engagement planning and resource allocation.

 - Engagement requires flexibility to support evolving client priorities and short planning horizons.

 - Work will primarily be performed remotely, including weekly internal LaunchWell meetings and regular client meetings. Periodic onsite client support and travel may be required depending on client and engagement needs.



Scope of Work

Employee Relations & Manager Support

 - Lead sensitive employee relations matters, including concerns, conflicts, investigations, performance issues, and documentation, escalating issues when needed.

 - Coach managers on performance management, accountability, and difficult conversations,

 - Assess risk and recommend action that balances legal, business, and employee considerations.

People Operations, Compliance & Systems

 - Own and improve core HR processes, including onboarding, offboarding, employee lifecycle management, and documentation.

 - Lead policy administration and compliance and manage People risks across multi-state or global teams.

 - Manage HR systems, data integrity, and workforce reporting, using insights to strengthen decision-making.

 - Lead the execution of performance management, engagement, culture, and other employee experience programs.

Client Partnership & Business Development

 - Step into new client environments, quickly build context and trust, and deliver value with limited direction.

 - Collaborate with LaunchWell and client People team members while owning coordination and follow-through.

 - Identify opportunities to expand LaunchWell’s support, and contribute to proposals, pitches, and scoping that reinforce our position as a strategic partner.



Qualifications & Experience

 - Eight (8)+ years of progressive HR or People Operations experience as an HR Generalist, HR Business Partner, People Operations Partner, or similar.

 - Demonstrated experience with Rippling, Paylocity and/or Workday.

 - Demonstrated experience advising executives, senior leaders, and people managers in fast-paced, changing, or ambiguous environments.

 - Strong employee relations experience, including investigations, performance management, corrective action, and sensitive employee matters.

 - Strong knowledge of HR operations, employee lifecycle processes, compliance, People systems, and multi-state employment practices.

 - Sound business judgment and the ability to balance employee, legal, and risk considerations.

 - Ability to know when to escalate matters or seek input prior to taking action or making recommendations

 - Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to influence leaders and navigate difficult conversations.

 - Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and create order in a fractional or consulting environment.

Preferred

 - Experience supporting multiple clients or business units in a consulting, outsourced HR, or high-growth environment.

 - Experience working in a start-up environment.

 - Experience building or improving HR infrastructure and scalable operating practices.

 - Experience with HRIS implementation and reporting, including platforms such as Gusto, BambooHR, Greenhouse, or Ashby.

 - Professional HR certification such as SHRM-SCP, SHRM-CP, SPHR, or PHR; exposure to M&A, carve-outs, or venture-backed businesses is a plus.



Application Timeline and Details

We anticipate the selection window for this opening will close on: October 9th, 2026. Submission does not guarantee selection, and LaunchWell reserves the right to modify or close the selection process at any time.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. All applications will be retained for future consideration.

Security Notice

To ensure applicant safety, LaunchWell only communicates via official corporate emails or through verified hiring personnel. At no stage in our recruitment process will we ever solicit financial data or payments from you.

Benefits & Disclaimers

This is a flexible remote contract role with competitive hourly or retainer rates. 

Equal Opportunity Statement

LaunchWell celebrates diversity and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with applicable laws, including the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Performance Engineering (Cloud Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Principal Software Engineer — Performance Engineering (Cloud Infrastructure)

Engineering Location: Menlo Park



About the Team

The Capacity, Performance & Efficiency team sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, workload behavior, performance measurement, and business economics. We drive Snowflake’s cloud infrastructure adoption and evolution strategy, price/performance decisions, platform footprint expansion amidst capacity constraints, and strategic alignment with cloud service provider (CSP) technical roadmaps.



We're looking for a Principal Performance Engineer to drive Snowflake's cloud infrastructure performance strategy. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who can go deep on hardware internals (CPU microarchitecture, memory bandwidth, I/O behavior) while also translating that technical depth into pricing, capacity, and roadmap decisions across Snowflake.



You will drive the evaluation of new hardware generations across all major cloud providers, build the benchmarking and modeling infrastructure that turns raw performance data into pricing and rollout decisions, and represent Snowflake in technical discussions with CSPs and silicon partners. You'll help grow performance engineering as a discipline across the company — mentoring engineers, building benchmark capability, and championing a culture of rigorous, data-driven performance work.



What You'll Do

 - Own new hardware evaluation and enablement. Lead evaluation of new AWS, Azure, and GCP instance types (e.g., AWS Graviton, AMD Turin, Azure ARM/Cobalt, GCP Axion) by building representative benchmark and evaluation solutions.

 - Set performance strategy and architecture. Shape the team's technical roadmap, set direction on measurement methodology, and translate benchmark results into concrete rollout and adoption recommendations.

 - Lead cross-functional and CSP partnerships. Work across engineering (i.e. Warehouse, Capacity, and other core platform teams) and Finance along with AWS, Azure, GCP to qualify new hardware and influence future cloud-instance designs.

 - Characterize hardware performance at a deep level. Analyze CPU microarchitecture (e.g., memory bandwidth, PMU counters, I/O behavior) to identify workload-specific bottlenecks and drive resolution.

 - Develop price/performance model to support new hardware transitions.

 - Automate day-zero hardware readiness. Build automated performance-validation workflows and per-provider/per-instance scorecards so Snowflake can qualify and price new silicon at or near cloud-provider GA.

 - Grow the performance engineering discipline. Mentor engineers, build out benchmarking capability, and drive company-wide performance education (e.g., a recurring Performance Tech Talk series).



Our ideal candidate will have:

 - 12+ years of experience in performance engineering, systems engineering, or infrastructure engineering, with a track record of principal-level technical leadership.

 - Deep expertise in cloud infrastructure performance across at least one major CSP (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including instance types, pricing models, and capacity constraints.

 - Strong grounding in hardware/systems fundamentals: CPU microarchitecture, memory bandwidth, I/O subsystems, and use of profiling tools (PMU counters, etc.) to root-cause performance bottlenecks.

 - Experience building or operating large-scale benchmarking systems (e.g., TPC-DS-style workloads) and turning benchmark output into actionable optimization strategies and pricing/rollout decisions.

 - Ability to build quantitative models connecting technical performance metrics to business outcomes (pricing multipliers, cost-per-query).

 - A track record of leading cross-functional, cross-company initiatives — comfortable being the primary technical point of contact with external hardware and cloud partners (CSPs, silicon vendors).

 - Bias toward automation: builds scorecards, dashboards, and validation pipelines rather than relying on one-off analysis.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with data warehouse / distributed database performance characteristics.

 - Direct experience partnering with cloud providers or silicon vendors on early-access hardware programs.

 - Experience building hardware-emulation systems.





Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Manager - Family Intake and Enrollment
jobs.description:
MeBe is a provider of evidence-based therapies for children with autism and other special needs. Our mission is to empower families, professionals, and communities by educating and training them on evidence-based approaches. Our secret sauce? Play-filled, research-based care across multi-disciplines including ABA, Speech and OT.



At MeBe, you’ll be offered more than a job. You’ll receive training and support to develop your career and grow as an individual. You’ll work with extraordinary team members who share a common goal—to help children with autism be their best selves. Your days will be filled with meaning and purpose.



MeBe is seeking a Manager – Family Intake & Enrollment to lead the first chapter of a family’s experience with us. You’ll lead the Family Success Liaison team and own the family journey from initial inquiry through service start—including family discovery, outreach quality, team performance, technology, workflows, and lead-to-enrollment results.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives on building structure, developing people, using data to improve performance, and creating an exceptional experience during what can be an emotional and complex decision-making process for families. Success means building a predictable, high-quality path to enrollment while ensuring families feel informed, supported, and confident at every step.

 

Responsibilities:

 - Family Discovery: Ensure families receive a comprehensive, whole-child discovery experience that explores developmental, communication, sensory, social, behavioral, and educational needs and helps them understand the full range of MeBe services that may benefit their child.

 - Family Access Operations: Ensure families move smoothly through insurance verification, benefits education, and funding workflows, with accurate guidance on coverage, accepted payers, service availability, and alternatives when coverage limitations exist.

 - Systems & Technology Ownership: Demonstrated success hands-on managing and optimizing CRM and customer communication systems—ideally Zoho CRM, Zoho Bookings, RingCentral, or comparable platforms—including workflow configuration, automation, data quality, reporting, troubleshooting, and team adoption.

 - Quality Systems & Controls: Establish and continuously improve the standards, templates, workflows, quality controls, and reporting that create clear guardrails for FSL execution. Monitor CRM hygiene, response times, outreach cadence, documentation, appointment progression, and journey-stage movement to identify breakdowns and drive consistent quality.

 - FSL Team Leadership & Performance: Hire, train, coach, and performance-manage the FSL team. Routinely review calls, emails, texts, CRM activity, and family progression to identify performance gaps, provide timely feedback, and ensure consistent execution against established standards.

 - Lead-to-Enrollment Performance: Own performance and reporting across the lead-to-enrollment funnel, including response time, contact rates, discovery calls, site tours, assessment conversion, authorization progression, service starts, lead aging, and journey-stage drop-off. Use data to identify barriers, improve conversion, and hold the team accountable for timely follow-through.

 - Clinical Capacity & Site Partnership: Partner with Site Directors and Operations to align family intake and enrollment with clinical capacity, service availability, and site-specific growth goals.

 - Referral Partner Collaboration: Partner with Business Development to strengthen referral relationships and ensure FSLs provide responsive, professional communication with referring providers regarding family status, service availability, and referral outcomes. Use insights from family and referral interactions to identify opportunities to improve the referral experience and support long-term partnerships.

 
 

Qualifications and Skills:

 - Team Leadership & Development: Demonstrated success leading and developing a client-facing team, including hiring, training, quality monitoring, coaching, accountability, and performance management.

 - Enrollment & Pipeline Performance: Proven ownership of intake-to-enrollment performance, including pipeline management, follow-up execution, reducing drop-off, and achieving measurable enrollment outcomes.

 - Systems & Technology Ownership: Demonstrated success owning CRM and customer communication systems—ideally Zoho CRM, Zoho Bookings, RingCentral, or comparable platforms—including workflow configuration, automation, data quality, reporting, and team adoption.

 - Process Improvement: Strong process-improvement mindset with the ability to identify workflow breakdowns, design and implement practical solutions, and measure whether changes improve efficiency, quality, and conversion.

 - Data & Performance Management: Data-informed leader who can translate performance metrics into action, identify trends and breakdowns, establish accountability, and use insights to improve individual and team performance.

 - Family & Referral Partner Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to communicate warmly and confidently with families and referring providers, personally navigate complex or escalated situations, and build trust without pressure.

 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Strong ability to work across teams and influence without direct authority, partnering effectively with Site Directors, Operations, Business Development, and clinical leaders to align family demand, service capacity, and enrollment priorities.

 - Relevant Service Experience: Experience in ABA, behavioral health, healthcare, patient access, admissions, or another high-touch service environment preferred, with an understanding of the importance of responsiveness, accuracy, and empathy throughout the client journey.

 - Ability to pass a background check (Required).

 - Excellent organizational skills and ability to meet deadlines
