jobs.title: Applications Administrator / IT Business Partner
jobs.description:
Are you ready to join a team committed to making a meaningful impact on cancer treatment through the discovery and development of precision medicines? At Kura Oncology, you have an opportunity to be a part of something bigger, with a lasting impact that you can be proud of.

At Kura Oncology, we are working to change the paradigm and improve the science of cancer treatment. As an organization, we strive to cultivate a diverse and talented professional culture driven to develop precision medicine therapeutics.

As we continue to build a leading biotech organization with a strong culture, a patient-focused mindset and a team focused on relentless execution, we are looking for innovative, passionate professionals to join us and make our vision a reality.

To succeed at Kura, you will need to have a demonstrated ability for excellence in drug discovery and development and a roll-up your sleeves attitude. The ideal candidate will possess a values-driven work style where integrity and grit drive all behaviors, decisions, and actions.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

The Applications Administrator / IT Business Partner (ITBP) is responsible for managing, optimizing, and supporting enterprise technology applications while partnering with business functions to align technology capabilities with organizational strategy and operational priorities. This role reports to the Executive Director of IT and serves as both a technical application administrator and a strategic liaison between the IT organization and business stakeholders/operations.

In this capacity, the role ensures enterprise applications are effectively implemented, configured, maintained, and supported while also identifying opportunities for technology-driven improvements across the organization. The ITBP works collaboratively with stakeholders to translate business needs into technology solutions, ensuring systems, platforms, and digital initiatives deliver measurable value to the organization.

Application Management

• Oversee implementation, configuration, deployment, and lifecycle management of enterprise applications, platforms, and other business systems related to the Commercial organization.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to configure and customize applications to meet evolving business requirements.

• Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and implement platform changes to support the entire organization.

• Coordinate system upgrades, patches, and maintenance to ensure optimal performance and security.

• Partner with IT teams and external vendors to support integrations between enterprise systems and third-party solutions.

IT Business Partnership & Strategic Alignment

• Serve as an Information Technology Business Partner (ITBP) across the organization, aligning technology capabilities with business strategy and operational priorities.

• Support strategic planning and technology roadmap development to ensure IT capabilities advance organizational growth and transformation. Act as a trusted advisor and liaison between functional leaders and the head of IT, fostering discovery and collaboration to align technology initiatives with enterprise objectives and Kura’s 2030 Vision.

• Develop a deep understanding of organizational objectives, operational challenges, and emerging needs to translate them into scalable technology solutions.

• Identify opportunities for digital enablement, automation, and process optimization.

• Promote cross-functional collaboration between IT teams, functional stakeholders, and external partners to deliver effective technology solutions.

• Advocate for business priorities within IT governance frameworks while ensuring alignment with security, compliance, and enterprise architecture standards.

Project & Stakeholder Management

• Facilitate project scoping, requirements gathering, and solution design in collaboration with stakeholders.

• Develop user requirements, SOPs, and operational processes for supported systems.

• Plan and execute assigned projects while monitoring progress and communicating status updates to leadership.

• Coordinate testing, validation, and implementation activities to support system changes and enhancements.

User Support & Training

• Provide functional and technical support for enterprise applications.

• Troubleshoot system issues and resolve user inquiries.

• Develop and deliver training sessions, user documentation, and best practice guidance to improve system adoption.

Data & System Governance

• Manage system security including user access, roles, and permissions.

• Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across enterprise systems.

• Maintain compliance with company policies, SOX, GxP, and regulatory requirements.

• Support system documentation, validation, and audit readiness activities.

Vendor & Service Management

• Serve as a primary contact for application vendors and service providers.

• Coordinate vendor support, issue escalation, and service level management.

• Collaborate with vendors and consulting partners to deliver system enhancements and upgrades.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

• Identify opportunities to improve system functionality, user experience, and operational efficiency.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and digital solutions that support organizational objectives.

• Participate in innovation initiatives and pilot programs to enhance enterprise technology capabilities.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in a related technical or business discipline required.

jobs.title: Director, Revenue Growth Programs
jobs.description:
Why Choose Bottomline?

Are you ready to transform the way businesses pay and get paid? Bottomline is a global leader in business payments and cash management, with over 35 years of experience and moving more than $16 trillion in payments annually. We're looking for passionate individuals to join our team and help drive impactful results for our customers. If you're dedicated to delighting customers and promoting growth and innovation - we want you on our team!

Role:

The Director, Revenue Growth Programs is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing strategic initiatives that accelerate revenue growth and close gaps between company revenue targets and expected performance. This role serves as the bridge between revenue planning and execution, leading cross-functional programs that drive customer retention, expansion, pricing optimization, and operational improvements.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, analytical rigor, program management expertise, and the ability to influence leaders across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and Operations. This individual will own the development and implementation of revenue growth initiatives while providing visibility into program performance and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

Revenue Growth Strategy & Execution:

• Identify revenue opportunities and develop action plans to close gaps between forecasted performance and revenue targets.

• Lead revenue growth programs from concept through execution, ensuring measurable business impact.

• Partner with functional leaders to translate strategic objectives into actionable initiatives and implementation plans.

• Monitor program effectiveness and adjust strategies as business conditions evolve.

• Serve as a catalyst for driving revenue performance when business-as-usual (BAU) plans are insufficient to achieve targets.

Cross-Functional Program Leadership:

• Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives involving Sales, Customer Success, Product, Operations, Marketing, and Finance.

• Establish program governance, milestones, accountability structures, and success metrics.

• Facilitate executive-level decision-making by providing clear recommendations and business cases.

• Drive organizational alignment and execution against key revenue priorities.

Pricing & Commercial Optimization:

• Develop and coordinate pricing, packaging, and commercial programs to improve revenue performance.

• Partner with business leaders to evaluate disruptive pricing opportunities and market-based strategies.

• Analyze customer behavior, retention trends, and revenue leakage to identify growth opportunities.

• Support customer save and retention initiatives focused on reducing churn and maximizing customer lifetime value.

Revenue Analytics & Insights:

• Build reporting frameworks, dashboards, and scorecards to measure program progress and business impact.

• Develop actionable insights through financial, operational, and customer data analysis.

• Provide ongoing performance reporting to executive leadership.

• Create visibility into program outcomes, risks, and opportunities.

Portfolio & Investment Management:

• Prioritize growth initiatives based on expected revenue impact, execution complexity, and return on investment.

• Develop resource requirements and investment recommendations to support growth programs.

• Track program benefits realization and ensure accountability for results.

• Support annual planning and long-range forecasting through identification of future growth opportunities.

The Director, Revenue Growth Programs will be measured on:

• Revenue growth generated through strategic initiatives

• Closure of revenue gaps against plan

• Customer retention and expansion performance

• Pricing initiative effectiveness

• Program implementation success and adoption

• Executive stakeholder satisfaction

• Speed and quality of decision support

• Accuracy and transparency of reporting and dashboards

Required Skills and Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, or related field.

• 8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Revenue Management, Strategy, Consulting, Finance, Program Management, or related disciplines.

• Proven experience leading cross-functional business initiatives from strategy through execution.

• Strong analytical skills with experience translating data into actionable business recommendations.

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive organizational change.

• Experience building executive-level reporting and performance dashboards.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience in SaaS, technology, subscription-based, or recurring revenue businesses.

• Knowledge of pricing strategy, customer retention, and revenue growth frameworks.

• Experience managing large-scale transformation or growth initiatives.

• MBA or advanced business degree.

Key Competencies:

• Strategic Thinking

• Program Leadership

• Revenue Growth Orientation

• Business Analytics

• Executive Communication

• Change Management

• Financial Acumen

• Cross-Functional Influence

• Problem Solving

• Results Driven Execution

jobs.title: Behavior Technician-Work With Kids- Training Provided
jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

Pay Range: $19 - $20

Requirements:

• Passionate about helping children with autism.

• Patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team.

• 18+ years of age

• High school diploma or GED

• Ability to obtain a CPR, First Aid Certification and Tuberculosis test (if you haven’t had one in the last year)

• Ability to pass a pre employment background check

• Ability to move in various positions (sit, squad, bend, etc.)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.

Perks of Working at Centria:

• Structured career path in the field of Behavioral Analysis

• Discounts to hundreds of retail partners via our Benefit Hub

• Access to Centria’s Employee Assistance Plan with benefits around mental health and counseling

• Unlimited opportunities to make an impact in the life of a special needs child

jobs.title: VP of Clinical Solutions
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION AND VISION

Unlearn exists to transform clinical development by making every trial smarter. We harness data, AI, and digital twins to enable faster, more robust studies that bring life-saving treatments to patients faster. This mission drives everything we do as we partner with biopharmaceutical companies to redesign how clinical trials are planned, run, and analyzed.

We are defining the future of clinical development with unmatched scientific credibility, replacing uncertainty with AI-powered precision so decisions are clearer and trials are stronger. We don’t just disrupt the pharmaceutical industry, we create lasting change.

We believe AI will define the future of medicine, and we are committed to building that future responsibly, rigorously, and in close collaboration with our partners in clinical development.




ABOUT OUR TEAM

We come from a variety of backgrounds ranging from machine learning to marketing—but regardless of where we come from, Unlearners share some common traits:

 - Unlearners are ambitious; we aren’t intimidated by big, challenging goals.

 - Unlearners are disciplined experimenters; we break down our big goals into smaller chunks and meet as often as necessary to track our velocity and iterate quickly.

 - Unlearners are gritty; we never give up, setbacks just make us try harder.

 - Unlearners are receptive to new ideas; in fact, we hate being stuck with the status quo

 - Unlearners are storytellers; sharing information with each other and with the world is super important, too important to be boring.  And, last but not least,

 - Unlearners are team-oriented; we put the mission first, the company second, the team third, and individuals last.

Headquartered in San Francisco, Unlearn was founded in 2017 by a team of world-class machine learning scientists.  We have raised venture capital from top tier investors such as Altimeter, Insight Partners, Radical Ventures, 8VC, DCVC, and DCVC Bio, and completed our $50 million Series C in January 2024.

If our purpose and culture resonate with you, we invite you to apply.




YOUR ROLE

Leading Pharma and Biotech companies trust Unlearn to deliver scientifically rigorous work using digital twins on studies where the stakes are high and the timelines are real.  A digital twin of a patient is a comprehensive prediction of expected outcomes under a defined standard of care, made by a machine learning model built using our proprietary technology. That work is done by our scientific delivery teams, with expertise spanning biostatistics, data science, clinical science, and machine learning. As the VP of Clinical Solutions, you will lead an organization of scientists and technical leaders across a wide array of active customer projects with different timelines, needs, and opportunities.

This role sits at the intersection of scientific leadership and operational excellence. On one side, you will develop technical teams through hands-on people leadership, technical governance, and deep domain judgment about what rigorous clinical and scientific delivery work looks like. On the other, you will keep  delivery on track across a growing portfolio, resourcing projects effectively as we scale, and partnering across functions to solve problems before they reach customers.

You will report to the COO  and be responsible for meeting business goals in Delivery that ensures that Unlearn increases its leadership and reputation as a best-in-class innovator and scientific partner.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead Unlearn's scientific delivery organization and own the quality, timeliness, and scientific rigor of customer-facing delivery work across a portfolio of concurrent projects.

 - Partner closely with Business Development, Product, Engineering, R&D, and Quality Management to shape scopes of work, resolve cross-functional blockers, feed delivery learnings back into the product, and ensure what we sell is what we can deliver excellently.

 - Serve as a senior scientific voice with customers: stepping into escalations, building trust with sponsor teams, and representing the credibility of Unlearn's science in clinical development settings.

 - Develop technical team leaders through direct people leadership, mentorship, and career development.

 - Establish and uphold technical governance: standards, review practices, and quality frameworks that ensure our statistical analyses, data products, and ML applications meet the bar our customers and regulators expect.

 - Own delivery operations at scale: project staffing and resourcing, capacity planning, prioritization across competing customer demands, and delivery processes that keep a growing portfolio on track without burning out the team.

 - Report regularly to company leadership on delivery health, capacity, and portfolio risk; manage the growth of delivery commitments so that we scale ambitiously without over-committing resources, and escalate risks early and transparently.

 - Build the systems, metrics, and delivery models that maintain quality while we continue to grow.




REQUIREMENTS

 - 10+ years leading scientific or analytical delivery work in clinical development, with significant experience operating at the Senior Director or VP level with responsibility for multi-disciplinary technical teams.

 - A track record of leading data analytics, biostatistics, data science, or related delivery organizations serving biopharma customers—for example at real-world data (RWD) companies, CROs, or analytics-driven clinical development partners. Direct ML delivery experience is a plus, but deep respect for and fluency with quantitative methods is essential.

 - Demonstrated scientific leadership: you have grown individual contributors into technical leaders, and you can provide credible technical guidance and governance across biostatistics, data science, and ML without needing to be the deepest expert in each.

 - Strong operational skills: you have kept complex, concurrent customer delivery portfolios on track, resourced projects effectively under real constraints, and scaled delivery teams and processes as demand grew.

 - Domain knowledge of clinical development: study designs, clinical data, sponsor expectations, and the regulatory and evidentiary standards that govern our customers' decisions.

 - Experience reporting to executive leadership on delivery capacity, growth, and risk: you manage commitments realistically, say no when the math doesn't work, and surface problems early rather than letting them compound.

 - Comfort operating cross-functionally with Business Development, Product, Engineering, R&D, Quality Management, and customer stakeholders, and translating fluidly between technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Experience in growth-stage or early-stage companies to build a stronger delivery model while running it.




BENEFITS & PERKS

The following benefits and perks are for full time roles only. 

 - Meaningful equity participation

 - 100% company-covered medical, dental, & vision insurance plans

 - 401k plan with matching

 - Flexible PTO plus company holidays

 - Annual company-wide break December 24 through January 1

 - Commuter benefits 

 - Paid Parental Leave



Unlearn is an equal opportunity employer. 

At Unlearn, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, because inclusion and diversity are essential to achieving our mission. If you’re excited about this role, and your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply nevertheless.

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Manager
jobs.description:
MOO brings brands to life in a sustainable way, with a range of remarkable print and merchandise products. We combine design, technology, manufacturing and service, so that people can connect in memorable ways. Not online but out there, in real life.
 
We started in 2004. Since then we’ve built an award-winning and much-loved brand, with customer satisfaction and Trustpilot ratings that make most businesses want to give up and hire an army of review bots. We’ve got half a million customers, mostly small and medium businesses in North America, the UK, and Europe – businesses that, like us, get all excited about putting something real and beautiful into people’s hands. Does that make us nerds? Probably, and we’re ok with that. 
 
We’ve been given the highest business award in Britain, ‘The Queen’s Award for Enterprise’. Backed by venture capital, we’re part of Tech Nation’s ‘Future Fifty’, recently passing $1bn in lifetime revenue, and featuring in the Guardian’s top 10 UK start-ups list. Ok, we’ll stop bragging now.
 
Today, we’re more than 400 people with our global HQ in London, UK, while we also have premises in Dagenham. In the US, you’ll find us in Boston, MA, as well as East Providence, RI and Denver, CO and with our most recent office expansion in Cape Town South Africa.


Our Manufacturing team is at the heart of our operations, creating best-in-class products for our customers. Our facility keeps things moving across three shifts, 24 hours a day, five days a week. Throughout it all, the team shares a commitment to safety, quality and efficiency—working brilliantly together and collaborating across MOO to turn new ideas into products our customers love.
 
This is a pivotal leadership role designed to steer our entire production operation. Your expertise will be crucial in ensuring we not only meet but exceed our manufacturing targets for safety, quality, cost, and delivery. We are hiring this position to strengthen our leadership as we scale our operations, launch new products, and implement cutting-edge processes to maintain our competitive edge.

jobs.title: BestDrive Service Technician
jobs.description:
💰 Sign-On Bonus Available!

Join the BestDrive team and take advantage of our Service Technician Sign-On Bonus Program!

Eligible external candidates may receive a sign-on bonus based on the Service Technician level hired into:

• Service Technician I – $1,500
• Service Technician II – $2,500
• Service Technician III – $3,500
• Service Technician IV – $4,500

The sign-on bonus is earned through continued employment and paid in installments after 30, 90, and 180 days, provided eligibility requirements are met.

Eligibility requirements apply.

The Tire Service Technician position is essential to our business. This person must be able to properly dismount, mount, balance, and repair Commercial Vehicle and Medium Truck tires. Employees will be responsible for all aspects of tire and related service and repair for off-the-road equipment (construction, earthmoving, mining, farm etc.) as well as other duties as assigned by the manager.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT -

• Mount/Dismount/Install tires & tire/wheel assemblies
• Load/Unload tires on and off trucks
• Repair Tires
• Follow established procedures to inspect tires and wheels before and after service.
• Determine repairable tire conditions and make such repairs.
• Review work orders and discuss work with supervisors.
• Document work performed accurately and according to company policy.
• Operate heavy-duty tire service equipment and tools including boom cranes, cribbing, jacks, compressors, and electric and hydraulic equipment.
• Unbolt and re-bolt wheels from/to equipment, using lug wrenches and other hand and power tools.
• Mount and dismount any type of off-the-road tire including but not limited to multi-piece rims.
• Perform emergency road service calls on nights and/or weekends on a rotating basis.
• Proper maintenance of assigned service vehicle including an appearance as well as onboard service equipment and tools.
• Comply with OSHA regulations and safety requirements pertaining to this position.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE -

• Must be 18 years or older
• Valid Driver’s License
• Ability to pass a DOT physical
• The ability to work in a fast-paced, customer service-oriented environment.
• Ability to work on a team and independently
• Ability to communicate, verbally and written, clearly and professionally with co-workers and management.

Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

ADDITIONAL WAYS TO STAND OUT -

• High School Diploma or equivalent
• 1-2 years of tire service technician experience
• CDL License a plus
• TIA certification

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

• Work hours are generally 7-5 Monday – Friday. Saturday and evenings as needed; may have little to no advance notice.
• Safety is our highest priority and safety procedures/guidelines must be followed.
• This position operates in all types of indoor and outdoor work environments, therefore exposure to heat and cold is to be expected.
• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, bend, climb, lift, and walk.
• Required to handle hazardous materials and wear various forms of protective equipment (safety shoes, gloves, protective eyewear, etc.). Comply with OSHA regulations and safety requirements.
• Required to lift 75-100 lbs. routinely; may be required to occasionally lift up to 150 lbs. individually.

THE PERKS

• Immediate Benefits
• Paid Time Off
• Employee Discounts, including tire discounts
• Employer 401(k) Match
• Diverse & Inclusive Work Environment
• Employee Assistance Program
• Future Growth Opportunities
• And more benefits that come with working for a global industry leader!

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION AND VISION

Unlearn exists to transform clinical development by making every trial smarter. We harness data, AI, and digital twins to enable faster, more robust studies that bring life-saving treatments to patients faster. This mission drives everything we do as we partner with biopharmaceutical companies to redesign how clinical trials are planned, run, and analyzed.

We are defining the future of clinical development with unmatched scientific credibility, replacing uncertainty with AI-powered precision so decisions are clearer and trials are stronger. We don’t just disrupt the pharmaceutical industry, we create lasting change.

We believe AI will define the future of medicine, and we are committed to building that future responsibly, rigorously, and in close collaboration with our partners in clinical development.




ABOUT OUR TEAM

We come from a variety of backgrounds ranging from machine learning to marketing—but regardless of where we come from, Unlearners share some common traits:

 - Unlearners are ambitious; we aren’t intimidated by big, challenging goals.

 - Unlearners are disciplined experimenters; we break down our big goals into smaller chunks and meet as often as necessary to track our velocity and iterate quickly.

 - Unlearners are gritty; we never give up, setbacks just make us try harder.

 - Unlearners are receptive to new ideas; in fact, we hate being stuck with the status quo

 - Unlearners are storytellers; sharing information with each other and with the world is super important, too important to be boring.  And, last but not least,

 - Unlearners are team-oriented; we put the mission first, the company second, the team third, and individuals last.

Headquartered in San Francisco, Unlearn was founded in 2017 by a team of world-class machine learning scientists.  We have raised venture capital from top tier investors such as Altimeter, Insight Partners, Radical Ventures, 8VC, DCVC, and DCVC Bio, and completed our $50 million Series C in January 2024.

If our purpose and culture resonate with you, we invite you to apply.




YOUR ROLE

Leading Pharma and Biotech companies trust Unlearn to deliver scientifically rigorous work using digital twins on studies where the stakes are high and the timelines are real.  A digital twin of a patient is a comprehensive prediction of expected outcomes under a defined standard of care, made by a machine learning model built using our proprietary technology.  Working at scale across the industry requires a strong engineering foundation built around data, models, and AI in a regulated, compliance-heavy environment.

As the VP of Engineering, you will lead our engineering function, an organization of engineers spanning core engineering, applications, ML/AI Ops, and infrastructure. The team includes engineers across experience levels, anchored by strong senior technical leaders.  Engineering plays a critical role in our ability to deliver AI technology through models, applications, and agentic systems, and this role will ensure the potential of AI systems are realized across that technical stack.

This is an execution-focused leadership role, focused on the core engineering systems, software applications, infrastructure, and forward deployment that drive AI-heavy, tech-enabled services.  You will work with your teams on scoping and delivery, and lead an engineering organization known for shipping what it commits to. You will partner closely with Product, Delivery, and R&D teams to understand requirements, integrate engineering with our customer delivery teams, and build the platform and tools they use to do their best work.

Just as importantly, you will connect engineering to the company's direction, understanding company strategy, translating it into a concrete engineering roadmap that integrates a workflow across data, modeling, applications, compliance, and security, and holding the team accountable for delivering to that roadmap on timeframes that match company objectives. You will work as a member of the leadership team, maintaining consistent communication and clear expectations in both directions, so that leadership always knows where engineering stands, and engineering always knows why its work matters.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead Unlearn's engineering function across technical disciplines, owning the quality, reliability, compliance, and security of the systems that power our work.  Ensure AI tools and systems are used heavily for efficiency and impact.

 - Drive execution: define projects, partner with teams on scoping and estimation, and run delivery practices that turn commitments into shipped work.  Partner with Product, R&D, and Delivery leadership to understand requirements, shape technical approaches, and deliver on value for customers.

 - Translate company strategy to sequence and prioritize work so that engineering output directly advances company objectives, and hold teams accountable for delivering to that roadmap on the timeframes the business requires.

 - Operate as a member of the leadership team: report clearly and consistently on engineering progress, capacity, and risk; maintain aligned expectations between leadership and the engineering team; and communicate priorities and context down into the organization.

 - Establish an AI-centric engineering culture, one that scales the impact of the organization and likewise equips team members with strong, modern toolsets to help them grow and succeed in their careers at and beyond Unlearn.

 - Own hiring and team design for engineering, deliberately growing the organization aligned with company needs.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 10+ years in software engineering with significant experience leading engineering organizations at the Senior Director or VP level, including managing managers and senior technical leaders across multiple engineering disciplines.

 - A track record of strong execution in highly collaborative and cross-functional environments where engineering has delivered on timelines that mattered to the business.

 - Experience leading across the stack: infrastructure/DevOps, backend or platform engineering, and application/front-end development, with experience in regulated environments where compliance is a key factor on system design.

 - Demonstrated ability to translate company strategy into an engineering roadmap, communicate the "why" behind priorities, and hold teams accountable for delivering against commitments.

 - Experience partnering closely with Product, R&D, and customer-facing delivery teams; you have built internal tools and platforms that made technical teams measurably more effective.

 - Experience in growth-stage or early-stage companies where you built engineering processes and delivery discipline in small teams while shipping. Experience in life sciences, healthcare, or another regulated, data-intensive domain is a plus.




BENEFITS & PERKS

The following benefits and perks are for full time roles only. 

 - Meaningful equity participation

 - 100% company-covered medical, dental, & vision insurance plans

 - 401k plan with matching

 - Flexible PTO plus company holidays

 - Annual company-wide break December 24 through January 1

 - Commuter benefits 

 - Paid Parental Leave



Unlearn is an equal opportunity employer. 

At Unlearn, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, because inclusion and diversity are essential to achieving our mission. If you’re excited about this role, and your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply nevertheless.

jobs.title: Head, Non-Financial Risk
jobs.description:
To provide pro-active management and operational support enabling the implementation of the Non-Financial Risk (NFR) management strategy across the Business and Commercial Banking (BCB), Personal and Private Banking (PPB), and Asset Management (AM).  The role is responsible for embedding risk management processes to identify and mitigate NFRs.

Minimum Qualification:

• First Degree in Business Commerce
• First Degree in Risk Management

Experience Required :

• 3–4 years’ experience in Risk and/or Corporate Affairs within financial services.
• Working knowledge of Information Risk, including familiarity with UK frameworks and regulations such as UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, and industry standards (e.g. ISO 27001, ISF Standard of Good Practice).
• Practical experience of risk and control frameworks, assurance, and their application in the financial services industry. Good understanding of risk appetite, risk response, and process improvement.
• Broad understanding of both non-financial risk and financial reporting risk characteristics.

Key Outputs :

• Act as the NFR interface to support fraud risk management and collaborate with relevant teams on information risk threats and controls across business units.
• Partner with the business to strengthen risk management capability, equipping teams to mitigate financial, reputational, and regulatory impacts of NFR incidents.
• Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including senior management, audit functions, and regulators.
• Oversee and challenge the risk and control cycle (RCSA) ensuring risk reporting, escalation, and actions are data-driven with clear accountability.
• Support delivery through collaboration and continuous improvement, including mentoring where required.
• Complete RCSA activities across relevant business areas, ensuring all applicable risk types are assessed and captured in the NFR management system.
• Analyse business impact and support risk acceptance processes for residual risks, including preparing recommendations and escalating where risk levels exceed appetite.

Salary range

GBP 73,000 to GBP 88,000

jobs.description:
Company Introduction

WorldStrides is the global leader in educational travel and experiential learning. The company was founded in 1967 to provide middle school travel programs to Washington, D.C. and has grown to provide a wide range of programs for more than half a million students annually to over 100 countries around the world. WorldStrides offers experiential learning programs in educational travel, performing arts, language immersion, career exploration, service-learning, study abroad, and sports. Each of these experiences helps students to see beyond the classroom and to see the world – and themselves – in new ways.

Job Description:

The sales team is a collaborative and development focused team that cares about, supports, and learns from each other. The Account Manager position for WorldStrides is responsible for the selling of educational tours to qualified or experienced Program Leaders, as well as the inheritance and relationship of an established base of current clients. The Account Manager will be expected to uphold consistent and competitive sales numbers, retain and resell their business base, as well as garnering referrals and closing new leads.

Responsibilities:

• Develops strong relationships with all Program Leaders upon selling or inheriting the account. Responds to inquiries or requests promptly via phone or email, engages personally with Program Leaders to determine long and short term needs, problem solves quickly and creatively on behalf of Program Leaders.

• Consistently maintains phone outreach to existing and new customers to maintain sales goals.

• Solicits new clients by prospecting past travelers, answering direct sales calls and following up on new sales leads.

• Meets or exceeds all goal expectations regarding the expected number of sign-ups per sales season while maintaining the appropriate level of resold business.

• Resells Program Leaders on future tours and inherits new clients that have been closed by Program Consultants.

• Works effectively and in tandem with Program Management, Program Associates and Financial Service Representatives as well as any other colleague within WorldStrides.

• Educates self on all relevant tours and all brands supported. Comprehends the student travel industry with interest to learn more regarding our competition as it compares to each brand that is supported.

• Supports all policies and procedures and overall business strategies of WorldStrides.

• Assumes additional responsibilities as requested.

• This role is hybrid based out of our San Diego office.

Qualifications:

• Positive, solution-oriented attitude.

• Excellent time management and organizational skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented, data-driven environment.

• Strong interpersonal skills – excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a professional telephone and video call demeanor.

• Keen attention to detail – must possess the ability to visually proof documents and work efficiently on a computer.

• Proficient in computer skills and able to learn new technologies with appropriate support and training

• Ability to balance customer service expectations with business considerations.

• Experience in a sales and/or customer relationship management and/or customer service environment (including restaurants) a plus.

• College degree preferred or 2-3 years sales and/or customer service experience.

• A love for traveling and belief in the value of travel in helping students understand the world.

• Adaptable to frequently changing systems and workloads, and can thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Work Perks:

• Comprehensive health benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, accident, critical illness, disability insurance, FSA/HSA options with employer HSA contributions, and a generous 401(k) match.

• Generous paid time off including 11 paid company holidays, 25 PTO days the first year (prorated), 1 paid volunteer day, 4 mental health days, and bereavement

• Professional development support, including up to $5,250 annually for tuition reimbursement and up to $1,000 for certifications annually

• Opportunities for paid and discounted travel

• Flexible work schedule providing on-site, remote, and hybrid office opportunities

• Encouraged participation in a wide variety of Employee Resource Groups

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and wellness resources, including fitness centers at select locations

• Paid parental, caregiver, and disability leave

• Team Member Discount Program

• Engaging, collaborative, and fun work environment

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount WorldStrides is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Jellyfish helps engineering organizations understand how their teams work, and that starts with data people can actually trust. We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help turn our growing data platform into a consistent, well-modeled foundation for analytics, product development, and customer-facing insights. You’ll sit between raw data and the people consuming it, defining durable models, improving data quality, and making sure important business concepts mean the same thing everywhere they appear.

If you care about clean semantic models, reproducible transformations, and making it easy for others to confidently use data, you’re the perfect fit.

What you’ll actually be doing:

 - Data Modeling - You’ll design and maintain analytical data models that turn raw engineering and product data into understandable, reusable datasets. You’ll help define facts, dimensions, metrics, and canonical business entities that can be shared across the organization.

 - Transformation Frameworks - You’ll help introduce and mature tools like dbt for managing transformations, testing, documentation, and lineage. You’ll establish patterns that make analytical transformations easier to understand, review, and maintain.

 - Data Quality - You’ll build automated checks for completeness, freshness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and other important quality signals. You’ll help move us from discovering bad data downstream to detecting problems closer to their source.

 - Metric Consistency - You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, and Analytics to establish clear definitions for important metrics and ensure those definitions are implemented consistently across dashboards, APIs, and customer-facing experiences.

 - Developer Enablement - You’ll make it easier for engineers and analysts to understand and use our data. That includes documentation, examples, reusable models, and helping teams understand how data flows through the platform.

You’re a great fit if:

 - SQL Fluency - You are extremely comfortable working with complex SQL and can reason about performance, correctness, and maintainability.

 - Analytics Engineering Experience - You’ve worked with tools like dbt or similar transformation frameworks and understand concepts like staging models, intermediate models, marts, testing, lineage, and semantic layers.

 - Strong Data Modeling Fundamentals - You understand dimensional modeling, normalized and denormalized models, facts and dimensions, grain, slowly changing dimensions, and how modeling decisions affect downstream consumers.

 - Data Quality Mindset - You think of tests, contracts, and documentation as part of the product, not cleanup work.

 - Collaborative Translator - You can work with engineers, analysts, product managers, and domain experts to turn ambiguous business concepts into precise data definitions.

 - Pragmatic Problem Solver - You understand that the goal is trustworthy, usable data, not building the theoretically perfect warehouse.

Bonus Points:

 - You’ve worked in a rapidly scaling SaaS environment.

 - You’ve helped introduce dbt or an equivalent modeling framework into an existing data platform.

 - You’ve worked with Databricks, Delta Lake, or lakehouse architectures.

 - You’ve worked with data catalogs, lineage, or governance platforms like OpenMetadata.

 - You’ve helped define semantic models or metric contracts consumed by both analytics and production applications.

A list of job experiences and qualification requirements is great, but humility, a performance-driven attitude, and a team-player approach are most important to us. We love to have fun and win in the process. We only hire people who have a passion for building great companies in an environment where a sense of humor is a must.

Occasional travel may be required.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the US. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.



Let’s talk about us!
This is all about you, but you want to know a little about us. Jellyfish https://jellyfish.co is the leading intelligence platform for AI-Integrated engineering, helping more than 1,000 companies including DraftKings, Keller Williams and Blue Yonder, leverage AI to transform how they build software. By combining the industry’s deepest engineering dataset with context-rich intelligence, Jellyfish helps R&D organizations understand what’s driving impact, adopt proven industry best practices, and make smarter decisions across AI adoption, planning, delivery, and engineering performance.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Enterprise Sales – Media
jobs.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.



About the Role

Associate Director, Enterprise Sales owns a new-business revenue number across Darkroom's media flywheel: Paid Media (Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, and the broader paid social, search, and programmatic stack), Creator (creator and UGC programs, affiliate and whitelisting, ambassador and creator-led acquisition), and Performance Creative (creative strategy, production, and iteration built to move paid performance).

You lead with paid media. Media management is the largest, highest-intent entry point into an enterprise brand's growth P&L, and it is where your hunt starts. Creator and Creative are how you widen the deal: once you are inside a brand's media operation, you are the person who sees that their creative is the bottleneck, their creator program is running on one-off deals instead of a system, and their acquisition engine is capped by supply rather than budget -- and who scopes and closes that work too.

This is the enterprise seat. Your book is built on a smaller number of larger accounts: brands with meaningful media budgets where a single engagement carries base retainer plus a media-linked variable fee. One whale can be half a quarter. You will run a named target list, a defined category focus, and a deliberate multi-quarter pursuit motion rather than a high-volume funnel.

You are a commercial, closer-minded operator who builds a book through platform partnerships, industry events, and targeted senior-level outreach -- and who also fields and closes the enterprise inbound that arrives in your practice. You will become the person the market associates with Darkroom's media offering: in the platform partner ecosystems, at the industry events that matter, and in the rooms where these deals get done.

You will also own the upsell and cross-sell motion for your departments -- working the existing client base alongside our Managing Directors and strategy leadership to identify and close expansion into media, creator, and creative.

This is a high-accountability role with clear revenue KPIs and uncapped commission that rewards self-sourced pipeline. If you want to own the media practice, build a durable enterprise network, and close tech-enabled marketing services you believe in, this is the role for you.



Location: NYC strongly preferred.




YOUR PRACTICE

You own new business and expansion across three service clusters. The first leads; the second two attach.

Lead with:

 - Paid Media -- full-funnel media strategy and management across Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, and programmatic/CTV; measurement and incrementality; media-linked variable engagements on enterprise budgets.

Attach and expand into:

 - Creator -- creator and UGC content programs, affiliate and whitelisting, ambassador programs, and creator-led acquisition that feeds paid.

 - Performance Creative -- creative strategy, static and video production, and the testing and iteration cadence that keeps paid media scaling.

You will build deep fluency in all three, the platforms behind them, and the buyer in each -- so that when a brand says "our CAC is climbing and we don't know why," "we need a creator engine before Q4," or "our creative can't keep up with spend," you are already scoping the deal. You will also carry the Shadow story into these conversations, since our AI commerce layer is a material part of why enterprise brands choose us over a category specialist.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Primary -- Source and close new business, media-first

 - Own a quarterly new-business number across the media practice, led by paid media, denominated in quota credit (base retainer plus a share of the media-linked variable fee), so enterprise deals count like enterprise deals.

 - Build and work a partner ecosystem as a durable referral engine -- Meta, Google, and TikTok agency partner programs, measurement and attribution platforms (MMM, incrementality, and attribution vendors), Shopify Plus and enterprise commerce platforms, creator and affiliate platforms, and the private equity and brand holdco operating networks that control enterprise marketing budgets.

 - Represent Darkroom at industry events and conferences in your practice (Cannes Lions, Possible, Shoptalk, CommerceNext, Adweek, the Meta / Google / TikTok partner summits, and the creator-economy events where enterprise creator programs get decided), and build the senior relationships that surface deals.

 - Develop and pursue a named enterprise target ("whale") list of brands that fit the media practice, alongside a category focus defined during your first 30 days (beauty, apparel, CPG, consumer tech, health, subscription, etc.).

 - Field and close enterprise inbound that arrives in your practice.

 - Run a deliberate attach motion on every new deal: land the media engagement, then scope creator and performance creative into the same relationship rather than leaving it for later.

 - Lead the full commercial process: discovery, media audit, scoping, pricing, proposal, negotiation, and close, working within the deal desk guardrails.

 - Work with our marketing team to understand inbound strategy across content, creators, SEO, and other deal sources.

Primary -- Own the upsell & cross-sell motion

 - Run a standing weekly expansion meeting with the Managing Directors of your assigned departments and strategy leadership, where you work the client base for upsell and cross-sell opportunities and drive the flagged deals to close.

 - The MDs surface the opportunity from delivery insight; strategy clears account health and capacity; you own the commercial motion and the close.

 - Proactively identify expansion through client conversations, performance data, and account signals -- you are the person the account team calls when an opportunity emerges.

Secondary -- Practice fluency and onboarding

 - Maintain deep, current command of Darkroom's media service catalog -- paid media, creator, and performance creative -- and the platforms behind it.

 - Be present on onboarding calls for new clients in your practice to establish the expansion relationship from day one.

 - Maintain clean pipeline documentation in HubSpot and Notion (Sourced By, Closed By, Origination, Expected Monthly Variable Fee, deal stages) -- comp is calculated off these fields.


WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

 - High-volume cold prospecting for net-new logos outside your practice -- that is the outbound BDR's function. You source through partnerships, events, and targeted senior relationships.

 - Deliver QBRs.

 - Execute campaign changes, creative production, or optimizations -- that is the account team's responsibility.
   
   


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

 - 7+ years in a full-cycle Account Executive or equivalent sales role with a documented record of closing enterprise-scale deals. Agency, media, AdTech/MarTech, or SaaS experience strongly preferred.

 - Media credibility. You can hold your own with a VP of Growth or CMO -- CAC and LTV, incrementality and MMM, platform mechanics across Meta, Google, and TikTok, creative testing cadence, and creator-led acquisition -- and you can speak fluently enough about creator programs and performance creative to earn a technical buyer's trust.

 - Closer DNA. You have carried an enterprise quota and closed new-business and expansion deals with long cycles and multiple stakeholders. You are energized by revenue outcomes, and you source your own pipeline rather than waiting for leads.

 - Multi-service instinct. You do not sell one line item. You see the whole growth engine -- media, creator, creative -- and build the deal accordingly.

 - Network-builder. You know how to turn platform partners, holdco relationships, and conferences into a durable enterprise pipeline rather than one-off business cards.

 - Commercially instinctive. When you hear "we're consolidating agencies next year" or "our board wants CAC down 20%," you are already scoping the deal.

 - Self-directed operator. Highly organized, proactive, fast-moving. You do not need to be managed into motion.

 - Tool-proficient. HubSpot (or equivalent CRM), Notion, Google Workspace, Slack; comfortable reading performance data and dashboards, including ad platform and attribution reporting.

 - Polished communicator. Fluent English, strong video presence, comfortable presenting to founders, CMOs, and heads of growth at enterprise and growth-stage brands.


HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

 - Quarterly new-business quota attainment (quota credit: new MRR plus a share of variable, per the Sales Quota & Commission Plan).

 - Media-led new business closed.

 - Attach rate -- share of new media deals that land with creator and/or performance creative attached.

 - Average deal size and named-target ("whale") conversion.

 - Upsell and cross-sell revenue closed.

 - Self-sourced pipeline generated (partnerships, events, outbound relationships).

 - Enterprise inbound deals closed in your practice.

 - Pipeline hygiene in HubSpot.
   
   


WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AT DARKROOM

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership -- and we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape -- just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

 - Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

jobs.title: Recruiter (Full-time, Contract)
jobs.description:
About us

Pomelo Care is the leading virtual medical practice for women and children, providing care across pregnancy, postpartum, pediatrics, menopause, and perimenopause. We combine proactive, 24/7 clinical care with technology that helps us reach patients earlier, identify risks sooner, and deliver personalized care throughout their journey. Our team includes clinicians, technologists, operators, and problem-solvers working together to make high-quality care more accessible for families nationwide.

As a Recruiter at Pomelo Care, you will serve as an adaptable talent generalist who can jump in wherever our hiring needs are greatest. Whether driving full-cycle hires, running high-volume searches, or stepping in to provide targeted sourcing support for fellow recruiters, you thrive on variety and cross-functional impact.

We are looking for a self-starter with a no task too small attitude, someone who moves easily between different orgs across the business, rolls up their sleeves to hunt for great talent, and brings grit and flexibility to a fast-paced startup environment.

What you'll do:

• Own the end-to-end recruitment process for high volume roles managing everything from initial pipeline generation and screening to extending offers.

• Proactively identify and engage passive top-tier talent using creative sourcing strategies. Act as a talent partner by also providing sourcing support to other recruiters on the team to help close priority roles.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring managers maintaining strong alignment on candidate profiles, provide regular pipeline updates, and guide teams through the interview and offer stages.

• Function as a highly autonomous self-starter, managing your own desk and prioritizing your workload effectively to meet hiring targets without needing heavy oversight.

• Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience while maintaining accurate, up-to-date documentation and data hygiene within our ATS.

Who you are:

• 3+ years of successful full-cycle recruiting experience with a track record of filling high-volume roles.

• Proven experience thriving in a fast-paced startup environment. You are comfortable with ambiguity and can easily pivot as business needs evolve.

• Comfortable navigating ATS platforms (Greenhouse or Ashby) and resourceful in how you find talent. You think beyond standard searches to build strong candidate pipelines.

• Deeply resourceful, highly organized, and capable of working independently in a remote environment while keeping communication channels open with the broader team.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to advise and build fast trust with cross-functional leaders.

Why you should join our team

By joining Pomelo, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast-moving, well-funded, and mission-driven startup that always puts the patient first. You will learn, grow and be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it.

We strive to create an environment where employees from all backgrounds are respected. We value working across disciplines, moving fast, data-driven decision making, learning, and always putting the patient first.

Benefits and Perks:

• Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage for employees and their families

• High deductible Health Plans with Health Savings Account (HSA) options

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• 401(k) program

• Competitive vacation policy

• Fully remote work flexibility (within the US)

Compensation:

This is a 3-month temporary role with the potential to extend or hire full-time. The expected base salary range offered for this role is $100,000-$110,000. Actual compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

At Pomelo, we are committed to hiring the best team to improve outcomes for all mothers and babies, regardless of their background. We need diverse perspectives to reflect the diversity of problems we face and the population we serve. We look to hire people from a variety of backgrounds, including but not limited to race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, disability, and veteran status.

Potential Fraud Warning

Please be cautious of potential recruitment fraud. With the increase of remote work and digital hiring, phishing and job scams are on the rise with malicious actors impersonating real employees and sending fake job offers in an effort to collect personal or financial information.

Pomelo Care will never ask you to pay a fee or download software as part of the interview process with our company. Pomelo Care will also never ask for your personal banking or other financial information until after you have signed an offer of employment and completed onboarding paperwork that is provided by our People Operations team. All official communication with Pomelo Care People Operations team will come from domain email addresses ending in @pomelocare.com.

If you receive a message that seems suspicious, we encourage you to pause communication and contact us directly at careers@pomelocare.com to confirm its legitimacy. For your safety, we also recommend applying only through our official Careers page. If you believe you have been the victim of a scam or identity theft, please contact your local law enforcement agency or another trusted authority for guidance.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
YOUR TURN TO START THE CONVERSATION.


WRITE THE FUTURE AT RASA.

Conversation. It’s the thread between our product and our people. The tool that enables us to forge relationships through compassion and expertise. To find the connection between our differences. It keeps us close together across borders and backgrounds and helps us create our shared vision.

Rasa means tight-knit. We get to the point and have the courage to ask ‘why?’. Because through relentless experimentation, passion, and vision, we’re transforming the way people interact with organizations through AI.

That’s Rasa. That’s our message.

Join us and add yours.




SUMMARY

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Go-to-market team. Your main goal will be to establish strong, scalable customer relationships that drive adoption, retention, and expansion You will be reporting to the Head of Customer Success.

Full-time - 100% remote - Location: USA, East Coast

We are hiring a Customer Success Manager to support our company's growth by investing in our customers' success, driving retention and expansion, and ensuring customers achieve long-term value.  - You’ve held a technical role in the past, or regularly worked in a customer-facing role with technical / IT stakeholders; you can handle technical conversations and know when/how to escalate.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Trial Manager (Contract)
jobs.description:
Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company, is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa’s lead investigational candidate – cleminorexton (formerly ORX750) – is being developed for narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions.

Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as a Great Place to Work® in 2026.

Description of Role

Centessa is seeking a (contract-to-hire) Senior Clinical Trial Manager (Sr. CTM) to lead the execution of global clinical studies from startup through closeout and clinical study report. This role is a temporary position with the potential to convert to a permanent role, accountable for study delivery, including operational strategy, timelines, budget, quality, vendor oversight, risk management, and inspection readiness. This individual in this role will lead cross-functional teams and manage CROs and external vendors to ensure studies are conducted efficiently, compliantly, and in alignment with program objectives.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the planning, execution, and oversight of global clinical trials from startup through closeout.

• Serve as the primary operational lead for assigned studies, driving cross-functional alignment and execution.

• Develop and manage study timelines, budgets, enrollment forecasts, risk mitigation plans, and key performance metrics.

• Oversee CROs and external vendors to ensure delivery against scope, quality standards, timelines, and budget.

• Drive critical study milestones, including site activation, enrollment, database lock, and study closeout.

• Review and approve study plans, vendor deliverables, and trial documentation to ensure compliance with protocol, GCP, and regulatory requirements.

• Identify operational risks and issues, implement mitigation strategies, and escalate as appropriate.

• Lead study team meetings and provide regular updates to stakeholders and senior management.

• Ensure Trial Master File (TMF) quality, completeness, and inspection readiness throughout the study lifecycle.

• Support regulatory submissions, audits, inspections, and Health Authority interactions.

• Contribute to process improvements and mentor junior clinical operations team members as needed.

• Collaborate effectively with global teams, investigators, CROs, and vendors across multiple regions.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in a scientific, health-related, or equivalent discipline required.

• 8+ years of clinical research experience, including 5+ years of clinical trial management experience within a sponsor or CRO environment. 2+ years of managing Phase 1 Healthy Volunteer studies.

• Experience in standard clinical pharmacology package studies such as: First in Human, Drug to Drug Interaction, Human Absorption, Metabolism, Excretion and Mass Balance, Relative Bioavailability, Bioequivalence, Organ Impairment, Abuse Liability studies.

• Demonstrated experience independently leading Phase 1 studies, global Phase II and/or Phase III clinical trials.

• Experience managing CROs, CRUs, central vendors, and cross-functional study teams.

• Neuroscience/CNS clinical development experience preferred.

• Experience supporting inspection readiness, audits, and regulatory interactions preferred.

Compensation

The hourly range for this position is $70.00 to $100.00 per hour. Individual compensation within this range will be determined based on a variety of factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and job knowledge.

Contractors engaged through Centessa are employed through a third-party agency that serves as the employer of record and provides access to a comprehensive benefits package. Eligible contractors may enroll in medical plans, including PPO and EPO options, as well as dental and vision coverage after 30 days. Additional perks, such as a 401(k), wellness programs, and other discounts, may also be available to eligible contractors.

Work Location

The Senior Clinical Trial Manager role is a based in the US (Remote), with occasional travel required.

POSITION: Temporary, non-exempt

We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. 

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup https://sifted.eu/leaderboards/sifted-future-50-2025 in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben https://www.linkedin.com/in/ben-freeman-a8542166/, Abs https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhirukt/, Sabrina https://www.linkedin.com/in/scastiglione/, and Rebe https://www.linkedin.com/in/rebecatristan/.



FIND OUT MORE ABOUT THE TEAM AND LIFE AT OMNEA HERE https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpjeHyocsu3ZoDn3sfODjqIR2L_DW3dgb. 


THE ROLE

AI is changing what it means to run enterprise pre-sales. Building a custom demo, standing up a proof-of-concept environment, or drafting responses to a security questionnaire used to mean days of manual configuration and copy-paste from old RFP answers. Increasingly, that first-draft work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI can generate demo environments, draft PoC configurations, and produce a first pass on technical RFP responses.

The job shifts with it. Instead of building every demo and proof point from scratch, you specify exactly what a prospect needs to see, direct AI to build the first draft, and apply the judgment AI can't: does this PoC actually prove the thing this customer's IT security team will ask about, does this demo reflect how their approval hierarchy actually works, is this RFP answer technically accurate or just plausible-sounding.

As Omnea's AI Sales Engineer, you're the technical authority in our enterprise sales process, working alongside Sales to win some of the world's largest companies. You run discovery, build and direct demos and PoCs, and become the trusted technical advisor a prospect leans on to decide whether Omnea is real. You're deep in the modern finance and procurement stack - ERPs, CLMs, GRC, AP automation - and you use that expertise to judge what AI produces, not just to present it.

This is a foundational hire on our Sales Engineering team, working closely with Sales, Product, and the Customer team who take a deal from signed to live.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own technical discovery and demos: Run technical discovery sessions with prospects, direct AI to build a first-draft demo environment tailored to what you've learned, then adapt it based on what only a human would catch - a workflow quirk, a compliance requirement, a stakeholder's pet objection.

 - Drive PoCs end to end: Scope and own proof-of-concepts in collaboration with Product and the Customer team, directing AI to configure the environment fast and applying your own judgment on whether the PoC actually proves what the prospect needs to see to move forward.

 - Answer the hard technical and security questions: Direct AI to draft first-pass responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires, then validate every answer against the prospect's actual requirements - a wrong answer here can lose the deal or create a problem after signature.

 - Be the bridge between Sales, Product, and Customer: Translate what you're hearing in the field into product feedback, and hand off cleanly to the Customer team so nothing gets lost between a signed contract and a live deployment.

 - Build the pre-sales toolkit: Keep demo environments, technical documentation, and RFP libraries sharp, using AI to draft and refresh materials as the product evolves, and refining what works based on what's actually landing with prospects.


ABOUT YOU

We don't expect you to know how to do all of this on day one. TL;DR: you're technical enough to be a genuine authority in the room, customer-facing enough to be trusted by a CFO or a CISO, and comfortable directing AI to do the heavy lifting so you can focus on the judgment calls only you can make.

 - 3-7 years in sales engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting, ideally in B2B SaaS

 - Ideally you have experience in the modern finance or procurement stack - you understand procurement and AP automation, and have demoed, implemented, or administered tools like ERPs, CLMs, or GRC platforms

 - Comfortable directing AI tools to produce first-draft demos, configurations, and RFP responses, with the judgment to catch what's wrong before a prospect sees it

 - A strong technical foundation: you can learn a complex software platform fast and go deep enough to answer hard security and architecture questions

 - An excellent communicator who can simplify technical concepts for multiple stakeholders from CFO, CPO to CISO. 

 - A proactive problem-solver with real troubleshooting instincts and a customer-first mindset

 - Comfortable owning RFPs, RFIs, and IT security questionnaires end to end, including the technical requirements that come with them

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.




A FEW THINGS TO NOTE: 

 - We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here https://www.notion.so/omnea/UK-Benefits-at-Omnea-36c88cce658781c39d08ee947693506f and our US Benefits Package here https://www.notion.so/omnea/US-Benefits-at-Omnea-36c88cce658781b49890e725794c0af1. 

 - We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices.
