jobs.title: Director, People Partnering
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

About this Role

We are currently planning for a significant increase in scale, and we are building the People function that can carry it.

This is a new role with two halves. First half: you will be the dedicated people partner to our Global Shared Services (GSS) teams [~200 employees], who do not have one today, working primarily with people leaders on structure, workforce planning, talent, and the people decisions that come with growth. You will partner with and coach senior leaders across GSS, up to VP level, including those who are strong operators still growing as people leaders. Second half: you will build how we handle behavior and performance concerns across the organization: the standards, the decision framework, and the enablement that lets people managers and our HR teams in the field handle them well.

The first year is weighted toward that build, with partnering also focused on performance and talent management as the most pressing needs. As the standards land, the balance shifts toward deeper partnering, while you continue to own the employee relations model.

The reason for this weight: the employee relations build is our most acute gap today, but should not be construed as a ceiling of the job. Over time, the partnering half opens up well beyond performance and conduct into org design, workforce planning, talent, career development, and the full range of people strategy for our global functions. We're hiring a broad, senior people partner who can build the ER model as their first major deliverable, not an employee relations specialist. If your instinct on reading this is that the ER work is the whole job, this role probably isn't the right fit, and the reverse is also true: if you're only interested in the strategic partnering and not the build, year one will frustrate you.

Job type: Full-time

Reports to: Head of People

Level: Director

Location: Remote, with a requirement to overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours, and meaningful overlap with US Eastern hours. We can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

Travel: Approximately 3-4 trips per year, including at least one to a country of operation and one to a key in-person leadership moment, with occasional additional travel as sensitive or time-critical situations require.

What you'll do

• Partner with our Global team: Act as the trusted advisor to GSS leaders (managers up to VPs) on anything involving their people: how their teams are structured, who they need, who is at risk, and what is not working. Some of this is work the Head of People holds today and will hand over as you establish credibility. Lead org design and workforce planning for global functions as we scale: structure, role definition, levels, sizing and sequencing, in partnership with function leads, Finance and Talent Acquisition. Own talent and succession for the population: who is ready for more, who is a flight risk, and where the single points of failure sit. Partner on performance and compensation decisions for global staff, including calibration, promotion cases and band placement. Coach senior leaders, on their own leadership as much as on their teams. Lead people-side change for global functions: restructures, leadership transitions, and the team-level fallout of both. Act as the People representative for global staff, holding employment decisions within our framework in the way HR Managers do in their countries. Coach global managers through behavior and performance conversations, rather than taking those conversations from them.

• Build how we handle behavior and underperformance: Define what these categories actually are and communicate them across the organization, so that a concern can be routed rather than defaulting into a disciplinary process. Audit how each country handles cases end to end, and write one global standard per category covering intake, escalation, who is responsible at each stage, and documentation. Build from what already works and flex only where local law genuinely requires it. Build the employment decision framework with Legal, including a delegated authority matrix setting out who decides what and when, and the escalation route when a case falls outside it. Design and deliver enablement for the three groups who have to use all of this: managers, HR Managers, and staff. Work with our central investigations function to stand up a single record of outcomes, so that patterns and inconsistencies become visible. Within your first 90 days, recommend who should support behavior and underperformance cases in each country, and what that requires.

• Hold consistency across the organization: Coach HR Managers through cases in their countries, and act as the technical escalation point when they need one. Provide the People input at triage on which category a concern belongs in. Watch outcomes as they accumulate, and raise it when something looks inconsistent: comparable facts resolving differently, one country diverging, or a pattern clustering around a team or a manager.

What this role is not:

• Not an investigations role. Misconduct investigations sit with our Central Intake and Investigations Hub. We would want you to have investigative capability we can draw on for surge, or for cases where the hub is conflicted, but it is not the job and someone who wants to investigate will be frustrated here.

• Not a caseload role. Cases in country belong to managers and to HR Managers. Your value is standards, judgment and partnership, not throughput.

• Not the owner of performance management or manager development. Those sit with our Talent Management function. You define what managers need to know about employee relations; they own the curriculum and the channel.

Who we're looking for:

Required:

• 7+ years of HR business partner experience with executive and senior leaders, including coaching leaders who were strong in their domain but needed to grow as people leaders, and holding a position when it was unpopular.

• You have done this in a scale-up or a major transformation. An organization that was growing fast, restructuring, or both, where the systems you needed did not exist and you built them while the volume was already arriving. We are not looking for steady-state operating experience.

• Demonstrated experience building employee relations standards, policy or frameworks from scratch or close to it, and getting them adopted across multiple countries or business units. A mix of high-growth commercial or tech experience and international or mission-driven experience. The role needs the speed and build instinct of the first and the operating complexity of the second, and we think it is hard to do well with only one.

• Experience holding or closely advising on disciplinary and capability decisions, including dismissals, in more than one jurisdiction, with the judgment to know when to bring in counsel.

• A track record of influencing without formal authority in a matrixed organization.

• Judgment and steadiness. You can hold a position with a senior leader, be wrong in public when you are, and stay trusted either way.

Preferred:

• Experience operating in sub-Saharan Africa.

• Experience building a people function, or a major part of one, from the ground up.

• Formal training or real experience in workplace investigations, as reserve capability rather than a core part of the role.

• Experience designing manager enablement content.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

• Base Salary: $134,400

• Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$20,160, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $23,587 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $154,560+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

• Base Salary: £94,695

• Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~£14,191, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be £16,603 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: £108,796+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

• Base Salary: $106,282

• Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$15,942, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $18,652 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $122,224+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,453

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (SQL & dbt)
jobs.description:
This role is part of our Central Data & BI Team at saas.group.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our small Central Data & BI Team. Together, we look after the data warehouse, dbt models, and analysis that saas.group leadership, Finance, our acquisitions team, and our portfolio companies rely on. Most of the work happens in SQL and dbt rather than in reporting tools.

The context changes a lot. Each of our portfolio companies has its own billing setup, data quirks, and questions. A large part of the work is due diligence on companies we're considering acquiring: taking data we've never seen before and turning it into figures that acquisition decisions rely on, often under a deadline. If you enjoy that kind of variety, you won't get bored here. If you prefer going deep on a single product for years, this probably isn't the right fit.

This is a hands-on role, but it isn't about typing as much SQL as possible. We already use AI agents extensively for implementation work. What we need is an experienced data person who can take an unclear business question to a result people can trust, question assumptions (including ours), and share real ownership of the platform. You'll be a sparring partner on approaches and trade-offs.

This is an individual-contributor role without people management.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

• Get to know our data platform end to end, from ingestion with extract-and-load tools to transformation in dbt and the core SaaS metrics built on top, and start handling incoming data requests independently

• Take ownership of production data issues, working out whether an unexpected number reflects a real business change or a source, ingestion, or modelling problem

• Deliver model changes and analyses from the initial question to a validated result, working directly with our portfolio companies, Finance, and saas.group leadership

• Support due diligence on potential acquisitions by turning unfamiliar billing and customer data into reliable revenue and customer figures

Your responsibilities

• Own requests end to end: clarify the question, assess the source data, investigate existing logic, build or change models, validate the result, and explain what it means and where its limits are

• Build and maintain production dbt models for billing, subscriptions, customers, recurring revenue, retention, and related SaaS metrics

• Build and maintain Metabase dashboards, reusable questions, and recurring reporting, alongside ad hoc analysis

• Monitor data quality and freshness, reconcile figures, and trace discrepancies back through transformation and ingestion to the source system

• Maintain source integrations in Airbyte, including custom connectors, and onboard data from newly acquired companies

• Process unfamiliar and often incomplete billing, customer, and revenue datasets for due diligence on potential acquisitions, often under time pressure

• Use AI tools as a normal part of development, investigation, and documentation: frame the problem, provide the right context, review the output, validate it against real data, and keep sensitive data protected

• Bring an independent view to decisions about models, metrics, and priorities, and challenge assumptions when something doesn't add up

• Document important definitions, source behaviour, limitations, and repeatable workflows

What You bring to the table

• 3+ years in hands-on data roles where SQL, rather than spreadsheets or BI tools, was your main tool

• Real production experience building and maintaining data models with dbt or a similar code-based workflow, with version control and review, not just a course or side project

• Comfortable reviewing code, including in languages you don't write every day such as Python: you can tell whether it does what it should and whether a simpler solution would do

• Experience tracing data from a source system through ingestion and transformation into a business answer, and telling a genuine business change apart from a data problem

• Sound analytical judgment and the habit of checking whether a result makes sense before you share it

• Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and the confidence to push back and form your own view

• Ownership of real outcomes: you prioritise independently, stay calm when production issues come up, and follow through

• Hands-on, daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) in real data work, with the judgment to spot bad assumptions and verify the output yourself

• Curiosity about unfamiliar systems: you don't need to know every tool we use, but you learn quickly and ask good questions

• Fluent written and spoken English

• Able to work Central European hours, so you can collaborate with the team in real time

Nice to have: SaaS subscription metrics such as MRR, ARR, churn, expansion, NDR, GDR, cohorts, and customer lifetime; billing systems such as Stripe, Chargebee, Recurly, or Paddle; PostgreSQL and Airbyte; understanding how APIs and data connectors work (authentication, pagination, rate limits, incremental syncs); supporting several products or business units with different source systems and definitions; acquisition due diligence or other work with unfamiliar datasets under time pressure.

What’s in it for You

• Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.

• Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.

• Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.

• Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.

• Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.

• Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

jobs.title: Sr. Launch Engineer
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

The Sr. Launch Engineer is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing all launch activities associated with new vehicle programs, engineering changes, and manufacturing readiness. This role serves as a key interface between Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Logistics, Program Management, and Product Development teams to ensure successful vehicle launches from concept through Start of Production (SOP). The Launch Sr. Engineer leads readiness assessments, build event coordination, issue management, validation activities, and operational readiness execution to ensure safety, quality, cost, timing, and volume objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

Launch Planning & Readiness:

• Support the development and execution of launch plans for new vehicle programs and major product changes.

• Update launch deliverables, milestones, and readiness criteria.

• Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure launch requirements are achieved.

• Monitor launch timing and escalate risks that may impact program objectives.

• Support Open-to-Go assessments and build readiness reviews.

Build Event Coordination:

• Lead preparation and execution of prototype, pilot, validation, and production builds.

• Coordinate vehicle scheduling and build plans with all participating functions.

• Ensure materials, tooling, equipment, manpower, and documentation are available and ready.

• Facilitate daily build reviews and issue resolution meetings.

• Track build performance metrics and lessons learned.

Issue Management & Problem Resolution:

• Collect, document, prioritize, and monitor launch-related issues.

• Drive closure plans with responsible teams.

• Utilize structured problem-solving methodologies to resolve launch issues.

• Escalate critical issues to leadership when required.

• Track issue trends and support management reporting.

Manufacturing Readiness:

• Assess manufacturing process readiness against launch requirements.

• Support validation of equipment, tooling, automation, software, and production systems.

• Verify operational readiness of manufacturing shops.

• Ensure readiness metrics are achieved prior to production milestones.

Product & Process Validation:

• Support new product introduction (NPI) activities.

• Coordinate vehicle and process validation builds.

• Ensure engineering changes are properly implemented and validated.

• Track launch quality metrics and process capability indicators.

• Support root cause analysis and corrective action implementation.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

• Facilitate communication between Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management, Logistics, and Supplier teams.

• Drive alignment on launch priorities and deliverables.

• Lead launch meetings and action-item tracking.

• Provide launch status updates to management and executive leadership.

Reporting & Governance:

• Develop launch readiness dashboards and reports.

• Maintain launch scorecards and milestone trackers.

• Support Launch Governance Reviews and executive launch reporting.

• Present launch status, risks, countermeasures, and recovery plans.

Continuous Improvement:

• Capture lessons learned from launch activities.

• Support development of launch standards and best practices.

• Identify opportunities to improve launch efficiency and risk management processes.

• Contribute to future program readiness and organizational learning.

Skills

• Deep understanding of vehicle assembly.

• Understanding of APQP principles

• Aware of Project management fundamentals

• Experience with Data analysis and reporting tools

• Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint)

• Experience launching manufacturing and production lines.

• Hands-on experience with process validation, commissioning, and manufacturing quality systems.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering (Master’s preferred).

• 5-8 years of experience in automotive manufacturing.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Field Technician
jobs.description:
The Field Technician position is responsible for the pick-up and delivery of water, soil and air samples to and from the laboratory. As a field technician you will also be responsible for maintaining the quality, hold time, and turnaround time for all recieved and delievered samples and materials assigned to the lab.

This is an exciting fast paced field position that will request the abillity to drive repeatedly throughout your scheduled day.

• Prepare and deliever bottle orders to clients following the standard operating procedure of the lab.
• Receive and stock all sample control supplies, prepare and ship sample kits and perform sampling events as needed.
• Dispose of samples and hazardous waste according to guidelines and carry out any other duties assigned by the department manager.
• Assists with routine and non-routine sampling, monitoring, and data collection activities in support of environmental monitoring programs and client service requests
• Perform on-site sampling events as needed
• Pick up and deliver samples, bottle orders and report to the laboratory for sign-in and analysis.
• Count the number of samples when receiving them from clients to make sure that the Chain of Custody and samples match. Verify that samples are not broken or damaged.
• Receive and sign the Chain of Custody.
• Ensure that client signs, dates, and records time on the Chain of Custody when releasing samples.
• Unload samples and inspect for damage or violated hold times to maintain sample integrity
• Transport samples on ice from client site to the lab, or from our lab to a sub- contracted laboratory
• Interact with Project Managers and clients appropriately and professionally.
• Follow directions or use maps to locate client offices/sites as specified in the courier request form.
• Communicate effectively with the courier coordinator about the courier schedule.
• Record in the courier log book the time that courier arrives to the site and time leaving from the site for all the pick-ups and deliveries
• Maintain records for the vehicle maintenance and driving miles; turn it in at the end of each month.
• Restock supplies when received so supplies are available to employees when needed.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, CDN Configuration Group
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: London

About Engineering at Cloudflare

Cloudflare's Engineering team is responsible for the software platform that serves tens of millions of HTTP requests per second on average. We also build and run the tools that empower our colleagues to rapidly deliver products to market, as well as monitor and deploy software updates across the globe to over 200+ data centers. You'll experience the full breadth of technologies needed to run one of the world's largest networks serving the world's largest customers such as Shopify and VISA.

About The Team

The CDN Configuration team oversees the end-to-end configuration ecosystem across our edge platform. Our core mission is delivering a coherent, safe, highly performant, and resilient experience that empowers customers to modify their traffic routing with absolute confidence. We enable users to build and tailor their own virtual network by rapidly generating settings and deploying updates globally without friction. While core teams engineer individual edge components, our group architecturally unifies these capabilities, enabling customers to seamlessly orchestrate their entire pipeline.

What you'll do

Collaborating with skilled software professionals, you will deliver robust mechanisms that grant users total governance and safety across their network settings. Your focus involves architecting services that let users seamlessly prototype, execute, evaluate, and discard tailored traffic rules, ensuring optimal alignment with their operational requirements. This scope extends far beyond a solitary codebase; you will directly interface with distributed edge platforms, partnering with cross-functional groups to streamline and fortify our global infrastructure.

In this role, you will stand at the intersection of core application deployment and infrastructure operations, driving technical alignment alongside engineering peers across the organization.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• Solid competencies in practical computer science, applying the right algorithms, data structures, concurrency control systems to software design, and building large, distributed systems

• Experience operating production systems safely — deployment, rollout, rollback, and observability

• Driving communication and consensus across teams

• A drive for continuous improvement when it comes to both operations and new product development

Bonus Points

These are things which the role is likely to require; we're happy to help you learn on the job, but prior experience is beneficial

• Experience of languages: Rust, Go

• Knowledge of web servers and web protocols

• Distributed systems, and distributed configuration or state-distribution systems

• Experience with safe deployment: progressive rollout, versioning/snapshots, CI/CD

• Web security issues and industry standards

Most importantly, we are looking for people who want to learn something new. We maintain the largest web server in the world, and we face unique challenges. You will be collaborating and designing innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people around the globe, everywhere they are, whatever their needs are.

Join and help us build a better Internet!

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

The Senior Vice President, People Strategy & Operations serves as a senior enterprise HR leader responsible for translating business strategy into scalable people solutions that drive growth, performance, leadership effectiveness, and operational excellence.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, this role acts as a strategic partner to executive leadership while overseeing the operational infrastructure of the People function. The SVP will lead the integration of people strategy, workforce planning, talent operations, employee experience, communications, compliance, and HR service delivery to ensure the organization operates as one enterprise.

This leader will balance long-term workforce strategy with disciplined execution, building scalable processes, modern operating models, and high-performing teams that enable business growth and strengthen organizational capability.

The role serves as a key advisor to the CPO and may act as the functional leader in the absence of the CPO.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise People Strategy

• Partner with executive leadership to align workforce strategy with business priorities, growth objectives, and organizational transformation initiatives.

• Help shape and operationalize the enterprise people agenda across talent, leadership, culture, engagement, workforce capability, and organizational effectiveness.

• Drive enterprise-wide consistency while enabling flexibility across business units where appropriate.

• Lead strategic workforce planning efforts tied to capability needs, market demands, and business growth.

• Support organizational design initiatives that improve scalability, accountability, and decision-making effectiveness.

HR Operations & Service Delivery

• Oversee the operational infrastructure of the People function, ensuring efficient, scalable, and compliant delivery of HR services globally.

• Establish operational standards, governance practices, metrics, and service-level expectations across the HR organization.

• Drive simplification, automation, modernization of HR processes and technologies, and adoption of self-service capabilities.

• Ensure operational readiness to support acquisitions, integrations, reorganizations, and rapid growth.

Leadership & Talent Enablement

• Partner with business leaders to strengthen leadership capability, succession readiness, and enterprise thinking across the organization.

• Support the development of high-performing teams and performance-driven cultures.

• Drive integration across talent acquisition, learning and development, performance management, and career growth initiatives.

• Champion initiatives that improve employee engagement, retention, internal mobility, and workforce capability.

Employee Experience & Communications

• Oversee enterprise employee communications and engagement strategies that reinforce culture, transparency, and alignment.

• Ensure employees have a clear understanding of organizational priorities, expectations, career opportunities, and rewards.

• Partner with leadership to strengthen trust, organizational connection, and change adoption during periods of transformation.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with employment laws, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards across all jurisdictions.

• Partner with legal and finance leaders to mitigate workforce-related risk while enabling business agility.

• Maintain strong controls related to compensation administration, payroll, employee relations, policy management, and workforce data governance.

Metrics, Analytics & Business Insights

• Establish meaningful workforce metrics and reporting that provide executives with actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making.

• Monitor trends related to retention, productivity, engagement, hiring, workforce costs, organizational health, and leadership effectiveness.

• Use analytics to identify risks, opportunities, and operational improvements.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, including senior enterprise HR operational leadership

• Experience supporting complex, multi-business-unit, global, or high-growth organizations.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to connect workforce strategy to financial and operational outcomes.

• Demonstrated success leading HR operations, organizational transformation, and large-scale people initiatives.

• Experience advising executive leadership teams on organizational and workforce matters.

• Strong understanding of HR systems, analytics, compliance, payroll, and operational governance.

• Excellent communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management skills.

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

• SHRM-SCP; HRCI SPHR, GPHR

Preferred Experience

• Professional services, accounting advisory, consulting, staffing, investment banking & advisory firms, financial services, technology services or law firms.

• Private equity-backed or transformation-oriented environments.

• Multi-state and international workforce management.

• M&A integration, workforce scaling, and organizational redesign experience.

jobs.description:
Casual Employment: This is an as-needed position with flexible scheduling and no guaranteed hours. Shifts are assigned based on department staffing needs. Availability is needed to cover a variety of shifts and days, including weekdays and weekends.

Mobile Crisis Response Teams (MCRT) are community-based services that dispatch mental health professionals to safely de-escalate behavioral health crises on-site. They provide immediate evaluations, safety planning, and crisis stabilization as a trauma-informed alternative to law enforcement or emergency room visits.

The Recovery Support Specialist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Uses personal and training experience to create a safe space for consumers to calmly process crisis events, learn and apply wellness strategies, and prevent future crisis events. As a member of a multidisciplinary team, the Peer Recovery specialist operates from the Crisis Now concept and focuses on practices including recovery orientation, trauma-informed care, and a philosophy that crises are an opportunity for learning.   All services are designed to proactively divert crises and break the cycle of hospitalizations.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as an individual advocate for consumers.
• Utilize training and personal recovery experiences to provide peer support for consumers.
• Provide recovery information and activities to all consumers; information, resources and connection to natural supports; and must follow principles of trauma informed care.
• Assess and evaluate consumer’s needs, strengths, goals, and resources.
• As directed, transports consumers to and from home, appointments, meetings, and/or school.
• Advocate within systems to promote person centered recovery support services. Work with an interdisciplinary team in reviewing cases and developing individual plans.
• Implement individual service plans through rehabilitation services such as case management, advocacy, outreach, skills training groups (i.e. WRAP), social rehabilitation, and community support as indicated.
• Provide linkage case management, participate in treatment planning and discharge planning.
• Consult with other staff regarding assessment and treatment/intervention planning. Consults with licensed hospital professionals regarding clinical situations and maintains close communication with supervisor.
• Consult with other service agencies around case-specific and programmatic issues.
• Refer and link consumers to other human service programs and care providers as indicated.
• Serve as a liaison to other community agencies as needed.
• Build relationships with local police, fire, emergency departments, and other organizations to promote awareness of Living Room services.
• Provide on-site support and introduction to services to patients within the hospital and outpatient settings (e.g. Emergency Department, Medical Floors, etc.).
• Train other providers and non-providers in areas related to service specialties.
• Document service provision as required by NM standards.
• Maintain clinical and management records in accordance with established policies and procedures.
• Demonstrate ability to meet the productivity requirements set in accordance with program goals.
• Attend required staff and other meetings
• Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• High School Diploma or equivalent

• Valid Driver's License
• Proof of auto insurance.

 - Navigate multi-stakeholder sales cycles (6-12 months) involving technical champions (Developers, Architects) and economic buyers (C-Suite, LOB Heads)

 - Drive and prove technical capabilities and business value of Rasa’s platform

 - Forecast and manage your sales activity and pipeline to consistently hit revenue targets

 - Work closely with our customer success team and develop new opportunities for our existing customers

The role is:

Full-time - 100% Remote - Continental USA

You are excited about AI assistants, machine learning and letting people interact with machines through text and speech. You are an experienced self-starter who works well with little supervision. jobs.title: SVP of Marketing
jobs.description:
About airSlate
airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work. 
 
We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines. 
At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.


Today, in the age of AI, we are moving our products upmarket and innovating with new outcome
oriented AI-first products for SMBs and midmarket. We need to more intentionally connect with our
ICPs, create demand and sharpen our solution positioning, as opposed to just scooping up
existing demand. This new marketing muscle needs to infuse both our digital and sales assist
motion across our entire portfolio of products.

About the Marketin team
The marketing team handles comprehensive 360º communication and comprises over 130 people. We manage all aspects in-house and operate a robust automation engine. Our combined monthly traffic across all brands exceeds 31 million. 

About the role

As a SVP of Marketing, you'll own our entire marketing organization, serving all 4 BUs headed by their GMs, as well as the sales team. You'll inherit our center of excellence around SEM, SEO, affiliates and more generally
digital performance marketing. You'll build everything else that is still missing around the small
teams that have started exploring those functional areas: campaign and content strategy and
creation, b2b demand generation, proper email execution, etc. You'll also steer our marketing in the new
age of GAO, and together with our VP of Engineering and data teams you'll decide how to complete our martech infrastructure for the new needs, and build the new instrumentation and marketing analytics
required.

jobs.title: Partner Operations Representative
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

As a Partner Operations Representative, your role in our integration team is crucial for incorporating bill pay functionalities into our user-facing apps, ensuring seamless payment experiences for customers, agents, and businesses.

You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the reliability of these features, ensuring sufficient funding for our business accounts, and nurturing partnerships with collaborators.

We seek a proactive individual in The Gambia who embodies resourcefulness, determination, tenacity, diligence, and a results-driven mindset.

In this role, you'll;

• Manage operationally escalated cases by Support Teams.

• Effectively multitask and juggle multiple priorities.

Key details

• You'll work from our office in Kotu.

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.

• Free food and a beautiful office space.

• Highly organized, independent, and self-motivated.

• Have Proficiency in SQL is advantageous, though not mandatory.

Our team

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.

Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

Day In The Life

Workstream is building AI-native services that deliver completed business outcomes—mature service categories businesses already pay for, delivered by AI agents plus a small human review layer at materially better margins than the traditional alternative. We are validating the first service now with design customers from our existing base. You will be the first engineering hire on the delivery team, reporting to the Head of Delivery, AI-Native Services.

This is a forward-deployed builder role. You will embed with design customers, map their real workflows, and build the production agents, integrations, evaluations, and review tooling that turn that work into a reliable, repeatable service. You will see your systems do real work with real consequences for real people—and you will be on the hook when they misbehave.

You will not own pricing, deal acceptance, or the margin model—those sit with the Head of Delivery and the Head of GTM. You will own the components: whether they work, how they fail, and how fast bespoke work becomes reusable.

This is a full-time, hybrid position with 1 to 2 days a week in-office to support close cross-functional collaboration.

• Build and operate production agents and agentic workflows: orchestration, tool use, data connections, deterministic logic, state, and permissions.

• Work forward-deployed with design customers—sit in their workflow, map the messy reality, and build against live data.

• Build the evaluation harness: eval datasets from real customer work, pre-launch thresholds, regression suites, and post-launch monitoring.

• Build the human-review layer: exception queues, review tooling, escalation paths, and the tracing that makes every agent decision auditable.

• Run shadow-mode parallel runs against the customer's existing process or provider and drive discrepancies to zero before go-live.

• Turn customer-specific work into reusable agents, integrations, and playbooks—productization is the default, customization the exception.

• Handle production incidents end to end, and feed every failure back into evals and controls so it cannot recur.

• Help set the technical bar as the team grows.

Who You Are

• You have personally built and operated at least one AI agent or agentic workflow in production. You can clearly explain how it worked, where it failed, how you evaluated it, and what you kept deterministic or human-led.

• Strong engineering judgment across models, orchestration, APIs, data and integrations, permissions, observability, and evaluations.

• You have worked directly with customers or end users—discovery, implementation, or incident resolution—and communicate clearly with non-technical people.

• You can break a messy workflow into deterministic steps, agentic decisions, human judgment, and exception paths—and define how each part will be tested.

• You care about keeping plausible but wrong AI output away from customers: grounded context, constrained actions, verification, evals, review, monitoring.

• You thrive in zero-to-one ambiguity: shipping weekly, owning outcomes, and doing whatever the service needs—including unglamorous review tooling and data plumbing.

• Exposure to a regulated domain (payroll, payments, tax, benefits, labor compliance) is a plus, not a requirement.

• Demonstrated production experience matters more than title or years.

What We Offer

• A mission-driven and value-based company dedicated to empower deskless workers and local businesses

• An early employee opportunity at a Series B hyper-growth startup; work with the founding team and industry veterans to accelerate your career

• Competitive salary and equity

• Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision. We pay 95% of your premiums for our employees and 85% for dependents

• In office amenities and stocked kitchen

• 401K Plan

• Flexible PTO

Know More About Workstream

• https://techcrunch.com/2021/08/26/workstreams-text-based-recruitment-tool-gets-a-48m-bet-from-bond-and-beyond/

• https://techbuzz.news/buzzworthy-august-27-2021/

Additional Information

Workstream provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals.

jobs.title: Senior Business Systems Specialist
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Who We Are

The Farmer’s Dog was born from a mission to change the landscape of pet health, providing dogs and their humans with honest, smart, and simple care. We’re starting by radically improving the $90 billion pet food industry, replacing bags of highly-processed pellets with a personalized subscription service that sends complete and balanced, freshly-made dog food directly to customers’ doors. Our ultimate goal is to create innovative, delightful and personalized experiences across all aspects of pet care, and we believe our direct-to-consumer business model, holistic approach to growth, and dynamic culture uniquely position us to shepherd this backwards industry into the future.

To date, The Farmer’s Dog has delivered over 1 billion meals nationwide and raised over $150M in funding to help us build a company as healthy as the dogs who are eating those meals. Join us as we continue to develop ways of bringing peace of mind to customers, health to their companions, and much-needed change to the way people feed and care for their pets.

#LongLiveDogs

What We Stand For and Where You’ll Come In

The Senior Business Systems Specialist is responsible for the technical implementation, configuration, and integration of our core business systems including NetSuite, Coupa, and various retail partners across the organization. You will build and maintain integrations between NetSuite and marketplace/vendor platforms with Retail partners and procurement systems (Coupa), configure workflows to meet business requirements, troubleshoot data and integration issues, and ensure data integrity across connected systems. You'll partner with engineering, accounting and operations to manage technical project timelines, document system architecture, and drive adoption through hands-on technical enablement, delivering projects on time, within scope, and aligned to stakeholder requirements.

One Team: We don’t think of ourselves as “Acquisition Marketers”, “Engineers”, “Data Analysts”, or “Product Managers”. Beyond denoting skill sets and areas of expertise, we don’t think departments matter. We’d rather align ourselves to the goals we’re working to achieve and make sure we have necessary subject matter expertise to drive meaningful impact. We strive to orient ourselves around customer problems TOGETHER – getting the right people, with the right context, in the right rooms/Zooms to solve problems holistically.

We are skeptical about everything and precious about nothing:  Ideas can and should come from anywhere, and we aren’t tied to our own. We proactively source input. We talk to our customers and leads regularly and are quick to change course if we know there’s a better or more impactful way to solve problems.

We consider the customer journey in all of our decisions:  We know that no interaction exists in a silo and therefore understand how important every single one is.  We ensure our strategy sets prospective and new customers up for success and drives long-term retention.  We answer questions and address problems early and proactively.  We understand the value of different channels, initiatives, and messages and know how to articulate impact and advocate for prioritization holistically.

We Execute For Impact: We don’t subscribe to “best practices” or “industry KPIs”. We’re uninterested in how we compare to “benchmarks”; instead we orient ourselves around being the best we can possibly be. Similarly, we don’t subscribe to rigid or classical expectations of roles – i.e. acquisition is hyper-focused on improving customer retention and experience.

We Are Focused and Work Without Assumption: We are not beholden to ideas. We have goals and believe everything beyond that is a series of hypotheses to validate. To that end, we seek to work in sequence and not in parallel. We constantly ask ourselves, “what’s the most important hypothesis I should be working on right now? How do I confirm or reject that hypothesis as fast as possible?”. We rarely have timelines/deadlines and are constantly taking in new information and adjusting our priorities accordingly. We don’t expect to be perfect the first time.

How You'll Make An Impact

• Serve as the NetSuite functional and technical SME, providing guidance on system architecture, data integrity, and best practices for financial systems.

• Architect and maintain advanced dashboards, saved searches, and custom reports in NetSuite and dedicated BI tooling (Looker, Sigma, etc) to support real-time financial and inventory visibility across the organization.

• Gather requirements and lead a group of cross-functional stakeholders to architect, implement and support scalable technical solutions, including full system implementations.

• Collaborate with TFD’s engineering function on custom solutions inside and adjacent to our financial systems.

• Own the order-to-cash systems architecture for retail and marketplace channels

• Analyze existing financial and operational systems to identify inefficiencies and drive the implementation of automated, scalable solutions, and champion

• Implement automation and workflow optimizations using SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, and custom integrations.

• Contribute to the roadmap of financial tooling across TFD with respect to system stability, scalability, and anticipating the needs of the future.

• Manage financial system configurations, role permissions, and upgrade cycles; coordinate testing, deployment, and post-go-live support with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Develop and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and training materials to ensure scalable adoption of integrated financial tools.

• Lead enablement sessions and provide hands-on training to finance, operations, and business users on new features, customizations, and process enhancements.

We're Excited About You Because

• You have 7+ years experience operating in and maintaining financial tools and deep experience integrating NetSuite with third-party tools and managing complex data pipelines into and out of an ERP.

• You have advanced familiarity with multiple of the following tools: ERP systems, payment processors, transportation management systems, procure to pay platforms, IPAAS, tax software, demand planning tools.

jobs.title: Head of Delivery, AI-Native Services
jobs.description:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.

Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

Grow With Us

We are a team from UC Berkeley, Cornell, SJTU, Cambridge, NUS, with broad industry experiences from Tencent, Alibaba, Amazon, ByteDance, and more. Our engineering team is composed of passionate, driven, and talented engineers who focus on building and innovating cloud technology solutions that empower local businesses to thrive and better serve the deskless workforce in their communities. We are seeking a talented Software Engineer (Full Stack) to join our growing engineering team.

Day In The Life

Workstream is building AI-native services that deliver completed business outcomes. These are mature, proven service categories that businesses already pay for today. Our bet is a new cost structure: AI agents plus a small human review layer, delivering the same outcome at materially better margins than the traditional human-delivered alternative.

The business runs as two peer seats. The Head of GTM owns pipeline, pricing, packaging, and closing. You own the delivery system and the cost structure: the agents, integrations, evaluations, human review, exception handling, and compliance controls that make the margin thesis true—and the cost per completed service unit that proves it. Gross margin is a shared scorecard number for both seats.

The mandate is deliberately narrow: one service, taken from design customers to repeatable, profitable operation, before anything else. This is a hands-on leadership role—you architect and build, not just direct.

This is a full-time, hybrid position with 3 days a week in-office to support close cross-functional collaboration.

Who You Are

• You have personally built and operated at least one AI agent or agentic workflow in production. You can clearly explain how it worked, where it failed, how you evaluated it, and what you kept deterministic or human-led.

• You have led a technical team, including hiring or developing people and making difficult architecture and delivery trade-offs.

• You have served customers directly—from discovery and workflow mapping through launch, problem resolution, and measurable outcomes.

• You have personally owned delivery economics—a cost model, a margin, or a capacity plan you ran and defended—and you can hold a deal-acceptance line against commercial pressure using the model.

• You can break a messy service into deterministic steps, agentic decisions, human judgment, exception paths, and escalation rules—and define how each part will be tested.

• You know how to prevent plausible but low-quality AI output from reaching customers through grounded context, constrained actions, verification, evals, review, and monitoring.

• You productize by instinct: you have turned bespoke customer work into reusable systems, and you can say no to customization that breaks the economics.

• Experience operating in a regulated domain (payroll, payments, tax, benefits, labor compliance, fintech ops) is strongly preferred.

• A forward-deployed leader, founding engineer who owned delivery economics, or technical services leader from a regulated-operations business may fit well, but demonstrated experience matters more than title.

What We Offer

• A mission-driven and value-based company dedicated to empower deskless workers and local businesses

• An early employee opportunity at a Series B hyper-growth startup; work with the founding team and industry veterans to accelerate your career

• Competitive salary and equity

• Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision. We pay 95% of your premiums for our employees and 85% for dependents

jobs.title: CNC Machinist III
jobs.description:
FUNCIONES Y RESPONSABILIDADES

• Preparar y operar centros de mecanizado CNC de Mazak utilizando el sistema de control Mazatrol.
• Preparar la máquina, las herramientas, los materiales y los dispositivos de sujeción necesarios para cada orden de trabajo.
• Trabajar de acuerdo con órdenes de fabricación, planos técnicos, instrucciones de proceso y otras instrucciones de trabajo.
• Realizar ajustes y modificaciones de programas CNC cuando sea necesario.
• Realizar la inspección de las piezas producidas, incluida la inspección de la primera pieza, y comunicar inmediatamente cualquier desviación o problema de calidad.
• Utilizar instrumentos de medición manuales para comprobar las dimensiones y la calidad de las piezas.
• Preparar el siguiente trabajo mientras la máquina está en funcionamiento, incluyendo la preparación de herramientas, materiales, equipos de medición y programas.
• Informar al líder de sección o al responsable correspondiente de cualquier problema relacionado con la máquina, el proceso o la calidad.
• Colaborar con los compañeros para identificar problemas y buscar soluciones.
• Identificar oportunidades de mejora continua y participar activamente en iniciativas de mejora de procesos.
• Seguir los procedimientos de mantenimiento preventivo establecidos para los equipos y comunicar inmediatamente cualquier fallo o irregularidad.
• Cumplir todas las normas y procedimientos de calidad, seguridad y medio ambiente.
• Completar correctamente toda la documentación necesaria.
• Formar e instruir a otros empleados cuando sea necesario.
• Realizar otras tareas relacionadas con el puesto según sea necesario.

REQUISITOS DEL PUESTO

• Formación Profesional Grado II ó Tecnico Superior de Grado Superior
• Experiencia o conocimientos en mecanizado, especialmente en centros de mecanizado CNC.
• Experiencia con máquinas Mazak y el sistema de control Mazatrol.
• Se valorará positivamente tener conocimientos básicos de programación CNC.
• Se valorarán conocimientos o experiencia con diferentes tipos de mecanizado, por ejemplo:tornos CNC y tornos convencionales,fresadoras CNC y convencionales,centros de mecanizado de 3, 4 o 5 ejes,electroerosión (EDM),taladros y otros equipos de mecanizado.
• Capacidad para leer e interpretar planos técnicos y documentación de producción.
• Capacidad para utilizar instrumentos de medición.
• Capacidad para realizar cálculos matemáticos básicos relacionados con el trabajo técnico.
• Conocimientos básicos de inglés, especialmente terminología técnica. La documentación técnica y los planos pueden contener términos e instrucciones en inglés.
• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y responsable.
• Orientación a la calidad y a la mejora continua.

REQUISITOS DE SEGURIDAD Y MEDIO AMBIENTE (EHS)

• Realizar todo el trabajo de forma segura y cumplir todos los requisitos y procedimientos de seguridad de la empresa.
• Cumplir las directrices de la empresa relativas a la manipulación y elevación manual de cargas, de acuerdo con las normas de seguridad vigentes.
• Cumplir todos los requisitos medioambientales de la empresa y contribuir a sus objetivos de desempeño medioambiental.
• Completar y participar activamente en todas las formaciones obligatorias relacionadas con seguridad, salud y medio ambiente.

REQUISITOS FÍSICOS Y MENTALES

• Capacidad para permanecer sentado durante períodos prolongados, de un mínimo de 2 horas cuando sea necesario.
• Capacidad para desplazarse por las diferentes áreas de la oficina, taller, almacén o planta de producción.
• Capacidad para levantar y transportar cargas de hasta 18 kg.
• Capacidad para agacharse, alcanzar, arrodillarse, girarse y sujetar objetos durante el trabajo.
• Capacidad para realizar varias tareas simultáneamente, gestionar diferentes objetivos y cambiar las prioridades según sea necesario para completar las tareas asignadas.
• Capacidad para leer, escribir, hablar y comprender inglés.
• Capacidad para responder a señales visuales y auditivas.

ENTORNO DE TRABAJO

El entorno de trabajo se encuentra normalmente en una ubicación de Smiths durante el horario laboral habitual o ampliado e incluye oficinas, plantas de producción y centros de reparación. El entorno de trabajo también puede incluir instalaciones de clientes, incluidos campos petrolíferos, así como lugares donde se celebran reuniones.

• El nivel de ruido en el entorno de trabajo suele ser elevado y es obligatorio utilizar los equipos de protección individual (EPI) homologados cuando se trabaja en la planta de producción.

DIVERSIDAD E INCLUSIÓN

John Crane es una empresa internacional y abierta, basada en valores de igualdad y ética, donde acogemos, apoyamos y valoramos la diversidad. La diversidad de perspectivas y experiencias es una de las razones por las que nuestra empresa prospera.

Todas las personas candidatas cualificadas tienen las mismas oportunidades de acceder a un empleo, independientemente de su raza, color de piel, religión, género, orientación sexual, identidad de género, nacionalidad, situación económica, estado de salud, edad o cualquier otra característica personal.

jobs.title: Staff Structural Engineer, Payloads
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maneuver Dominance team is building Thunder - an autonomous attack rotorcraft built to fight alongside crewed combat aviation to deliver overwhelming mass effects deep beyond the front lines. The team in London builds the Mission System and the autonomy that makes aircraft like Thunder work.

Autonomy is only as good as the link that carries it. Thunder is a compact airframe with weapons, sensors and radios competing for the same antenna real estate, flying low and in formation, in a spectrum that is actively contested. That is the problem you would own.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a Staff Structures Design Engineer to join the Thunder Team at our Costa Mesa HQ. You will work on new aircraft development in a lean, high-ownership culture where you directly shape the product and operate at a velocity to fly new designs within months, not years.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Perform static and dynamic structural analyses of composites and metallics using first principles and appropriate analysis methods (hand calculations, spreadsheets, scripts, detailed FEA)

• Develop and own FEM creation and organization at the global and subsystem level

• Collaborate with hardware engineers to drive proper designs based on analytical results

• Document analysis methodology and results in technical reports for internal teams and external stakeholders

• Conduct and support validation testing, including instrumentation requirements, load requirements, data collection, and model correlation

• Participate in flight testing including setting Do No Exceed values, monitoring loads, and dispositioning inspection findings

• Ensure designs meet customer requirements, industry standards, and safety regulations

• Stay current with advancements in analysis techniques, materials technology, and industry standards

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• BS or higher degree in engineering or applied physics with a focus in structures

• Deep understanding of statics, dynamics, mechanics of materials, and materials properties

• Structural testing experience (static, buckling, cyclic) including sensor selection, data acquisition, and data post-processing

• Proficiency in FEA software (ANSYS, Abaqus, NASTRAN) solution sequences for linear and non-linear static and buckling analyses

• Experience with CAD tools (NX, Solidworks)

• Proficiency in Matlab or Python (or equivalent) for developing analytical models, data acquisition, and automation

• Highly motivated, self-starting, and able to perform duties autonomously without supervision

• Very organized and willing to establish scope and requirements for ill- defined problems

• Be able to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of experience in a structures, dynamics, or loads related role with high ownership and accountability for hardware outcomes

• MS or higher degree in engineering or applied physics with a focus in structures

• Experience with high cycle fatigue and/or turbomachinery

• Ability to develop workflow automation tools

US Salary Range

$191,000—$253,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
