jobs.title: Platform Engineer (SDO)
jobs.description:
About us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

The Role

As a Platform Engineer, you will help build, operate, and improve the cloud platforms and infrastructure that support Wayve's software development and release systems.

Working as part of a team, you’ll focus on maintaining reliable, scalable, and secure cloud environments, while improving the systems that enable efficient software development, testing, and deployment. This is a hands-on role with opportunities to deepen your expertise in cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering.

Key Responsibilities

• Build, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure (primarily Azure) to support development, testing, and production environments.

• Contribute to Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) implementations (e.g. Terraform, Ansible) to ensure consistent and repeatable infrastructure provisioning.

• Support and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment systems running in cloud environments.

• Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise cloud systems for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

• Assist in managing containerised workloads and orchestration platforms (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).

• Implement and maintain observability tools (logging, metrics, alerting) to ensure system health and rapid incident response.

• Work with engineering teams to ensure infrastructure meets application requirements and supports scalable software delivery.

• Help improve security, access control, and compliance within cloud environments.

• Participate in incident response and root cause analysis for infrastructure and deployment issues.

• Continuously improve automation, reducing manual operations across infrastructure and deployment workflows.

About You

Essential:

• 2–5 years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or related engineering roles.

• Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

• Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g. Terraform, Ansible).

• Familiarity with CI/CD systems and cloud-based deployment pipelines.

• Basic understanding of networking, cloud architecture, and system reliability.

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Desirable:

• Experience with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).

• Experience working with Linux systems and shell scripting.

• Programming or scripting experience (e.g. Python, Bash, Go, or similar).

• Understanding of security best practices in cloud environments.

• Exposure to large-scale or distributed systems

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Brazil
jobs.description:
About Ahrefs

Ahrefs is an all-in-one marketing intelligence platform used by marketers, businesses and agencies around the world. Our tools help people understand search demand, analyse competitors, improve website performance and research content opportunities, backed by 15 years of web crawling data and increasingly powered by AI.

We’re bootstrapped and profitable, and we have been for 15 years. There are no investors and no board, which means no outside timeline on our decisions. We’re multinational, with offices in Palo Alto, Cambridge (MA), Singapore and Tokyo, and our culture is fast-moving, low-ego, and built on smart decisions and ownership.

The role

We’re looking for a Marketing Manager to drive Ahrefs’ growth in Brazil. This isn’t about translating global campaigns: it’s about building and executing a local marketing strategy that resonates with Brazilian marketers and businesses.

You’ll bring a track record of helping SaaS companies expand in Brazil, a strong understanding of SEO and AEO, and the ability to turn market knowledge into measurable growth.

You’ll start as a one-person local marketing team, working closely with our global marketing team.

This role is remote and based in Brazil.

What you’ll do

• Own Ahrefs’ marketing in Brazil, taking a hands-on approach across the marketing mix.

• Develop and execute marketing strategies that drive brand awareness, qualified leads and customer acquisition.

• Create and localise content for Brazilian audiences: blog posts, social media, email campaigns, landing pages and other digital assets.

• Manage local marketing activities, including content, events, partnerships, community engagement and public relations.

• Educate the Brazilian market on SEO, AEO and AI search, positioning Ahrefs as a trusted resource.

• Build relationships with Brazilian marketers, agencies, creators, industry experts and relevant communities.

• Organise and take part in conferences, networking events and customer meetups to build relationships and generate demand.

• Analyse market trends, competitor activity and customer insights to identify opportunities and improve performance.

• Report results, learnings and priorities to senior leadership, connecting marketing activity to business growth.

What you’ll need

• Significant hands-on experience in SaaS marketing, with ownership of market growth and clear, measurable results.

• A track record of SaaS expansion in Brazil. You can show which companies you helped grow, what you personally owned, and the results in customer acquisition, revenue or other meaningful business metrics. Experience bringing a global SaaS brand into Brazil is particularly relevant.

• Strong practical knowledge of SEO and AEO, including how brands build visibility across search engines and AI-powered answer platforms.

• Good working knowledge of Ahrefs, and how its products serve marketers and businesses in Brazil.

• A deep understanding of the Brazilian marketing landscape, customer behaviour, and local channels and communities.

• Strong content creation and digital marketing skills, with experience adapting English-language content and creating original campaigns for Brazilian audiences.

• The ability to identify quick wins in your first few months, build on what works, and develop a longer-term strategy while operating as a one-person local team.

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills, working effectively across teams.

• Native-level Brazilian Portuguese and fluent English, written and spoken. Spanish is a plus.

What success looks like

In 6 months: you’ve launched a focused marketing strategy for Brazil, with measurable improvements in relevant traffic, engagement and qualified demand. You’re active in at least two relevant local communities, you’ve established relationships with potential partners and creators, and you can show which early initiatives are contributing to customer acquisition.

In 1 year: Ahrefs has a recognised presence in the Brazilian marketing community. Your content, partnerships and community initiatives are contributing to measurable growth in customers and revenue. You’ve identified repeatable ways to acquire customers, built a plan for further expansion, and established whether growing a small local team is justified.

Why Ahrefs

We believe in empowering smart people to make big decisions. As our Marketing Manager for Brazil you won’t be managing a rigid process, you’ll be building a market. We don’t micromanage. We trust you to identify opportunities, move quickly and deliver results, working with a product that helps marketers do their jobs better.

Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we’ll let you know.

Location: Brazil. Remote.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Procurement Operations Manager on our Deployed Programs team within Centralized Procurement, you will be the tip of the spear for procurement performance across Anduril's business lines. You will embed directly with division procurement teams, diagnose execution gaps, and drive measurable improvement in supplier delivery, PO management, and buyer effectiveness. This is not a headquarters role that reviews dashboards from a distance. You will be on the ground with buyers, in supplier meetings, and in the weeds of ERP data, solving problems that directly determine whether hardware reaches the production floor on time. Centralized Procurement owns the playbook: the standards, the training, the KPI framework, and the escalation authority that keep procurement operating consistently across every division. The Tiger Team is how that playbook comes to life. You will pilot the model in early divisions, then expand it across the enterprise, shifting from embedded execution to coaching as each business line matures. If you want a high visibility role where your work directly shapes how a fast scaling defense technology company buys, builds, and delivers, this is your mission.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Embed and Drive Execution
• Deploy into business line procurement teams during pilot and expansion phases. Pair directly with buyers and supply chain leaders to assess current state, identify gaps, and stand up the standard operating model.
• Lead weekly OTD drumbeat reviews at the division level. Own the agenda, drive root cause analysis on past due POs and supplier delivery failures, and ensure corrective actions convert into measurable improvement.
• Coach buyers on core procurement execution: PR to PO conversion within the two day standard, PO acknowledgement follow up, DPAS compliance, and supplier performance management.
• Conduct hands on ERP and MRP work alongside buyers. Pull on order reports, validate promise dates, flag at risk deliveries, and ensure data hygiene in the procurement system of record.

Operationalize the Centralized Playbook
• Roll out standard procurement processes, templates, and escalation frameworks so every division operates from the same baseline. Adapt the playbook to local program realities without compromising the standard.
• Stand up and maintain the KPI reporting cadence for assigned divisions. Track and report on the full metrics framework: PR to PO conversion, PO acknowledgement rates, past due PO lines, receiving issue ticket closure, invoice resolution, DPAS PO OTD, and supplier OTD.
• Execute the escalation and remediation framework. At Tier 1, provide coaching. At Tier 2, deploy as embedded support for 30 day improvement sprints. At Tier 3, support centralized oversight of the affected function until performance is restored.
• Benchmark procurement performance across divisions. Identify which teams are ahead, document what works, and propagate best practices through the Peer Learning Network.

Build the Foundation
• Deliver buyer training aligned to centralized standards: ACD code compliance, procurement policy and governance, War Chest navigation, and KPI reporting workflows.
• Support the buildout of automated reporting dashboards and the On Order Report (OOR) so divisions move from manual, weekly data pulls to machine generated, daily visibility.
• Contribute to the career framework and professional development standards that define what good looks like in a buyer at every level, from IC2 through Senior Buyer.
• Support hiring decisions as the central quality bar holder. Evaluate procurement candidates, pressure test technical and behavioral competency, and ensure new hires ramp through a consistent onboarding standard.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business administration, industrial engineering, or a related field.

• 5 to 8 years of experience in procurement, supply chain operations, or strategic sourcing, with direct ownership of supplier delivery performance and purchase order management.

• Ability to travel approximately 40 to 60% of the time, variable based on which divisions are in pilot expansion, or steady state.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master's degree in supply chain, operations management, or MBA.

• Experience in defense, aerospace, or hardware manufacturing procurement.

• Deeper experience within: Supplier performance management and development programs DPAS (Defense Priorities and Allocations System) rated order compliance Procurement policy and governance in a regulated environment Standing up procurement operations in new or immature business units Coaching and training junior procurement professionals

• Proficiency in data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) for building procurement dashboards.

• Familiarity with high mix, low volume manufacturing environments where procurement complexity is driven by product diversity rather than volume.

• Background in Lean, Six Sigma, or structured problem solving methodologies applied to procurement processes.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance.

jobs.title: Technicien Qualité (Quality Technician)
jobs.description:
À PROPOS

Harmattan AI est un acteur de nouvelle génération dans le secteur de la défense, spécialisé dans la conception de systèmes autonomes et évolutifs. En combinant ingénierie avancée, robotique et intelligence artificielle, nous développons des capacités opérationnelles pensées pour le terrain.

Notre croissance rapide reflète une ambition claire : équiper les forces armées avec des systèmes à la hauteur des enjeux actuels. Nous recherchons des profils prêts à s’engager dans un environnement technique exigeant, avec un fort sens de la mission et de l’impact.

 
 


RÔLE

Nous recherchons un Technicien Qualité pour rejoindre notre bureau de Paris. En travaillant sur le terrain aux côtés des équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication et de qualité, vous veillerez à ce que la qualité soit intégrée à nos produits, du prototype jusqu'à la livraison au client. Vous rapporterez au Responsable Qualité.

 
 


RESPONSABILITÉS

Support à la fabrication de prototypes :

 - Fournir un support qualité lors de l'assemblage des prototypes, en veillant à ce que les constructions soient conformes aux plans, aux instructions de travail et aux spécifications.

 - Identifier et documenter les pièces non conformes, soutenir le traitement et les actions correctives aux côtés de l'équipe d'ingénierie.

 - Aider à définir les méthodes d'inspection et les critères d'acceptation pour les nouveaux composants.

 

Revue de premier article (FAI) :

 - Réaliser des revues de premier article sur les pièces de développement.

 - Préparer et maintenir les rapports FAI avec une traçabilité complète des résultats d'inspection.

 - Assurer le suivi des conclusions de la FAI et veiller à ce que les actions correctives soient clôturées avant la mise en production.

 

Mur Qualité – Produits en développement :

 - Gérer le point de contrôle du mur qualité, en vérifiant que chaque unité de développement répond aux critères définis avant de passer à la phase suivante.

 - Tenir à jour les registres du mur qualité et donner de la visibilité sur l'état des produits et les motifs de blocage.

 - Faire remonter les défauts récurrents à l'Ingénierie Qualité et à la Conception pour résolution.

 

Support après-vente et tri chez le client :

 - Participer aux activités de support après-vente, y compris l'inspection sur site et le tri des produits chez les clients si nécessaire.

 - Effectuer des contrôles visuels et dimensionnels pour identifier les unités non conformes, isoler les produits défectueux et documenter les résultats.

 - Agir en tant que représentant qualité sur site, assurant la liaison entre le client et les équipes internes pour résoudre efficacement les problèmes de qualité.

 - Remonter les observations du terrain au centre de développement pour piloter les actions correctives et l'amélioration des produits.

 

Système Qualité et Amélioration Continue :

 - Veiller à ce que les rapports d'inspection et de non-conformité soient correctement documentés dans les outils appropriés (Jira, Confluence ou QMS).

 - Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus d'inspection et des critères du mur qualité au fil du temps.

 

Prérequis

 - Diplôme technique en qualité, génie mécanique, fabrication ou domaine connexe.

 - Première expérience dans un rôle d'inspection qualité ou de qualité fabrication, idéalement dans les secteurs de l'aérospatiale, de la défense ou de la haute technologie.

 - Capacité à lire des dessins d'ingénierie et à utiliser les outils d'inspection standards (pieds à coulisse, micromètres, etc.).

 - La connaissance des processus de revue de premier article (FAI) est un plus.

 - Connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et EN 9100.

 - Minutieux, rigoureux et à l'aise pour travailler en atelier.

 - Esprit d'équipe et bonnes compétences en communication.

 - Bon niveau d'anglais ; disponibilité pour se déplacer sur les sites des clients si nécessaire.

 - Adhésion totale à la mission de Harmattan AI et volonté de s'investir pleinement pour soutenir notre croissance.

 

Nous avons hâte de découvrir comment vous pouvez aider à façonner l'avenir des systèmes de défense autonomes chez Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: User Experience Researcher III
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About the Fan Ecosystem Team

The Fan Ecosystem team sits across the Fanatics Company and focuses on the Fanatics App, Enterprise Loyalty, and Enterprise identity. The Fanatics App is becoming the daily home for sports fans - the place they buy, bet, collect, and play from one connected surface.  We build experiences that impact Fans across the whole of Fanatics and back-end tools that empower Fanatics Operating Companies to improve customer experiences within their specific sites and apps. This role sits on the Experience Design team within Fan Ecosystem, representing the customer voice that empowers fan-first decision-making across product, design, and engineering.

About the Role

We’re looking for a User Experience Researcher to help drive user-centered decision-making across our product teams. In this role, you’ll be responsible for executing research projects that enhance our understanding of fan behaviors, needs, and pain points. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to design and conduct research that directly impacts the Fanatics’ customer experience.

What You’ll Do

• Support the Sr. Manager of UX Research in the daily operations of the UXR program.

• Collaborate with Product, Design, Engineering, and Commercial Teams to develop research plans that align with the product roadmap.

• Manage research intake requests from stakeholders, creating structured research plans that drive alignment and reduce inefficiencies.

• Plan and execute evaluative research for new and existing features.

• Plan and execute discovery research for the future product roadmap.

• Conduct qualitative customer interviews to generate insights that inform product and design decisions.

• Set up and manage unmoderated user tests.

• Plan, manage, and synthesize quantitative research efforts such as surveys.

• Work with researchers across different Fanatics verticals to gather holistic fan insights and connect learnings across the Fanatics organizations.

• Manage the collection of and reporting on longitudinal health metrics such as NPS and CSAT.

• Own research operations for projects, including screening and recruiting, scheduling, methodology, tooling, synthesis & analysis processes, and socializing insights.

• Ensure holistic analysis of problems by leveraging multiple primary and secondary data sources.

• Synthesize findings into clear, actionable insights and communicate them effectively to non-research audiences including leadership, product, design, engineering, marketing, and commercial teams.

• Advocate for research findings and the voice-of-the-customer in a variety of settings, across communication channels, and across stakeholders.

• Assist in other research operations work such as research participant management, data management, defining and documenting processes, selecting research tools, and standardizing methods.

• In addition to research responsibilities, you will also grow your professional research skills and expertise, work alongside experienced product and design professionals, and have opportunities to perform research in many capacities and methods.

What We’re Looking For

• 2-4 years of experience in UX research, usability testing, or a related field.

• Strong foundational knowledge of user-centered design principles, and mixed methods research background.

• Ability to synthesize insights and communicate findings in a clear, impactful way.

• Time management skills that support reporting on customer insights quickly and regularly.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced product development environment.

• Familiarity with research tools such as unmoderated interviewing tools, survey software, transcript apps, and video editing.

• Experience integrating AI into your everyday research work, from research planning, to synthesis and reporting.

• A business-curious researcher who can apply data toward product decisions and revenue creation.

• Good communication skills (written and spoken), and a comfort level with sharing research results to stakeholders.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple research projects simultaneously.

• Proven collaboration skills and comfort with building connections throughout an organization.

Bonus Points

• Experience with quantitative research methods, strong survey design skills, and data analysis skills.

• Background in human-computer interaction (HCI) or user experience design.

• Experience working within an agile product development environment.

• Embracing ambiguity as an opportunity to make a big difference on an exceptional team of talented people!

• Fearlessness about change, innovation, and meeting new challenges.

Why Join Us?

• Be part of a growing research team that values collaboration, curiosity, and impact.

• Work on products that shape fan experiences and engagement at scale.

• Influence product decisions through meaningful, user-driven insights.

Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

$117,000—$170,000 USD

jobs.title: Critical Vendor Manager -Operational Readiness
jobs.description:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is seeking a Critical Vendor Manager to own the vendor relationship program for Riot's maintenance and repair critical vendors — the trade vendors (electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety, water treatment, and similar categories) that perform maintenance and repair work across the data center portfolio.

You will design and run the vendor performance management program: KPI tracking and scorecarding in both directions — Riot's assessment of vendors, and a defined path for vendors to provide constructive feedback on Riot — continuous-improvement tracking, and program-level effectiveness evaluation. Day-to-day vendor relationship management sits with site teams; this role owns the program framework, standards, and metrics they operate within. You will execute and assure against the Vendor Management Standard, own vendor qualification, and maintain the Approved Vendor List.

This position is remote/hybrid, with regular travel to Riot sites.

What you'll do

• Own the vendor relationship program for maintenance and repair critical vendors across the portfolio — setting program structure, governance, and performance metrics, and evaluating program effectiveness at the portfolio level
• Design and maintain vendor performance scorecards and KPI tracking for maintenance and repair critical vendors, covering quality, safety, schedule adherence, and conformance to the Vendor Management Standard
• Build and run the reciprocal feedback process — vendors formally scoring Riot's performance as a partner, with a defined path for vendors to provide constructive feedback
• Set and track continuous-improvement metrics in partnership with vendors, driving shared improvement initiatives rather than one-directional scorekeeping
• Serve as the escalation intermediary for site teams raising vendor performance or coverage issues, working the issue to resolution or to a documented corrective action
• Execute vendor selection evaluations and onboarding verification for maintenance and repair critical vendor scopes, in partnership with site Critical Operations Managers and per the Vendor Management Standard
• Own vendor qualification and Approved Vendor List administration by maintaining the performance data and evidence that qualification reviews depend on
• Own contract renewal timing and coverage-gap tracking for critical vendors — flagging warranty and contract expirations before they become coverage lapses
• Partner with the Maintenance Strategy Manager on which maintenance scopes are vendor-performed, ensuring vendor statements of work stay aligned to the governing equipment strategy
• Maintain vendor performance and nonconformance records as audit-ready evidence supporting SOC 2 scope

What you'll have

• 7+ years of experience in vendor/supplier management, contract management, or vendor performance management within data center, industrial, or other critical infrastructure environments
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered
• Ability to travel 50% of the time
• CPSM or a similar procurement/vendor management certification, strongly preferred
• Demonstrated experience building or running a vendor scorecard/KPI program, ideally with a reciprocal (two-way) feedback component
• Experience with critical infrastructure trade vendor categories — electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety, water treatment, or similar
• Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills; comfortable serving as an escalation point between internal teams and external vendors
• Familiarity with vendor risk/compliance screening (insurance, safety program review) and SOC 2 or similar compliance frameworks a plus

Compensation and Benefits

• Competitive Salary: Base range (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
• Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
• 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
• Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
• Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Data Center Asset Manager - Reliability Management & Operational Readiness
jobs.description:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is seeking a Data Center Asset Manager to join our Central Operations team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end strategy and process for how physical assets — from critical power and cooling infrastructure to IT and networking equipment — are tracked, assessed, and managed across Riot's data center portfolio. You will build the Asset Management strategy and the operational process that sits under it, own the CMMS platform as the system of record for asset data, and lead site-level asset gap assessments and remediation as they arise across the portfolio.

You will lead Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and criticality assessments across key asset classes, using the results to define Riot's Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) program strategy — the framework for what preventive and predictive tasks get performed, and at what intervals, before that strategy is operationalized by site teams.

This position is remote/hybrid, with regular travel to our Riot sites to support site assessments, audits, and coordination with site teams.

What you'll do

• Develop and own the Asset Management strategy — the fleet-wide approach to how physical data center assets are tracked, assessed, valued, maintained and managed through their lifecycle.
• Develop the Asset Management process that operationalizes the strategy: asset onboarding, tagging and classification standards, transfers, audits, and decommissioning.
• Own the data integrity in the CMMS platform as the system of record for asset data — configuration, asset registers, reporting, and data integrity standards; partner with IT/platform teams where the CMMS integrates with DCIM, ServiceNow, or other systems of record.
• Lead site-level asset gap assessments and remediation as needed across the portfolio — validating inventories, resolving missing or incomplete asset data, and standing up accurate, audit-ready asset registers.
• Identify dominant failure modes, risk, and maintenance-relevant failure data across key asset classes through Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and criticality analysis, partnering with Engineering to resolve identified failure modes into the technical basis for maintenance strategy.
• Apply FMEA and criticality outputs to define and continuously refine Riot's Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) program strategy — the basis for PM task selection, intervals, and prioritization across the fleet.
• Reconcile client-provided scopes of work and contractual asset coverage expectations against OEM manufacturer operating manuals and suggested maintenance intervals, and incorporate into Riot's maintenance strategy.
• Develop the spares strategy — what spares are needed, stocking levels, and lead times — in coordination with the Logistics team, including defining the ownership handoff between asset strategy (what's needed) and Logistics execution (procurement and stocking).
• Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting the asset program, including asset standards, classification schemes, and process documentation for audit and operational use.
• Collaborate closely with site-based Asset & Maintenance Planners, who execute the Asset Management strategy day-to-day at their sites, to ensure the strategy translates cleanly into site-level execution
• Conduct or oversee periodic asset audits and inventory validations to maintain compliance and audit readiness.
• Ensure asset records, controls, and documentation meet Finance, Internal Audit, and SOC 2 requirements, maintaining audit-ready evidence for identity, physical access, and asset-related controls in scope.
• Monitor asset health, utilization, and status trends across the portfolio to identify risk areas and process gaps, and report findings to Central Operations leadership.
• Define the handoff points between the Asset Management strategy and the downstream Maintenance Strategy.

What you'll have

• 7+ years of experience in asset management, fixed asset management, or reliability/maintenance programs within data center, industrial, or other critical infrastructure environments
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered
• CMRP (Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional) or familiarity with ISO 55000/55001 asset management standards strongly preferred
• Ability to travel 50% of the time
• Demonstrated experience owning or administering a CMMS platform (e.g., Nuvolo, Maximo, IBM TRIRIGA, or similar)
• Strong technical writing skills — able to produce clear, audit-ready standards, SOPs, and process documentation
• Experience developing asset lifecycle, spares/inventory, or maintenance strategies, ideally across a multi-site portfolio
• Experience conducting FMEA or criticality analysis and applying it to design a Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) program
• Ability to reconcile conflicting inputs — client contractual requirements vs. OEM manufacturer specifications — into a coherent, defensible strategy
• Strong cross-functional coordination skills; able to work with Procurement, Logistics, Facilities, Standards & Governance, and site operations teams without direct authority

Compensation and Benefits

• Competitive Salary: Base range (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
• Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
• 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
• Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
• Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Technical Program Manager is the operational backbone of the Standards and Governance functions within the Central Operations pillar. Reporting to the Director of Standards and Governance, this mid-senior individual contributor runs the document governance lifecycle, drives root cause analyses and their corrective actions to verified closure, coordinates SOC and ISO audit readiness, and holds the throughline across these programs. The role exists so this work can scale as Riot brings new data center capacity and customers online.

Governance Document Lifecycle

• Own the day-to-day operation of the operations document library across the full hierarchy of policies, standards, processes, procedures, and forms.

• Maintain the review cadence so standards and procedures stay current against customer agreements, infrastructure changes, RCA findings, and audit findings.

jobs.title: Power Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
About the job

Delart is home to a team of world-class engineers and project leaders dedicated to developing the next generation of advanced networking technologies, consumer devices, and innovative technology solutions. Trusted by some of the world’s leading technology companies, we deliver highly scalable, mission-critical solutions that power both consumer and business applications globally. Since our founding in 2017, we have been at the forefront of designing cutting-edge networking, telecommunications, and consumer products, while driving end-to-end project execution and creating transformative technology applications.

Overview

Join a dynamic team focused on delivering industry-leading wearable devices by driving power measurement methodology development and ensuring robust power validation from concept through mass production. This high-impact role is central to optimizing device battery life and system efficiency, working across hardware and software disciplines to define, automate, and execute power validation processes that guarantee delivery to key performance indicators.

Responsibilities

• Define, implement, and refine power measurement methodologies tailored for wearable consumer devices, spanning initial proof-of-concept to mass production stages.

• Bring up, debug, and validate power circuitry on prototype hardware, collaborating closely with hardware, firmware, and software engineers.

• Develop and maintain automated frameworks for capturing, analyzing, and reporting power measurements during device validation and testing cycles.

• Execute comprehensive power validation test cases, collecting consumption data across various operational use cases and device states.

• Systematically report validation issues in bug tracking systems and work with cross-functional teams to drive rapid root cause analysis.

• Generate, maintain, and improve documentation, including validation test plans, reports, and detailed instructions for testing.

• Support root cause analysis and debug power, SoC/memory, and peripheral component issues, contributing to continuous improvement in power subsystem performance.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience validating power subsystems for consumer devices, ideally in wearables or mobile electronics.

• Demonstrated proficiency with key power management components (Buck/Boost regulators, LDOs, load switches, fuel gauge ICs, SoC power domains).

• Experience creating and executing power validation and test plans, including defining use cases and automation strategies.

• Proficient in capturing and analyzing power consumption data using laboratory equipment (multimeters, power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscopes, data acquisition units).

• Strong scripting skills in Python or LabVIEW for automation and data analysis.

• Familiarity with Android OS, Linux kernel, and SoC power architecture fundamentals.

• Understanding of communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, and UART.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience optimizing and validating power for battery-operated consumer devices at volume production scale.

• Advanced knowledge of automated test environments, data analytics, or custom tool development to streamline validation workflows.

• Familiarity with firmware and driver-level power optimizations in embedded systems.

• Exposure to root cause analysis for SoC- or memory-related power consumption anomalies.

• Graduate coursework or research in embedded systems, power electronics, or mobile systems architecture.

Benefits

Delart provides competitive benefits and compensation across all regions where we operate. In the United States, our benefits package includes premium PPO and HMO medical insurance, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA), life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, a company-matched 401(k) plan, and a generous paid time off policy.

Join us in shaping the future of technology. Apply today!

Delart is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace for all employees. We strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Finance Manager - Uganda
jobs.description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/5ac97b31-49cd-4012-8bb0-5caf15e33c69/B25.png]



Finance Manager — M-KOPA Uganda



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/790ccaf4-c22e-497d-a4aa-c2d551c7ae1e/image.png]



You've built the controls. You've closed the books. You've explained the numbers to boards who didn't want to hear them. But have you ever built financial rigor into a business that's simultaneously scaling, lending, and putting life-changing assets into the hands of millions of customers who've never had access to credit before?



That's the question at the centre of this role.



M-KOPA Uganda is a core market for M-KOPA — sub-Saharan Africa's largest asset fintech. We finance smartphones, solar power systems, and other essential assets for customers who pay daily via mobile money, building credit history and unlocking opportunity along the way. Uganda is one of M-KOPA's founding markets and remains a strategically important one, with a mature and expanding customer base and loan book.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/4feda09f-cc17-4950-8897-46e92b98c154/image.png]



Why this matters right now



M-KOPA has crossed 10 million customers, unlocked more than $2 billion in credit, and is on a deliberate path to 10 million more. Uganda is a critical piece of that next chapter — a market with deep operating history, its own reporting cycle, its own regulatory environment, and its own commercial dynamics. That's not a legacy structure to simply maintain: it's a business being continually refined in real time, with real customers, real repayment behaviour, and real IFRS obligations.

We are hiring a Finance Manager to own the financial management of the Uganda business — not just to maintain a finance function, but to strengthen and scale one.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/1d08d298-2a55-4b34-9de2-3d208a9eb145/image.png]



What this role actually is



This is a hands-on, high-ownership position. You will be a finance lead for the Uganda entity — responsible for the monthly management reporting pack, executive commentary, the IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss model, treasury and compliance matters, and the unit economics that inform commercial decisions across the market.



You'll manage the end-to-end monthly close: accruals, prepayments, intercompany, depreciation, FX. You'll produce variance analysis that isolates market-specific effects from one-off items. You'll monitor the loan book, analyse repayment behaviour by cohort, and own provisioning and bad debt trends. You'll support statutory and regulatory reporting, manage documentation for funding and compliance processes, and support due diligence as needed.



And then — because this is Uganda — you'll also be a commercial partner. You'll sit alongside the commercial team to interrogate unit economics, model new product launches, assess pricing and supply decisions, and build the financial cases for leadership and board discussions.



This is not a role where the strategy happens upstairs and the finance team keeps score. You'll shape both.



What makes it different



Most finance roles at this level have inherited structures, established processes, and reporting cadences that largely run themselves. This one asks for more ownership than that. You'll identify automation opportunities, strengthen controls, and ensure IFRS compliance in areas where judgement genuinely matters: IFRS 9, IFRS 16, IAS 21, revenue recognition, IFRS 18 readiness.



You'll also have direct exposure to one of East Africa's most established fintech markets, working alongside local and regional leadership to navigate an evolving regulatory and commercial landscape. That's a professional education you can't buy.



What you bring



 - Qualified Chartered Accountant (ACCA, CPA(U), CA or equivalent), with a demonstrable track record in finance management or a senior finance role, including hands-on ownership of statutory and management reporting cycles.

 - Deep, applied IFRS knowledge — particularly IFRS 9, IFRS 16, IAS 21, and revenue recognition — and proven ability to manage audit processes end-to-end, from file preparation to auditor queries.

 - Exceptional financial modelling and communication skills: you can build a complex multi-scenario model in Excel and present its conclusions clearly to a CFO or a lender in the same week.

 - Big 4 training (PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG) is a strong advantage. Working knowledge of the Ugandan fintech, lending, or asset-financing sector is a plus, though not required — curiosity and commercial instincts matter more.
   
   

The reality check



This role will ask a lot of you. The business is scaling fast, the reporting obligations are real, and the market's dynamics require precision. There will be months where the close feels tight and the audit feels relentless. You'll be operating across strategic and operational levels simultaneously — and some days the most important thing on your plate will be debugging a provisioning model, not presenting to leadership.

If that sounds manageable, it probably is. If it sounds energising — you're probably the right person.



What you'll find here



A front-row seat in strengthening the financial infrastructure of one of Africa's largest asset fintech businesses, in one of its most established markets. A mission where every asset financed is a tangible improvement in a customer's daily life. And genuine ownership — the kind where your judgement shapes how this entity reports, controls, and makes decisions, not just maintains them.



Ready to build something that matters? Let's talk.




WHY M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.



Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com http://m-kopa.com.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/369018b8-cf9c-49c7-95f1-1d414482ba57/B13.png]

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/481f6724-8375-4f39-b514-fbe00b8fc3b5/B13.png]



Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.



M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 



M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.



Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.



If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

jobs.title: Sr. Analytics Engineer/ Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Laurel is on a mission to return time. As the leading AI Time platform for professional services firms, we’re transforming how organizations capture, analyze, and optimize their most valuable resource: time. Our proprietary machine learning technology automates work time capture and connects time data to business outcomes, enabling firms to increase profitability, improve client delivery, and make data-driven strategic decisions. We serve many of the world's largest accounting and law firms, including EY, Aprio, Crowell & Moring, and Frost Brown Todd, and process over 1 billion work activities annually that have never been collected and aggregated before Laurel’s AI Time platform. 



Our team comprises top talent in AI, product development, and engineering—innovative, humble, and forward-thinking professionals committed to redefining productivity in the knowledge economy. We're building solutions that empower workers to deliver twice the value in half the time, giving people more time to be creative and impactful. If you're passionate about transforming how people work and building a lasting company that explores the essence of time itself, we'd love to meet you.



About the Role

As a Senior Analytics Engineer/Data Scientist at Laurel, you’ll turn product and business data into clear, trustworthy insights leaders can act on. You’ll own the analytics lifecycle—from ingestion and modeling to BI visualization and decision enablement. You’ll deliver self-serve insights using SQL/Python and embedded BI (e.g., ThoughtSpot). You will also help define the design patterns and data infrastructure to scale.

We’re especially interested in candidates who thrive in early-stage environments and pair analytical rigor with clear storytelling. You’ll partner closely with our CX team to quantify and communicate Laurel’s ROI, and you’ll join customer-facing presentations. You will be able to translate complex methods for non-technical leaders while going deep with technical stakeholders when needed.

In addition, you’ll apply machine learning to real-world product and business problems. You should be comfortable prototyping AI/ML models in notebooks, experimenting with approaches (classification, clustering, regression, NLP, etc.), and translating findings into actionable insights for the product and business.

What you will do

 1. Build analyses & automation (SQL/Python)
    
    - Run recurring ROI analyses (Business Impact Reports). Write performant SQL and pandas; productionize repeatable jobs (scheduling, alerts, anomaly checks) with orchestration (e.g., Airflow).

 2. Define metrics & model the data
    
    - Own metric definitions (e.g., True Time vs. Released), create reusable SQL Data Models that serve as the analytics source of truth.

 3. Partner with CX on customer ROI
    
    - Quantify and communicate Laurel’s impact, prepare exec-ready materials, and join customer-facing presentations—translating for both non-technical and technical stakeholders.

 4. Ship dashboards & actionable insights
    
    - Deliver customer-facing ThoughtSpot dashboards and turn findings into concise actionable insights

 5. Raise data quality & instrumentation
    
    - Add validation tests and monitoring, triage data issues quickly, and collaborate with Product/Engineering to improve data quality.

 6. Data Platform Development
    
    - Design, build, and maintain Laurel’s Analytics Data Warehouse as the single source of truth for analytics and reporting needs.
    
    - Create scalable ETL pipelines to ingest, process, and organize data from diverse sources (PMS, Web Analytics, WebApp).
    
    - Deploy and maintain Business Intelligence tools to provide analytics and reporting capabilities.

You will be a great fit if you have

 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Experience: 3+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist. Ideal candidates will be comfortable working with large-scale data systems.

 - Technical Proficiency:

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.

Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.

Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.

With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.

Join us in building the power foundation of the future!

Job Description Outline

Job Title: Full Stack Software Engineering Intern

Location: Reno/San Francisco

Headcount: 2

Hiring Manager: Yung Hua

Estimated Comp Range: Intern Comparable Rates for location

Company Overview

Amperesand is disrupting industrial power with the first commercialized Solid State Transformer (SST) systems. SSTs are far more than transformer replacements — they unlock advanced capabilities for data centers, EV charging, renewables, microgrids, and industrial installations.

To support this mission, Amperesand is building a modern ERP and manufacturing operations software platform that gives our internal teams and external stakeholders real-time visibility, control, and intelligence across the business. We are looking for a motivated intern who wants to build production software across the full stack while learning from a high-agency startup engineering team.

Role Summary

This internship is an opportunity to work hands-on with a startup engineering team building the ERP and manufacturing platform that powers Amperesand's operations. You will contribute across both frontend and backend, helping ship new features, improve reliability, and bring AI-enabled capabilities into our internal tools.

You will work closely with engineers, product owners, and internal and external stakeholders who rely on our proprietary ERP and manufacturing ecosystem every day. This is a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment where you'll be expected to take ownership of real, production-facing work.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with backend, frontend, and product teams to define APIs and data contracts.

• Assist in troubleshooting and resolving issues raised by internal and external users of the ERP and manufacturing ecosystem.

• Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and participate in code review.

• Document features, architectural decisions, and processes for cross-functional stakeholders.

• Bring a customer-oriented, team-first mindset to a fast-paced startup environment.

Qualifications

• Experience with TypeScript and React, including component-based development and state management.

• Basic understanding of REST APIs and client-server architecture.

• Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.

• Strong communication skills and comfort working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Self-motivated, team-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

Bonus Qualifications

jobs.title: Controls Engineer, Mission-Critical Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is building the next generation of digital infrastructure — a growing footprint of liquid-cooled, mission-critical data center campuses across Texas backed by a multi-gigawatt development pipeline. We're looking for a hands-on Controls Engineer to lead commissioning and project delivery on-site, keep our operations teams running day to day, and help grow the next generation of our controls organization.

This position will be based onsite in our Rockdale office. Relocation assistance is available for non-local candidates.

What you'll do

• Lead on-site commissioning and project management across our active and upcoming deployments — including close-out, warranty resolution, and vendor management, which recur on every project we bring online
• Own commissioning and vendor management for new deployments as they come online, including projects as large as 200 MW
• Support monitoring, alarm thresholds, and controls integration for our liquid-cooled (direct-to-chip and immersion) infrastructure, working alongside our thermal and mechanical teams
• Lead hands-on, on-site troubleshooting and technical support for our operations teams
• Mentor and directly help develop junior controls team members, including team members transitioning into controls engineering roles
• As your on-site workload stabilizes, grow into reviewing — and eventually co-owning — our controls standards and governance documentation

What you'll have

• 5-8 years of controls engineering experience, with direct data center or other mission-critical infrastructure exposure
• Hands-on commissioning and vendor management experience (RFP review, PSA negotiation and execution)
• Strong working knowledge of EPMS and BMS/SCADA integration and commissioning
• Familiarity with industrial protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, and OPC-UA
• Comfort owning incident response and change management for live, critical infrastructure

Compensation and Benefits

• Competitive Salary: Base range (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
• Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
• 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
• Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
• Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

In this role, you will build and maintain Workday reporting solutions and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-impact reporting that supports business decision-making.  You will serve as a subject matter expert in Workday reporting, data governance, and workforce analytics. This role drives the design, development, and enhancement of advanced reporting solutions and dashboards that enable strategic HR decision-making across the enterprise. • Process Automation & Continuous Improvement: Lead initiatives to automate recurring workflows, leverage APIs/integrations to enrich reporting datasets, and stay current with Workday releases to continuously improve system capabilities.

• Documentation & Enablement: Develop and maintain detailed documentation for reporting logic, calculated field methodologies, and data definitions; manage hypercare, implementation rollouts, and user adoption across technical levels.

• Leadership & Operational Support: Mentor junior team members on reporting logic and best practices, conduct quality assurance reviews, and efficiently handle ad-hoc analytics and production troubleshooting.

Requirements

• Advanced experience with Workday Report Writer, EIBs, Calculated Fields, worksheets, and dashboards; Workday PRISM or other advanced modules a plus.

Benefits

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented and curious, a self-starter who enjoys understanding how calculations work, validating assumptions, and ensuring that outputs are reliable and defensible. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Engineering & Construction
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.


THE ROLE

We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the Engineering and Super domains of CapitalProjectOS (CPOS), the operating system for how Mariana designs, plans, and builds capital projects. CPOS is organized around four components ( MarianaEngineer (design), MarianaGSM (procurement), MarianaSuper (construction), and MarianaPM (planning and monitoring)) and this role owns two of them end-to-end: MarianaEngineer, the centralized system for design basis, process and engineering data, and 3D models; and MarianaSuper, the real-time command center for construction execution and plan-versus-actual tracking in the field.

You will be the single accountable owner for product strategy, roadmap, and execution across engineering and construction, working alongside PMs who own procurement (GSM) and planning/knowledge (PM) within the same CPOS team. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in capital project engineering or construction/field execution and is energized by the challenge of embedding AI into workflows that engineers and superintendents depend on every day.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the product vision, roadmap, and prioritization for MarianaEngineer and MarianaSuper, including agentic tooling such as engineering automation, reality capture, and plan-versus-actual intelligence.

 - Serve as the primary domain expert translating capital project engineering and construction workflows into software requirements. You will act as the the bridge between project engineers, superintendents, project controls, software engineering, and executive stakeholders.

 - Embed directly with engineering and field teams to understand how design and construction work actually happens, anticipate edge cases, and distinguish true product requirements from one-off user preferences or process gaps.

 - Write clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules; build and test prototypes to hone in on valuable products as quickly as possible.

 - Build a structured user engagement model (discovery sessions, workflow reviews, sprint reviews, UAT, and adoption check-ins) that makes users accountable for feedback, testing, and adoption.

 - Develop rollout plans, training materials, adoption metrics, and feedback loops; track adoption barriers and work with engineering and construction leaders to resolve them.

 - Define and track success metrics: modeling and design turnaround time, C4 and reality-capture adoption, plan-versus-actual accuracy, cycle time, and downstream project outcomes (schedule, cost, safety).

 - Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives; maintain a well-prioritized backlog.

 - Create visibility into what is being built, why it matters, and how it is performing.

 - Help build the PM function at an AI company. This is a small, early team where you'll help establish how we work and develop PMs behind you at a company at the cutting edge of developing and adopting AI.
   
   


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Must Have

 - 5+ years of experience in capital project engineering (process, mechanical, or EPC design) and/or construction or field execution (superintendent, construction management, project controls).

 - Strong understanding of the capital project lifecycle including design basis, engineering deliverables, procurement handoff, construction execution, and commissioning.

 - Ability to go deep on engineering and construction workflows and earn credibility with domain experts by understanding how the work actually happens.

 - Strong product judgment: ruthless prioritization, focus on highest-leverage work, resistance to building everything at once.

 - Ability to translate complex operational workflows into clear requirements, priorities, and product decisions, and to lead cross-functional teams through ambiguous, complex projects with competing stakeholder priorities.

 - Genuine interest in AI-powered tooling. You know how to translate model capabilities into products that engineers and superintendents will trust and adopt, and you enjoy staying current on the cutting edge of AI advancements.

 - Strong communication skills across a wide range of organizational contexts, from field superintendents and engineers to executives.

Nice to Have

 - Direct experience with engineering software (P&ID, 3D/plant design, datasheet or equipment-sizing tools) or construction management software (scheduling, QA/QC, reality capture, command-center platforms).

 - Experience shipping AI-powered enterprise tools: agentic engineering workflows, document intelligence, or process co-pilots.

 - Track record of digital transformation in capital-intensive industries — mining, energy, construction, or manufacturing.

 - Prior product management experience, or genuine excitement to move into product management from an engineering or construction background.

 - AI-forward projects outside of work.
   
   


WHY THIS ROLE

At Mariana, you don't need to validate product-market fit because we are the market. If you identify a real problem and build a real solution, adoption is a conversation, not a sales cycle.

MarianaEngineer and MarianaSuper are the platforms that determine whether Mariana's designs move from design basis to 3D model without drifting out of sync, and whether the field catches a schedule or quality problem in real time instead of in a monthly report. The engineering tools you build set the authoritative source of truth for every project. The command center you build is what a superintendent looks at every morning to run the site.

If you want to own something end-to-end, build software with immediate operational impact, and help shape what a modern industrial company looks like from the inside out — we'd love to talk.


OUR CULTURE IS BUILT ON FOUR PRINCIPLES:



Everyone Gets Home Safe. We never put speed or cost ahead of people.

Extreme Ownership. We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions.

Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate. We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale.

Share Your Legos. We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions.



Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

jobs.title: Materials & Processes Technical Specialist II
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Materials and NDE (Non-Destructive Evaluation) team plays a central role in enabling Terran R to fly, re-fly, and scale: developing, characterizing, and inspecting materials and processes across all parts of the vehicle. From welding and additive manufacturing to advanced composites, the team works at the intersection of innovation and execution, balancing performance and reliability with cost, quality, and schedule. As we move toward first flight and beyond, the challenges become more exciting, offering opportunities to shape how we design and develop for re-use. With ownership across products, systems, and disciplines, engineers gain broad exposure and drive key decisions across design, manufacturing, and operations.

About the Role:
