jobs.title: Buyer - Women's Accessories
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Fashion Nova is the world’s leading trend-to-market fashion and lifestyle brand with high-growth categories across its Women, Men, Kids and Beauty divisions. Renowned for delivering the most-wanted styles to millions worldwide, Fashion Nova earned the title of the Top 5 Most-Searched Fashion Brand on Google in 2022, alongside Louis Vuitton and Nike.

Founder & CEO Richard Saghian launched the brand in 2006, from a retail location in Los Angeles. After multiple store openings, Saghian launched the e-commerce website for Fashion Nova in 2013, pioneering a disruptive social commerce model of affordable, on-trend, size-inclusive clothing online– powered by an innovative, social media-first marketing strategy.

Today, Fashion Nova has amassed over 40 million social media followers, with annual sales of approximately $2 billion!

The brand’s name has been featured in chart-topping hit songs by Cardi B, Drake, 21 Savage, Saweetie, The Game, Tyga and Offset and its styles have been worn by many celebrities, artists and athletes including Meg The Stallion, Ice Spice, Chris Brown, Floyd Mayweather, Rick Ross, Kourtney Kardashian, and Kylie Jenner.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Under the guidance of the Division / Category Director, you as a Buyer on the Women's Accessories team will work to create the appropriate merchandise mix based on emerging trends and manage the assortment strategies established by your team leaders. You will also be responsible for managing your category product assortment and delivering on financial targets. Your role is essential to ensuring Fashion Nova has the best product offerings for our customers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Drive Assortment Strategy: Develop and execute buying strategies to curate trend-driven product assortments that align with customer preferences and seasonal trends, while achieving optimal SKU count and balancing newness vs. replenishment inventory

• Trend Forecasting: Stay ahead of fashion trends by conducting market research, keeping a pulse runway trends, and analyzing social media and competitors to ensure a competitive and forward-thinking product mix. Utilize research to work with in-house production team and suppliers to drive on-trend newness

• Cost Negotiation & Margin Optimization: Lead pricing negotiations with suppliers to secure the best cost structures while maintaining product quality, ensuring profitability, and maximizing margins in a highly competitive market

• Financial Management: Manage weekly sales performance, open-to-buy budgets, pricing, margin targets, and inventory levels, ensuring alignment with sales goals and profit margins, while optimizing the balance of newness and replenishment, minimizing markdowns

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with production, replenishment, planning, and creative teams to ensure timely deliveries, fast replenishment of high-demand styles, successful promotions to maximize sales opportunities, and cohesive product launches

• Data-Driven Decisions: Utilize sales performance data, customer reviews, and market insights to continuously optimize product assortments and increase profitability

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

• 5-7 of years of experience in Buying for accessories (handbags, jewelry, belts, and hats) ideally within an eCommerce fashion brand

• Strong understanding of current and emerging fashion trends, with a deep passion for the fashion industry

• Experience working with vendors and negotiating product quality, costs, and delivery dates with vendors

• Excellent prioritization, project management, organization skills, and attention to detail, in addition to strong analytical skills to support data-driven decisions

• Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Workspace

• Bachelor’s Degree in Fashion, Production, Design or related field, or equivalent work experience

• English, additional language(s) an advantage

• Schedule of this position: Monday – Friday | Core business hours | Onsite

BENEFITS

• NEW state-of-the-art HQ upcoming in 2025!

• Formalized career paths for continued professional growth

• Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Comprehensive health insurance across Medical, Dental and Vision

• 401k match, with immediate vesting upon eligibility

• Weekly catered lunches & fully-stock kitchen pantry!

• Opportunities to travel for trade shows and vendor meetings

• Summer Fridays Early Departure

• Team bonding events and programs

• Attractive employee discounts!

jobs.title: Associate, NOC Relations & Planning - Americas
jobs.description:
LA28 does not provide relocation assistance for any positions. If you are based outside the Los Angeles area, we still welcome your application — we value talent from all geographic backgrounds and want to hear from you if you are able to work on-site in LA.

Role Purpose

As Associate, NOC Relations and Planning, Americas, you will help a portfolio of National Olympic Committees prepare for and experience the Games. Reporting to the Senior Manager, you will support service-level planning, client communications, and cross-functional coordination so each committee's needs are understood and represented across LA28. You will build trusted relationships, keep clients informed, and help deliver pre-Games readiness and Games-time operations. It is a role for an organized, culturally aware relationship-builder who wants to serve an international community and grow within a collaborative, inclusive team.

Key Responsibilities

• Cultivate trusted, transparent relationships with a portfolio of 15–25 National Olympic Committees.

• Manage client correspondence, escalation pathways, and the review and distribution of key documents, policies, and informational resources.

• Support service-level planning with 8–10 functional areas, mapping the athlete journey from arrival to departure.

• Maintain status-tracking and reporting tools, and help mitigate identified gaps against NCS and functional-area milestones.

• Deliver pre-Games readiness and Games-time operations, including Chefs de Mission Seminars and NCS Service Center support.

Required Competencies

• 3+ years of relevant work experience, with authorization to lawfully work in the United States for the full duration of the role.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent preferred, ideally paired with international, cultural, or sport-industry exposure.

• Multilingual strength: English as the primary working language, with fluent written and spoken Spanish or another language highly preferred.

• Experience with Office productivity tools, including Excel and PowerPoint, and with Smartsheet or similar project management and reporting tools.

• Strong international-relations, client-management, and major-event operations skills across diverse, global stakeholders and LA28 functional areas.

Valued Experience

• Direct experience with the adaptive or Paralympic community.

• Prior Olympic or Paralympic Games experience.

• Familiarity with data analytics and reporting tools.

• Understanding of Olympic and Paralympic structures and protocols.

• Experience in client services, membership, or account management.

What We Offer

• A client-facing role at the heart of a once-in-a-generation Games.

• Real exposure to international relations and complex multi-venue Games delivery.

• A collaborative, inclusive team serving a global Olympic and Paralympic community.

• Purpose-driven work with direct impact on the athlete and delegation experience.

What This Role Means for the Games

National Olympic Committees are among LA28's most important clients, and their experience shapes how the world remembers these Games. The relationships you build and the planning you support now determine how smoothly delegations arrive, compete, and are cared for at Games-time.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

• Available to work onsite in our Downtown Los Angeles-based office.

• The majority of work will be conducted in an office setting, requiring extended periods of time using computers, phones, and other office equipment.

• The LA28 office is an open floorplan working environment; employees must be able to work efficiently in an open cubicle environment.

• Hours of work may vary, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, especially during peak event periods.

• Perform other duties as required; the role will evolve over time and may include operational responsibilities during the Olympic and Paralympic Games.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position is $70,500 - $82,000.

The pay scale provided is the range that LA28 reasonably expects to pay as starting base compensation for this role. All LA28 compensation remains subject to final determination based on individual candidate qualifications, experience, or other reasonable criteria consistent with LA28's operational business needs and applicable law.

Accommodation

LA28 is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require an accommodation at any stage, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Equal Opportunity

LA28 is committed to fair and unbiased recruitment procedures allowing all applicants an equal opportunity for employment, free from discrimination on the basis of religion, race, sex, age, sexual orientation, disability, color, ethnic or national origin, or any other classification as may be protected by applicable law. LA28 will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance and all applicable laws. We strive to build a team that is inclusive and encourage qualified candidates of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities to apply. We assess applications based on relevant skills, education, and experience a candidate can add to our team.

jobs.title: Senior Component Engineer
jobs.description:

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Senior Component Engineer to join our fast-growing team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Component engineering is critical to the performance, reliability, and long-term supportability of Echodyne’s advanced radar products. Echodyne is seeking a Senior Component Engineer to join our Component Engineering team and own component engineering activities for assigned products and programs across product development, production, and sustaining engineering.

In this role, you will work across Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Manufacturing to drive component selection and qualification, support new product introduction (NPI) and production release, and ensure components remain available, compliant, and supportable throughout the product lifecycle. You will proactively manage lifecycle, obsolescence, and supply continuity risks, resolve complex component and supplier quality issues, and mentor less experienced engineers. The ideal candidate combines strong component engineering expertise with sound technical judgment and effective cross-functional collaboration.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own component engineering activities and commitments for assigned products and programs throughout development, production, and sustaining Evaluate electronic components based on performance, reliability, availability, cost, lifecycle, and application requirements Own component qualification for new parts, alternates, and changes, in coordination with design engineers, including qualification plans, test requirements, acceptance criteria, results review, and final approval Review new part requests against design requirements and component risks, ensuring alignment with component selection standards, derating guidelines, and preferred parts strategies before production release. Partner with design engineers on component selection, trade studies, and resolution of component related technical issues Manage component part creation and release, including AML/AVL records and required component data and documentation within PLM Provide component engineering input during design and production-readiness reviews

• Drive component lifecycle and supply continuity for assigned products and programs Perform BOM reviews and proactively identify obsolescence, availability, lead time, single source, and other component risks Drive PCN, EOL, shortage, last time buy, second source, and alternate component activities Drive component standardization, part consolidation, cost reduction, and value-engineering activities

• Coordinate production and sustaining activities across Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing, and external suppliers Coordinate qualification of component manufacturers in partnership with Supply Chain and Quality Own component quality investigations and failure analysis in coordination with the Quality team, including supplier containment and corrective actions, and drive resulting design and process improvements Support ECOs, deviations, and sustaining changes resulting from component qualification, lifecycle, supply, and quality activities

• Ensure environmental and material compliance requirements are addressed and maintain current lifecycle, sourcing, compliance, and qualification information within PLM

• Mentor and support less experienced engineers as needed and contribute to continuous improvement of Component Engineering practices

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

• Experience evaluating electronic components used in analog, digital, RF, power, and related electronic systems

• Ability to interpret datasheets, specifications, qualification data, and supplier documentation and make independent technical recommendations

• Experience managing component lifecycle activities including PCNs, EOLs, obsolescence, alternate components, and second sourcing

• Experience performing BOM reviews and identifying technical, lifecycle, availability, and supply risks

• Experience planning and executing component qualification and supporting electronic hardware through production

• Experience working with PLM systems, engineering change processes, and controlled product documentation

• Problem solving, communication, organization, and cross functional collaboration skills

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE
(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)

• Experience with Arena PLM

• Experience with environmental and material compliance, including but not limited to RoHS, REACH, and related documentation

• Experience supporting aerospace, defense, radar, RF, or other high reliability electronic products

• Experience working with contract manufacturers, distributors, and global electronic component suppliers

• Understanding of PCB fabrication and assembly processes as they relate to component selection and manufacturability

QUALIFICATIONS

• BS in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related technical field

• 5 or more years of relevant experience in component engineering, hardware development, electronics manufacturing, or related discipline

• Eligibility to handle export-controlled information (ITAR/EAR)

Echodyne’s technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant’s eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations.  Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.

This is an exempt role.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Strive Pharmacy is a personalized compounding pharmacy built on a simple conviction: medicine should fit the patient, not the other way around. We started Strive because we believed the pharmaceutical industry was overdue for a more human approach—one that prioritizes individualized care, clinical nuance, and genuine partnership with patients and providers.

Compounding gives us the tools to do that. Every formulation we prepare is built to the specific needs of a specific person, and every interaction we have is guided by that same commitment to personalized care.

We're growing, and we're looking for people who share that conviction. If you're ready to be part of a pharmacy that takes the work seriously and the people even more seriously, we'd like to meet you.

Strive exists to disrupt an industry long overdue for a more personal approach to care. We put the human element at the center of everything: every formulation, every patient interaction, every provider partnership. We're not just a compounding pharmacy. We're a team on a mission to change what personalized healthcare looks and feels like.

Location: Onsite, Gilbert, Arizona
Position Type: Full-Time
Schedule: Friday through Sunday, 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM
Compensation Range: $28 to $29 per hour, plus $3 per hour shift differential

Position Overview:

Strive Pharmacy is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Sterile Compounding Pharmacy Technician to join our overnight compounding team. In this critical role, you will prepare custom sterile compounded medications while maintaining the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and regulatory compliance. Working under the direct supervision of licensed Pharmacists, the Sterile Compounding Pharmacy Technician performs aseptic compounding activities, completes required documentation, maintains cleanroom standards, and supports the safe production of patient-specific and batch-compounded medications in accordance with Strive Pharmacy’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Key Responsibilities:

• Sterile Compounding: Follow proprietary formulations and established procedures to accurately and safely compound sterile injectable medications.

• Quality Control & Documentation: Perform ongoing quality checks, prepare samples for testing, and initiate investigations for deviations from established procedures.

• Pharmacist Collaboration: Work closely with the Pharmacist-in-Charge, facility Pharmacists, and Quality Assurance teams to maintain product integrity, accuracy, and regulatory compliance.

• Equipment Documentation: Maintain calibration logs for scales, electronic meters, and other laboratory equipment. Accurately document quality procedures, production activities, and required compounding records.

• Cleanroom Maintenance: Maintain cleanroom cleanliness, organization, and compliance according to established procedures. Properly dispose of chemicals and waste materials according to safety protocols.

• Inventory Management: Monitor inventory levels, identify supply needs, report shortages to supervisors, and inspect materials for expiration or quality concerns.

• Compliance & Continuous Improvement: Participate in audits, inspections, competency assessments, and required continuing education activities to support ongoing compliance and operational excellence.

Required Qualifications:

• Active National Pharmacy Technician Certification through the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) or National Healthcareer Association (ExCPT), along with an active State Pharmacy Technician License or Registration in good standing.

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Working knowledge of United States Pharmacopeia (USP) <795>, USP <800>, and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 503B Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) guidelines.

• Strong understanding of pharmaceutical calculations, medical terminology, aseptic technique, and sterile compounding processes.

• Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment while maintaining exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and quality standards.

• Ability to operate small, sensitive, and specialized laboratory equipment used in sterile compounding processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Minimum of 1 year of sterile compounding experience in a high-volume sterile compounding pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, 503A compounding pharmacy, or 503B outsourcing facility.

• Experience with cleanroom operations, environmental monitoring, quality assurance documentation, regulatory compliance processes, and continuing education related to sterile compounding.

Work Environment:

This position is primarily based in an onsite sterile cleanroom and laboratory environment. The role requires regular periods of standing or sitting, performing precision compounding tasks, keyboarding, and computer use, with occasional lifting of pharmaceutical supplies up to 30 lbs. The position requires the ability to wear required cleanroom Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), including masks, gloves, lab coats, coveralls, hairnets, safety goggles, and shoe covers. Employees must be able to successfully complete required medical clearance for use of an Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA)-compliant N95 respirator and work safely around chemicals and cleaning agents commonly used in laboratory environments. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

Hourly Pay Rate

$28—$29 USD

Join Us in Making an Impact:

At Strive, the work is real and the impact is direct. Every role here contributes to a patient experience that's more personal, more attentive, and more human than what most people have come to expect from a pharmacy. Apply today and help us raise the bar.

• Paid time off

Culture:

Culture isn't an afterthought at Strive. It's something we actively build. We foster a collaborative, engaging workplace where employees have opportunities to connect, celebrate, and build meaningful relationships with their colleagues. We're committed to supporting the personal and professional growth of every employee, both inside and outside the workplace.

EEO:

Strive Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state or local laws.

Echodyne is seeking a Principal PCB/A Materials & Process Engineer with strong expertise in printed circuit board materials, fabrication processes, and electronics assembly processes to support the development and production of high-performance commercial radar products.

At the foundation of every Echodyne radar is a printed circuit board assembly that must deliver RF, high-speed digital, thermal, mechanical, and manufacturing performance within a producible design. In this role, you will serve as a subject matter expert for PCB materials and fabrication processes, while also applying strong working knowledge of PCBA assembly processes to help bring new products to market and improve supplier capability across the product lifecycle.

This role will work primarily in new product development, partnering with design engineering, program management, operations, supply chain, and suppliers to ensure that new PCB and PCBA designs are aligned with capable, scalable, and reliable manufacturing processes. You will also support production supplier development where new or improved supplier capabilities are required to support released products, cost reduction, yield improvement, reliability, or manufacturability needs.

• Provide practical design and process guidance to improve manufacturability, reliability, cost, and supplier execution

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

• Knowledge of PCB materials, fabrication processes, stackups, and design-for-manufacturing / Quality / Reliability practices for RF, high-speed, or mixed-signal products

• Experience working directly with PCB fabricators, material suppliers, and electronics manufacturing suppliers

• Ability to evaluate PCB/PCBA designs, fabrication documentation, supplier design rules, and manufacturing tradeoffs and prioritize activities based on this analysis

• Experience with RF PCB materials, PTFE or mixed-material stackups, rigid-flex construction, metal-backed boards, or complex multilayer fabrication

• Experience with advanced PCB processes such as sequential lamination, blind/buried vias, filled vias, controlled-depth drilling, or controlled-impedance structures

• Experience with electronics manufacturing, supplier development, product manufacturing engineering, or technical supplier management

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE
(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)

• Experience supporting NPI, supplier qualification, manufacturability reviews, production readiness, or process improvement activities

• Knowledge of PCBA assembly processes, manufacturing constraints, common failure modes, and supplier process controls

Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

The Opportunity:

We're hiring a Transitions Experience Manager to be the face of Redstone for every new client and every incoming on-site team, guiding each property through the full transition journey, from the moment the Property Management Agreement is signed through a confident Day 60.

In this role, you'll be the single point of contact for clients and department heads during one of the biggest moments of change they'll experience with us, blending warm, high-end hospitality with sharp back-end execution in Entrata.

You'll work directly with the Director of Strategic Initiatives and across departments to keep every transition on schedule, on-brand, and stress-free for the client. The role is built for someone who's just as comfortable presenting to an ownership group as they are heads-down in a spreadsheet. Prior Regional Manager experience is not required.

This role is perfect for someone who:

• Projects calm authority and genuine warmth during high-stakes moments of change

• Communicates with exceptional emotional intelligence and active listening

• Stays organized under tight deadlines, juggling several transitions at once

• Notices process gaps and brings solutions instead of just flagging problems

• Picks up new systems quickly and isn't intimidated by property-level financial reports

• Follows through on every commitment, even when priorities shift fast

• Takes initiative and doesn't need constant direction

• Uses AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to work smarter, not harder

What You'll Own:

As our Transitions Experience Manager, you will:

• Transition-In: Take ownership of the client relationship the moment a PMA is signed, and stay the single point of contact for the client and department heads through Day 60.

• Project warmth and high-end hospitality in every client touchpoint, weaving Redstone's core values into the transition experience.

• Own the transition checklist (RFI collection, data prep, Entrata configuration, and Go-Live migration), keeping every department head and milestone on schedule.

• Travel to the property for Day 1 launch on Tier 1 transitions (alongside the Regional Manager); support Tier 2 transitions remotely.

• On-Site Team Onboarding: Train and mentor the new community manager and staff on timelines, SOPs, and software adoption for their first 30–60 days.

• Deliver the 30–60 day client report and run weekly check-in calls with the Community Manager through stabilization, until the Regional Manager takes over full ownership.

• Operational Handoffs: Partner with regional operations managers to audit site-level workflows so daily responsibilities shift without disrupting resident satisfaction or lease administration.

• Transition-Outs: Compile final reporting and coordinate with internal departments to close out every RFI item when a property leaves management. No travel required.

• Continuous Improvement: Build feedback loops with on-site staff to catch friction points, and bring process fixes back to Operations and Leadership.

This is the kind of role where staying two steps ahead pays off: for you, for the client, and for the team you're handing things off to.

Who You Are:

You're a builder at your core: someone who makes people feel steady and supported, even when everything around them is changing.

You bring:

• 1+ years in a client-facing coordination, hospitality, or operations role

• Comfort leading calls and presenting directly to clients and ownership groups

• The ability to read and speak to property-level financial and operational reports (AP/AR, rent roll, delinquency)

• Strong organizational and project coordination skills: you can run several transitions at once without dropping a ball

• A genuine passion for hospitality and making people feel confident during big change

• Integrity and follow-through, even when priorities shift fast

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort learning new systems quickly

Bonus points if you have:

• Prior experience with Entrata or a comparable property management system

• Regional Manager or similar multi-site operations background (not required!)

• Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools to manage workflows

Compensation & Schedule:

$80,000–$95,000 per year, plus performance bonus. Full-time, exempt. Monday–Friday, standard business hours, with travel and occasional overtime during active transitions.

Location & Work Environment:

This role is based out of our corporate office in Provo, UT, with regular travel to properties across the portfolio, typically 1–2 Tier 1 takeovers per month, plus annual travel to the company leadership Summit. On-site transition days are fast-paced and may involve extended hours.

Why You'll Love Working at Redstone:

• Health, vision, and dental insurance

• 401(k) with up to 6% company match

• Flex PTO and 10 paid holidays

• Gym membership

• Discounted phone plan

• 3 paid service days per year

• Paid parental leave

• Professional development support

• Employee assistance program

• A people-first culture that walks the talk

• A front-row seat to Redstone's growth, one transition at a time

• A leader who values your judgment and your time

• Work that matters: every transition is someone's big moment

• A team that cares deeply and communicates honestly

• A workplace where fun and performance go hand-in-hand

At Redstone, you'll have the opportunity to shape how every new client experiences our brand, build real relationships with ownership groups, and do meaningful work during the moments that matter most.

Ready to Join Us?

If you find quiet satisfaction in a smooth Day 1, a client who feels taken care of, and a handoff that just works, we'd love to meet you. Apply today and help make every Redstone transition unforgettable.

At Redstone Residential, we’re committed to creating a workplace where people thrive. We believe in elevating communities, starting with our own team. Whether you’re just beginning your career or looking to grow in a fast-paced, purpose-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Sr. Associate, NCS Publications & Information Management
jobs.description:
LA28-USOPP does not provide relocation assistance for any positions. If you are based outside the Los Angeles area, we still welcome your application — we value talent from all geographic backgrounds and want to hear from you if you are able to work on-site in LA.

Role Purpose:

The Sr. Associate of NCS Publications & Information Management plays a critical role in the planning, coordination, and execution of the NCS Communications and information management strategy. The primary focus is on delivering high-quality pre-Games publications and managing information for the National Olympic Committees (NOCs) and National Paralympic Committees (NPCs) participating in the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games. Reporting to the NCS Communications Operations Manager, this individual will ensure the consistent and professional delivery of critical information, directly contributing to a seamless and successful Games experience for our key stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

Publications & Content Management

• Manage end-to-end timelines, version control, approvals, and distribution across NCS digital and print platforms.

• Help drive the complete lifecycle of core NCS publications, including the Chef de Mission Guides, from content gathering and validation to final distribution.

• Gather and validate inputs from NCS relations and planning teams and cross-functional partners to ensure completeness and accuracy of all NCS managed

• Ensure all publications strictly adhere to LA28 editorial standards, branding, translations, and IOC/IPC accessibility and sustainability requirements.

• Support the integration of technology and AI-enabled solutions to improve publication pipelines and efficiency.

• Support the successful and on-time delivery of the Chef de Mission Guides and all Games-time Guides / updates for the Olympic and Paralympic Games.

Information Management & Communications Operations

• Support the drafting, review, and distribution of newsletters, extranet updates, policies, guides, and publications.

• Serve as a key operator for NCS information systems, including the NOC/NPC extranets and newsletters.

• Monitor content on information sharing channels to ensure accuracy, relevancy, and accessibility for all NOCs and NPCs.

• Serve as a key contributor to keeping NCS databases, trackers, and tools current and accurate to drive cross-functional alignment.

Games-Time & Readiness Operations

• Assist with meeting preparation, content development, in-room logistics, and administrative follow-up for the Chefs de Mission meetings.

• Monitor and log operational items raised during CdM meetings

• Execute NCS procedures to coordinate and deliver global communication with stakeholders to ensure timely escalation and resolution.

• Manage critical publication and communication distributions during readiness exercises and live Games-time operations.

• Assist in other Games-time operations that may include event operations, NOC/NPC service center, and other special projects.

Background & Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in communications, publishing, or major event operations, with demonstrated experience in project managing content through design, translation, and distribution cycles.

• Excellent written communication skills, with a meticulous eye for proofreading, detail, and quality control.

• Exceptional project coordination and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple content pipelines (e.g., print, digital, presentations) simultaneously in a deadline-driven environment.

• A strong eye for visual communication and presentation design, with proficiency in developing clear, impactful slides using tools like PowerPoint or Google Slides.

• Proven ability to work with diverse internal and external stakeholders, including experience coordinating with translation services or managing multilingual content workflows.

• Ability to synthesize complex operational information into clear, concise, and visually engaging deliverables, including written guides and presentations.

• Comfort working in fast-paced, evolving operational environments and adapting to changing priorities.

• Ability to work effectively and collaboratively across multicultural and cross-functional teams.

Expectations:

• Familiarity with Smartsheet, Mailchimp, and SharePoint a plus.

• Experience working on major sporting events or within the Olympic/Paralympic Movement not required but preferred

• Demonstrated comfort working with new technologies and evolving digital tools, including AI-supported workflows and information systems.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages such as French, Spanish considered an asset.

The successful candidate will join a highly collaborative team responsible for developing and maintaining a Spring Boot application with a MariaDB backend that processes terabytes of enterprise data each week. The team delivers software while preparing the application for containerized deployment on Kubernetes. The ideal candidate is passionate about modern software engineering and enjoys building scalable Java applications that process large volumes of data while leveraging Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, relational databases, and container technologies. • Develop, test, debug, and maintain Java and Angular applications using modern software engineering practices.

• Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs.

Bring deine Karriere auf ein neues Niveau und bewirb dich jetzt online!

Für Airbus Defence and Space in Manching suchen wir für den Bereich "Quality EF Series, Prototypes and Future Projects“ einen

Quality Inspector Mechanik/Technik für Eurodrone/Eurofighter Produktion (d/m/w).

Schwerbehinderte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt.

Dein Standort

Manching ist eine aufstrebende Gemeinde, die ein vielfältiges Freizeit- und Kulturangebot bietet. Hier können Sie die Lebensqualität auf dem Land genießen und dennoch die Annehmlichkeiten der nahegelegenen Städte nutzen.

Deine Vorteile

• Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen
• 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe
• Hervorragende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und tolle internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
• Sonderleistungen: arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, vergünstigtes Auto Leasing, Sonderkonditionen bei Versicherungen, Bezuschussung im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr, Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen
• Vor-Ort-Einrichtungen: Arzt für Check-ups und andere gesundheitsbezogene Dienstleistungen, Kantine und Cafeteria, standortnaher Kindergarten
• Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Jobsharing, Teilzeitmodelle, flexible Arbeitszeiten, individuelle Auszeit)

Unsere Hauptaufgabe ist es die Konformität des Waffensystems Eurodrone/Eurofighter mit den festgelegten Spezifikationen zu garantieren. Zur Aufrechterhaltung und Erhöhung der Kundenbindung- und Zufriedenheit steht für uns und auch dich "on quality, on time, on cost" an oberster Stelle.

Zu deinen Aufgaben im Bereich Eurodrone und Eurofighter gehören folgende Punkte:

• Durchführung von Qualitätsprüfaufgaben für Produkt und Dienstleistungen mit dem Umgang von vordefinierten Prüfpunkten.
• Eingangskontrolle der Eurodrone und Eurofighter Major Units nach Ankunft
• Unterstützung und Mitwirkung beim Aufbau der Eurodrone Produktion und deren Prozesse
• Kontrolle und Prüfung während dem Zusammenbau, der Ausrüstung und Testphase der Eurodrone Prototypen
• Komponenten der Splice und System Splice Freigaben und Abnahmen in der EF FAL und Eurodrone Prototypenbau
• Betreuung und Abnahme der B und C-Teste
• Erteilung der Engine Ground Run und Flugfreigaben der Eurodrone Prototypen
• Endabnahme des gesamten Lfz. und anschließende Übergabe an den Kunden
• Im Falle von Abweichungen Unterstützung bei der Ursachenforschung, Hilfe bei der Erarbeitung von Korrektur-/ Präventivmaßnahmen und Unterstützung bei der Lösungsfindung
• Bestätigung der Konformität des Produktes/ der Dienstleistung
• Beobachtung und Prüfung der Arbeitslandschaft, Anlagen, Hardware, Werkzeuge etc. auf Konformität mit geltenden Betriebs und Sicherheitsanforderungen
• Führung und Beratung zur Einhaltung und Berücksichtigung von Qualitätsaspekten, um zukünftige Probleme zu vermeiden
• Technischer Ansprechpartner für interne und externe Kunden
• Mitwirkung bei internen Audits
• Durchführung von Fertigungsbeobachtungen in den Fertigungsbereichen

Du hast folgende Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen:

• Abgeschlossenen Ausbildung zum Fluggerätmechaniker
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Meister oder Techniker
• Grundlagenlehrgang zum CAT B1
• Eurofighterkentnisse von Vorteil
• Erfahrung im Umgang mit SAP
• Erfahrung im Umgang mit PDM
• Hohes Engagement und technische Erfahrung
• Teamplayer
• Qualitätsorientiert und erfahren im Umgang mit komplexen Situationen
• Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Du bist...

• Sehr engagiert und technisch erfahren?
• Bereit, mit und in einem motivierten Team zu arbeiten
• Bereit für Dienstreisen im Rahmen der Eurodrone Erprobung
• Qualitätsorientiert und kannst mit komplexen Situationen umgehen?

Interesse?

Dann bewirb dich bei uns und heb mit uns ab!

jobs.title: Full Time - Sales Specialist - Millwork - Day
jobs.description:
Your Impact at Lowe's

As a Sales Specialist, you will be one of the first people our customers meet. Your sales expertise can help customers find the products they need and encourage them to transform a great project idea into reality. If you enjoy helping people and solving problems in a fast-paced environment, this is the perfect role for you.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe's is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe's associate, you'll gain access to a variety of benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.

• Earn more from your sales performance with additional bonus opportunities.
• Make your well-being a priority with multiple health insurance options.
• Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
• Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k).
• Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
• Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

Your Day at Lowe's

Sales Specialists at Lowe's are very active, moving throughout the store or garden center, answering phones, and talking to customers. As a Sales Specialist, you'll spend most of your time communicating with customers – discussing project needs, answering questions, and helping them accomplish their home improvement goals.

You will become the product expert, informing customers of specifications, features, promotions, and financing options to close a sale. Your exceptional consulting services help ensure that customer needs are met before leaving the store.

You will be working in one of the following departments, based on hiring needs and skillsets: Appliances, Cabinets, Flooring, Live Nursery, Millwork, Fashion Plumbing, Outlet, Tool Rental, Pro, or Windows & Walls.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide SMART customer service by seeking out customers to understand their needs, answer questions, and communicate the advantages of Lowe's products and services
• Serve as a point of contact for customers and vendors within your department, providing project estimates, scheduling installer visits, processing and tracking customer orders/installations, and following up to ensure project completion.
• If in the Pro Department, focus on external accounts and outside sales and services
• Monitor inventory levels to support sales, working with vendors and other stores to find merchandise and order replacement stock
• Perform price reviews by pricing policies and ensure maintenance of pricing and documentation
• Support all checkout functions, call buttons, departmental pages, or requests for assistance
• Train associates in the department by conducting on-the-job training on the Sales floor and coaching around development needs
• Complete other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications

• High School Diploma or GED
• 1 year experience in customer-facing sales or 6 months of Lowe’s retail experience (Or 3 years of external experience in customer-facing sales or 18 months of Lowe’s retail experience if education requirement is not met)
• 1 year of experience in sales or customer service in a sales environment with required sales goals or metrics
• Able to Read, write, and perform basic arithmetic (addition and subtraction)
• Able to stand and sit for prolonged periods
• Minimally lift 25lbs unassisted or over 25lbs with or without an accommodation
• Obtain sales-related licensure or registration if required by law in your state (Lowe's will support and fund this requirement)

Preferred Qualifications

• 1 year of experience in completing customer sales orders
• 1 Year Experience promoting product related services and plans such as installation, delivery, credit financing, or extended protection plan
• 2 years of experience designing customized products for customers using 20/20 or Computer-Aided Design System
• Professional certification related to the department being considered
• Bi-lingual skills

Lowe's commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we strongly encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

Travel Requirements

This role does not require regular travel; however, this role may need to travel occasionally to meetings, training, or to support neighboring stores.

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

About Lowe's

Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 50 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2023 sales of more than $86 billion, Lowe's operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing and helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts. For more information, visit Lowes.com

Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. For information regarding our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

Associate Benefits (https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/joining-our-team)

• Working at one of the largest retail companies has its perks. We offer exceptional benefits and wellness programs for eligible full-time and part-time associates, tailored for many different lifestyles. Our benefits range from health, vision and dental insurance to paid vacation, tuition assistance and parental and family-building benefits. Plus, we offer learning and development opportunities to help our associates grow their skills and achieve their goals.
• Health, Dental and Vision insurance

Job Description:

We are searching for the best talent for a Global Event Management Operations Coordinator. This hybrid role will be in New Brunswick, NJ.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe good health is the foundation of vibrant lives, thriving communities, and forward progress. That’s why for more than 130 years, we have aimed to keep people well at every age and every stage of life. Today, as the world’s largest and most broadly-based healthcare company, we are committed to using our reach and size for good, and we strive to improve access and affordability, create healthier communities, and put a healthy mind, body, and environment in reach of everyone, everywhere.

This position reports to the Leader, Global Event Management. The Global Event Management Operations Coordinator serves as the operational backbone of the Global Event Management team, supporting the financial, administrative, procurement, vendor and logistics needs. Key responsibilities include managing payments, purchase orders, budgets, contracts, travel arrangements, calendar coordination, merchandise purchases, inventory tracking and shipment logistics. While this role supports a team responsible for high-profile meetings and events, its primary focus is operational coordination and business support rather than event planning or event management. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates exceptional attention to detail and takes pride in keeping complex processes organized and on track.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial, Budget, & Operations Management (40%)

• Oversee and manage complex financial operations supporting up to $26M in annual spend, including vendor payments through Ariba and e-Marketplace (wire transfers, check requests).
• Manage purchase order creation and lifecycle management.
• Perform Corporate Meeting Card (CMC) reconciliation, compliance tracking, and expense reporting through Concur, including reconciliation of multiple high-value AMEX Corporate Meeting Cards (>$1M each).
• Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation, ensuring compliance with company policies, audit requirements, audit readiness, and business continuity.
• Identify opportunities to enhance financial tracking, reporting accuracy, operational processes, and overall process efficiency.
• Support the development and refinement of operational processes, policies, and best practices to enhance consistency, effectiveness, and compliance.

Vendor & Contract Management (25%)

• Manage MSA and contract lifecycle processes through eMarketplace, ensuring timely renewals and compliance.
• Coordinate vendor sourcing activities, including bid requests for large-volume projects (premiums and gifts).
• Partner with external vendors (NSO, DMC, production) to support presentations, onboarding, and execution.

Operational Coordination & Team Support (20%)

• Provide operational and administrative support across Global Event Management initiatives, coordinating tasks, timelines, meetings, calendars, documentation, and follow-up activities to ensure priorities remain organized and on track.
• Support a team of employees and contractors by managing operational details, tracking action items and facilitating the timely execution of assigned workstreams.
• Maintain trackers, records, status updates, and supporting documentation to provide visibility into operational activities, budgets, shipments, contracts, and key deliverables.
• Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to coordinate requests, gather information, support reporting, and contribute to process improvements that enhance team effectiveness, business continuity, and operational excellence.

Executive Support, Travel & Logistics Coordination (10%)

• Proactively manage and prioritize a complex, rapidly changing executive calendar, ensuring alignment with business priorities.
• Support Executive Committee and Chairman’s Office requests, including high-touch VIP arrangements (travel, accommodations, special experiences).

• Coordinate complex domestic and international travel logistics, including air, ground transportation, visa support, and passport renewals. Ensure compliance with global travel requirements while optimizing traveler experience and efficiency.
• Be a liaison between senior leaders, administrative teams, and external partners to ensure seamless communication and delivery.

Operational Coordination & Communication (5%)

• Manage high-volume operational communications and respond to routine and time-sensitive requests.
• Coordinate logistics, materials, and shipments to support program(s) execution.
• Open, sort, prioritize and distribute communications and shipments, as needed.
• Assist with onsite execution of meetings and events, ensuring smooth operations and issue resolution.

ORGANIZATIONAL/CULTURAL ASTUTENESS

• Demonstrate strong knowledge of Johnson & Johnson’s organizational structure, executive protocols, and global operations.
• Effectively navigate complex stakeholder environments to drive alignment and deliver high-quality outcomes.

Required qualifications

• High school diploma required, bachelor’s degree preferred.
• A minimum of 5 years of experience in operations coordination, administrative support, financial administration, payment processing, vendor management, project coordination, or a related business operations role.
• Experienced with executive travel and logistics.
• Advanced financial and budget management skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
• Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects/priorities while meeting deadlines and tracking deliverables.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills in fast-paced environments.
• High level of professionalism, discretion and customer service orientation.
• Highly organized with strong prioritization and project tracking capabilities.
• Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and implement operational efficiencies.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
• Experience with financial and procurement systems including Ariba, Concur, eMarketplace, Aravo, Totality and Apex.

PREFERRED

• Experience supporting Executive Committee members, senior leaders, or other high-profile stakeholders.
• Experience supporting global programs, events, or large-scale initiatives.
• Experience coordinating and managing external vendors.

The Senior Performance Marketing Strategist leads the development and activation of performance media strategies that drive digital commerce growth aligned with P&G Personal Healthcare brand goals.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician (2p-10:30p)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary:

Maintenance Technician

Our manufacturing teams bring our brands to life by operating safe, reliable, and efficient production facilities. As a Maintenance Technician, you will help keep our syrup manufacturing, packaging, utility, and facility systems operating safely and reliably.

This is a hands-on industrial maintenance position requiring strong troubleshooting skills, mechanical ability, electrical knowledge, and the ability to respond effectively when production equipment fails.

Key Responsibilities

• Troubleshoot and repair mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control-system problems affecting production.
• Support syrup batching, processing, filling, packaging, conveying, palletizing, and material-handling equipment.
• Diagnose equipment failures, determine root causes, and complete repairs that restore safe and reliable operation.
• Perform preventive and predictive maintenance on production equipment, plant utilities, and facility systems.
• Inspect, adjust, repair, and replace components such as motors, gearboxes, bearings, chains, sprockets, pumps, valves, sensors, cylinders, conveyors, and electrical devices.
• Troubleshoot electrical circuits, motor controls, variable-frequency drives, instrumentation, sensors, and PLC-controlled equipment.
• Read and use electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and technical documentation.
• Perform equipment alignments, lubrication, fabrication, installation, and modification work as assigned.
• Support plant utility and facility systems, which may include boilers, chillers, compressed air, water treatment, wastewater, and building systems.
• Respond to production calls, communicate clearly with operators and supervisors, and prioritize work based on safety, quality, and production impact.
• Assist production personnel with equipment setup, adjustment, and proper equipment operation when needed.
• Document troubleshooting findings, repairs, labor, parts usage, and follow-up work in the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS).
• Identify recurring failures and recommend corrective actions or equipment improvements.
• Follow all safety, food-safety, quality, environmental, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and lockout/tagout requirements.
• Maintain clean and orderly work areas and return equipment to production in a safe and sanitary condition.
• Safely operate forklifts, high-reach equipment, aerial lifts, and other powered equipment after completing required training.
• Work cooperatively with technicians, production personnel, contractors, and plant leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

• High school diploma or GED.
• Demonstrated experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical and electrical equipment.
• Working knowledge of:Mechanical power transmissionIndustrial electrical systems and motor controlsPLC-controlled equipmentPneumatic systemsPumps, valves, piping, and fluid systemsBearings, lubrication, alignment, chains, and conveyorsPreventive maintenance practices
• Ability to use electrical meters, hand tools, power tools, and precision measuring instruments safely.
• Ability to read electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and equipment manuals.
• Ability to achieve a passing score at the Maintenance Technician I level of the company’s technical assessment.
• Ability to safely lift, climb, bend, kneel, work at heights, and perform maintenance work in an active industrial environment.
• Ability to work independently, make sound troubleshooting decisions, and communicate effectively during equipment breakdowns.
• Ability to work the assigned shift and provide overtime, weekend, holiday, or emergency coverage as required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Associate degree, technical degree, apprenticeship, or recognized industrial-maintenance certification.
• Experience in food, beverage, pharmaceutical, chemical-processing, or another regulated manufacturing environment.
• Experience with PLC diagnostics and industrial automation systems.
• Experience with variable-frequency drives, instrumentation, and process-control equipment.
• Welding, machining, or metal-fabrication experience.
• Experience using SAP or another computerized maintenance management system.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Maintenance Technician does more than replace failed parts. This person troubleshoots systematically, performs quality repairs, documents the work accurately, communicates with the people affected, and helps prevent the same failure from happening again. Safety, food quality, equipment reliability, and teamwork are essential parts of every job.

Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

jobs.description:
Job Description & Summary

PwC, cabinet pluridisciplinaire, rassemble 7 000 collaborateurs en France et au Maghreb, au sein d’un réseau mondial de plus de 364 000 personnes dans 136 pays. Chaque jour, nous exerçons des métiers d’excellence pour concrétiser notre ambition : être utiles à nos clients et accélérateurs de mouvement.

Dans un monde en constante évolution, nous investissons dans le développement de nos équipes avec une proposition de valeur forte : Grow here. Go further. Un engagement mondial pour accompagner nos talents dans l’évolution de leurs compétences.

Ce que nous recherchons ?  Des expertises, bien sûr. Mais surtout, des personnalités curieuses, passionnées, prêtes à incarner les comportements du PwC Professional, notre référentiel commun qui guide notre manière de travailler ensemble.

Reconnu Top Employer pour la 6ème année consécutive, PwC s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et handi-accueillant, où chacun peut pleinement collaborer et avoir un impact. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part.

Votre équipe

L'équipe Innovation accompagne la transformation de PwC en identifiant, expérimentant et déployant les initiatives capables de créer de la valeur durable pour la firme.

Elle intervient sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de l'innovation : veille sur les tendances, structuration et pilotage des initiatives IA, développement des capacités d'acculturation, animation et accompagnement des métiers dans l'adoption des usages.

En lien étroit avec les équipes métiers (LoS) et les différentes fonctions support, l'équipe construit les dispositifs permettant de transformer l'innovation en usages concrets créateurs de valeur pour les collaborateurs et les clients.

Pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous recherchons un(e) alternant(e) Chargé(e) de projets innovation au sein de notre équipe basée à Neuilly-sur-Seine.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement stimulant, au croisement de l’innovation, de la stratégie, de la transformation des métiers et de l’intelligence artificielle.

Vos missions

I. Support à la structuration et au pilotage de projets d’innovation

Vous accompagnerez l'équipe dans le pilotage opérationnel d'un portefeuille d'initiatives innovation à fort impact.

À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à :

• Coordonner l'avancement des projets avec les différentes parties prenantes ;
• Produire les supports de pilotage et de communication à destination des parties prenantes et instances de gouvernance
• Créer et déployer les plans d'action
• Contribuer à la mesure de la valeur créée et à la préparation des décisions de passage à l'échelle
• Assurer la documentation, le partage des retours d'expérience et la capitalisation des bonnes pratiques.

Votre rôle sera essentiel pour permettre à l'équipe d'accélérer l'exécution des projets et de transformer les expérimentations en solutions pérennes.

II. Enrichir et déployer l’expérience de formation Tech des collaborateurs

Vous prendrez une part active à un programme stratégique visant à renforcer la culture technologique et l'acculturation Tech au sein de la firme.

À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à :

• Concevoir les parcours d’apprentissage : définition de l’expérience, formats, etc.
• Coordonner la création de contenus de formation en lien avec nos assets et partenaires pédagogiques internes ou externes
• Assurer la mise à jour régulière des parcours afin de garantir un niveau de connaissance homogène et actualisé pour l’ensemble des cibles du programme
• Mettre en place et suivre les indicateurs de performance du programme afin d'améliorer en continu l'expérience proposée

Cette alternance vous apportera :

• Une vision transverse des enjeux d'innovation et de transformation d'un grand cabinet.
• Une immersion dans les usages concrets de l'IA en environnement professionnel.
• Une forte exposition aux équipes de direction et aux responsables métiers.
• L'opportunité de contribuer à des projets stratégiques à fort impact.
• Un environnement entrepreneurial favorisant l'autonomie, l'initiative et l'apprentissage.

Votre profil

• Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, ingénieur ou université (Bac+4/Bac+5)
• Première expérience en gestion de projets, idéalement de projets d’innovation
• Forte appétence pour l'innovation, la transformation et l'intelligence artificielle.
• Rigueur et excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse
• Curiosité, autonomie, esprit d'initiative pour structurer, animer, communiquer et fédérer
• Maîtrise de PowerPoint, Excel et connaissance des outils IA générative

Vos avantages

• Un environnement technologique innovant : accès à des outils de pointe comme le Tech Lab, Copilot M365 et l’IA Factory pour façonner le monde de demain.
• Des possibilités d’apprentissage et de développement hors normes, grâce à notre plateforme de formation intelligente et notre culture du feedback continu.
• Un cycle de performance stimulant, aligné avec le référentiel PwC Professional, pour vous aider à atteindre vos objectifs et viser l’excellence jour après jour.
• Un cadre de travail positif et inclusif pour vous permettre d’être pleinement vous-même et de collaborer efficacement au service de nos clients (programmes de parentalité, d’équité femmes-hommes, de santé et bien-être Be Well, Work Well, d’inclusion LGBT+ et de maintien dans l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap).

Pour en savoir plus sur nos avantages, rendez-vous sur notre page dédiée.

Notre processus de recrutement

Pour vous permettre de vivre une expérience fluide et transparente, notre processus de recrutement se déroule en plusieurs étapes :

1. Évaluation en ligne avec un test de compétences et/ou un test d’anglais

2. Entretien RH

3. Rencontres avec les équipes opérationnelles (un ou plusieurs entretiens en physique)

4. Vérification des informations : avant l’embauche, un organisme spécialisé procédera à la vérification des éléments figurant sur votre CV

jobs.title: Internship in BGE Reagents Development (Rotkreuz, 6 Months, start: mid-November / December 2026)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthcare pioneer and the industry’s global leader in in-vitro diagnostics, the Diagnostics Division pushes boundaries and challenges the status quo to redefine what’s possible. Our commitment to research and development means we can bring to the market integrated solutions in diagnostic testing, laboratory efficiency, healthcare digitalization, and decision support tools and software. Our products deliver increasingly precise information to help save lives, prevent or control the risk of infection, and monitor treatment effectiveness.

At Sensor and Reagent Development BGE, we are at the forefront of innovation in the healthcare industry. Banking on the technical expertise and know-how of our skilled and dedicated team of scientists and engineers, we design and develop sensors and reagents for blood gas and electrolyte (BGE) analyzers. Our products are essential for accurate and reliable patient diagnostics, impacting lives every day.

The Opportunity

In this internship, you will drive an exploratory feasibility project to evaluate novel oxygen scavenging strategies for next-generation blood gas reagent formulations. The project focuses on different innovative pathways such as small organic molecule scavengers, storage-stable enzymatic systems, and functional multilayer packaging foils.

Key responsibilities include:

• Organic Scavenger Screening & Electrochemistry: Identify and evaluate small organic molecules (e.g., food additives, antioxidants) to determine oxygen depletion kinetics while analyzing electrochemical behavior to minimize potential sensor interference.
• Enzymatic Scavenger Systems: Assess and validate enzyme-based systems for their feasibility and performance as effective oxygen scavengers.
• Functional Packaging & Materials Evaluation: Investigate active scavenging polymer laminates and pouch foils, conducting thorough leachables and extractables testing to safeguard sensor and reagent stability.
• Analytical Testing & Characterization: Apply advanced electrochemical, spectroscopic, and chromatographic methods to measure oxygen consumption rates and characterize matrix interactions.
• Data Analysis & Documentation: Synthesize experimental results, assess formulation and material viability, and present clear technical summaries and recommendations to the cross-functional R&D team.

Who You Are

• You are currently enrolled in, or have graduated from, a Master’s degree program (or equivalent advanced studies) in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field within the last 12 months prior to your start date.
• You are eager to gain practical industry experience in a dynamic laboratory setting. Furthermore, You have:
• Strong theoretical and practical foundation in organic chemistry and wet-lab chemical formulation (Required).
• Sound knowledge of enzymes, enzyme kinetics, and biochemical reaction mechanisms (Required).
• High degree of self-organization, analytical problem-solving skills, and a structured approach to experimental design (Required).
• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities in English (Required).
• Interest or experience in electrochemistry (e.g., oxidation potentials, electrode interactions) or analytical techniques (e.g., UV/Vis spectrophotometry, fluorescence assays) (Preferred).
• Basic understanding of or curiosity about packaging materials, active foils, and leachables/extractables testing (Preferred).

Application process:

• Please upload a current CV and a Motivation Letter.

Additional Information:

• Due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must be actively enrolled for the entire duration of the internship and provide an official university certificate stating that the internship is a mandatory part of their studies.
• This internship position is located in Rotkreuz, Switzerland, on-site.
• The start date for the internship is from mid- November / December 2026 with a duration of 6 months.
• Part-time employment and writing a thesis during the internship is not possible.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

If you're a recent graduate or soon-to-be graduate, join us and unlock a world of carefully curated experiences, knowledge, and connections to shape your career.  Along the way, you can expect all the training and support you need to make your mark on the world. Put simply, we’ll empower you to help determine how we do things and where we go next. Our graduates are a vital part of our success. Our Expert Programme

Why the Quant Graduate Programme?
Our team is an integral part of the bank, researching and developing models and producing data analysis tools for valuation and risk management across various business areas at Barclays.

Risk Quantitative Analytics (Risk QA)
As a Graduate in Risk Quantitative Analytics (Risk QA), you will join a group of specialised modellers and developers powering Barclay’s ability to manage financial risk. From day one, you’ll be part of a team that uses statistical methods, AI techniques, and coding strategies to build the tools and models Barclays uses to make big decisions. Along the way, you’ll collaborate with colleagues across risk, finance, global markets, and technology - gaining exposure to how different parts of the business come together to navigate market shifts and meet regulatory demands.

The chance to make an impact

We’ll keep you motivated with encouragement, feedback and support as you build your technical know-how, business acumen and leadership skills. We’ll help you connect with mentors, and network with colleagues and senior leaders alike.

You’ll have strong mathematical and programming skills, ideally in C/C++ or Python, along with logical thinking, creative problem solving and strong communication skills.

Successful applicants who are not eligible to receive a skilled worker visa, and who we are therefore unable to secure a skilled worker visa for, will be required to have their own legal right to work in the UK on a full-time basis from August 2027 to August 2028.

jobs.title: Retail Personal Banker l - Cincinnati Eastside
jobs.description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

GENERAL FUNCTION:

Selected candidates are intended to become a Retail Personal Banker I after completing a 4-8 week on-boarding and education program that includes rotations in operations and Sales & Service. There will be a certification at the conclusion of the program to provide selected candidates the opportunity to demonstrate skills necessary to successfully perform a role within the Retail Personal Banker job family. The Personal Banker I is a Financial Center position focused on using the consultative sales process to proactively identify and meet the financial needs of customers or prospects. The Personal Banker I maintains focus on acquiring new households and/or deepening existing customer relationships through a variety of activities, including but not limited to lobby leadership (Financial Centers) or aisle time (Bank Marts) and tele-consulting. This role is responsible for processing teller transactions as well as working as a member of the platform staff.

Responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues, and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank's risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Use the consultative sales process and Financial Needs Assessment to build a thorough customer profile and identify current and future financial needs.
• Maintain an in-depth knowledge of Retail consumer and small business products/services and recommend appropriate solutions using our value proposition.
• Utilize CAMP and other approved Marketing tools to proactively reach out to customers and set appointments for periodic financial reviews.
• Primarily focused on cross-selling to existing customer base and engaging in outside sales activities (i.e. Membership Advantage onsite presentations, business sales calls, community financial literacy events, etc.) as directed.
• Establish close working relationships with assigned Business Partners (Mortgage, Small Business, Commercial and Investment), referring customers when appropriate to provide timely, and holistic financial solutions.
• Consistently meet/exceed customer experience and individual/team production goals and enhance year-over-year revenue growth as measured by the Financial Center P&L.
• Provide guidance to CSRs with respect to the sales and referral process.
• Promote customer satisfaction with a friendly, helpful demeanor and professionalism.
• Act with confidence by answering customer questions and owning customer issues.
• Maintain a position of trust and responsibility by keeping all business confidential.
• Follow the Bancorp Code of Business Conduct and Ethics and other related policies, maintaining ethical behavior at all times.
• Adhere to established policies and procedures while opening/servicing the full range of Retail products.
• Participate in the consumer loan and bankcard process, owning sourced loans from application through closing.
• Participate in the opening/closing process of the Financial Center or Bank Mart as directed by the Financial Center Manager.
• Keep up to date on Retail procedures in place to mitigate fraudulent activity and unnecessary risk or exposure.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

None.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

• College degree or work experience providing transferrable skills, or, combination of education and experience.
• Experience in the financial industry preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to develop comfort level with sales activities designed to acquire new consumer household and small business customers and/or cross-sell to established customers.
• Must be able to demonstrate understanding of advanced math functions that will allow for analysis of credit and financial information.
• Ability to professionally represent Fifth Third Bank in terms of appearance and verbal/written communication.
• Demonstrated ability to develop a working knowledge of Retail policies and procedures in order to utilize good judgment in making sound decisions.
• This position requires S.A.F.E. Act registration at the time of employment through the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System (NMLS). The NMLS web site (mortgage.nationwidelicensingsystem.org) provides the MU4R questions and registration required for employment in this position.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

• Normal office environment.
• Extending viewing of computer screens.
• This program will require the ability to travel within the affiliate for training as well as scheduling flexibility.
• Travel outside of the affiliate will be required for various classroom training sessions.
